R_LNLW_MED_SEV.name: Median Nerve Severity from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_MED_SEV.description: Intermediate node representing the severity of damage to the median nerve resulting from a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW), such as carpal tunnel syndrome. Combines the presence and severity of the wrist lesion into a measure of how severely the median nerve is affected at that site.

R_LNLW_MED_PATHO.name: Median Nerve Pathophysiology from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_MED_PATHO.description: Intermediate node representing the pathophysiological character (e.g., demyelinating vs. axonal) of median nerve damage caused by a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW). Determines what kind of electrophysiological abnormalities are expected downstream.

R_LNLW_MEDD2_DISP_WD.name: MEDD2 Temporal Dispersion (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_MEDD2_DISP_WD.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the median nerve sensory response recorded from digit 2 (MEDD2) across the wrist–digit (WD) segment, attributable to a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW). Reflects how a focal demyelinating wrist lesion broadens the sensory action potential.

DIFFN_SEV.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Severity
DIFFN_SEV.description: Overall severity of a diffuse (generalized) peripheral neuropathy. Discrete states range from absent/very mild to very severe, summarizing the global degree of nerve damage independent of localization.

DIFFN_TYPE.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Type
DIFFN_TYPE.description: Pathophysiological type of diffuse peripheral neuropathy (e.g., demyelinating, axonal, or mixed). Determines which electrophysiological abnormalities (slowing, block, amplitude loss) are most prominent.

DIFFN_SENS_SEV.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Sensory Severity
DIFFN_SENS_SEV.description: Severity of sensory fiber involvement in a diffuse neuropathy. Captures how strongly sensory nerves are affected, which influences sensory nerve action potentials such as MEDD2.

DIFFN_DISTR.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Distribution
DIFFN_DISTR.description: Anatomical distribution of a diffuse neuropathy, typically distinguishing distal-predominant from proximal or generalized patterns. Influences which segments and muscles show the most severe abnormalities.

DIFFN_S_SEV_DIST.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Sensory Severity (Distal)
DIFFN_S_SEV_DIST.description: Effective severity of sensory fiber involvement at the distal end of the limb in a diffuse neuropathy. Combines overall sensory severity with the neuropathy's distribution to produce a localized sensory severity used downstream.

DIFFN_PATHO.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Pathophysiology
DIFFN_PATHO.description: Underlying pathophysiological mechanism of a diffuse neuropathy (demyelination, axonal degeneration, or mixed). Drives whether findings emphasize conduction slowing/block or amplitude reduction.

R_DIFFN_MEDD2_DISP.name: MEDD2 Temporal Dispersion from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_MEDD2_DISP.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the median digit-2 sensory response (MEDD2) caused by a diffuse neuropathy, particularly its demyelinating component. Aggregates the effect of generalized nerve disease on sensory waveform broadening.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_MEDD2_DISP_WD.name: MEDD2 Dispersion (Wrist–Digit) from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_MEDD2_DISP_WD.description: Intermediate node combining contributions from diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) and a local wrist lesion (LNLW) to temporal dispersion of the MEDD2 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment.

R_MEDD2_DISP_WD.name: MEDD2 Temporal Dispersion (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_DISP_WD.description: Observed temporal dispersion of the median digit-2 sensory nerve action potential measured across the wrist-to-digit (WD) recording segment. Increased dispersion suggests demyelinating pathology in that segment.

R_LNLBE_MEDD2_DISP_EW.name: MEDD2 Dispersion (Elbow–Wrist) from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_MEDD2_DISP_EW.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the MEDD2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment, caused by a local nerve lesion below the elbow (LNLBE).

R_MEDD2_DISP_EW.name: MEDD2 Temporal Dispersion (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MEDD2_DISP_EW.description: Observed temporal dispersion of the median digit-2 sensory response across the elbow-to-wrist (EW) segment. Reflects demyelinating lesions located proximal to the wrist.

R_MEDD2_DISP_EWD.name: MEDD2 Temporal Dispersion (Elbow–Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_DISP_EWD.description: Overall temporal dispersion of the median digit-2 sensory response across the full elbow-to-digit pathway (EWD). Integrates dispersion contributions from both the EW and WD segments.

R_DIFFN_MEDD2_BLOCK.name: MEDD2 Conduction Block from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_MEDD2_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing the degree of sensory conduction block in the median digit-2 pathway caused by a diffuse neuropathy. Reflects focal demyelinating effects in generalized disease.

R_LNLBE_MEDD2_BLOCK_EW.name: MEDD2 Conduction Block (Elbow–Wrist) from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_MEDD2_BLOCK_EW.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the MEDD2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment caused by a local nerve lesion below the elbow (LNLBE).

R_MEDD2_BLOCK_EW.name: MEDD2 Conduction Block (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MEDD2_BLOCK_EW.description: Observed sensory conduction block in the median digit-2 response across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment. Indicates focal demyelination proximal to the wrist.

R_MEDD2_AMPR_EW.name: MEDD2 Amplitude Reduction (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MEDD2_AMPR_EW.description: Observed amplitude reduction of the median digit-2 sensory response between elbow and wrist stimulation/recording sites. Combines effects of conduction block and temporal dispersion across the EW segment.

R_LNLBE_MEDD2_LD_EW.name: MEDD2 Distal Latency Contribution (Elbow–Wrist) from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_MEDD2_LD_EW.description: Intermediate node representing the latency-prolonging effect on the MEDD2 sensory response in the elbow–wrist (EW) segment due to a local nerve lesion below the elbow (LNLBE).

R_MEDD2_LD_EW.name: MEDD2 Distal Latency (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MEDD2_LD_EW.description: Distal latency of the median digit-2 sensory response measured for the elbow–wrist (EW) recording configuration. Prolongation indicates slowed conduction in that segment.

R_LNLBE_MEDD2_RD_EW.name: MEDD2 Proximal Latency Contribution (Elbow–Wrist) from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_MEDD2_RD_EW.description: Intermediate node representing the proximal (rostral) latency contribution to the MEDD2 sensory response in the elbow–wrist (EW) segment from a below-elbow lesion (LNLBE).

R_MEDD2_RD_EW.name: MEDD2 Proximal Latency (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MEDD2_RD_EW.description: Proximal latency component of the MEDD2 sensory response in the elbow–wrist (EW) configuration. Used together with distal latency to compute conduction velocity across the segment.

R_MEDD2_LSLOW_EW.name: MEDD2 Local Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MEDD2_LSLOW_EW.description: Local conduction slowing of the median digit-2 sensory fibers within the elbow–wrist (EW) segment. Indicates focal demyelinating pathology between elbow and wrist.

R_LNLW_MEDD2_SALOSS_WD.name: MEDD2 Sensory Axon Loss (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_MEDD2_SALOSS_WD.description: Intermediate node representing sensory axon loss affecting the MEDD2 response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment due to a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW).

R_DIFFN_MEDD2_SALOSS.name: MEDD2 Sensory Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_MEDD2_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing sensory axon loss affecting the median digit-2 response caused by a diffuse neuropathy (especially its axonal component).

R_DIFFN_LNLW_MEDD2_SALOSS.name: MEDD2 Sensory Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_MEDD2_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining sensory axon loss contributions to the MEDD2 response from both a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) and a local wrist lesion (LNLW).

R_LNLBE_MEDD2_SALOSS_EW.name: MEDD2 Sensory Axon Loss (Elbow–Wrist) from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_MEDD2_SALOSS_EW.description: Intermediate node representing sensory axon loss in the MEDD2 pathway across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment due to a below-elbow lesion (LNLBE).

R_MEDD2_SALOSS.name: MEDD2 Sensory Axon Loss
R_MEDD2_SALOSS.description: Overall sensory axon loss affecting the median digit-2 response, integrating contributions from focal lesions and diffuse neuropathy. Manifests primarily as reduced sensory response amplitude.

R_DIFFN_MEDD2_DIFSLOW.name: MEDD2 Diffuse Slowing from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_MEDD2_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse (length-uniform) slowing of the median digit-2 sensory fibers caused by a diffuse neuropathy. Reflects generalized demyelination or fiber loss.

R_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_EW.name: MEDD2 Diffuse Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_EW.description: Diffuse component of conduction slowing in the median digit-2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment. Distinguishes generalized slowing from focal local slowing.

R_MEDD2_DSLOW_EW.name: MEDD2 Distal Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MEDD2_DSLOW_EW.description: Distal-segment slowing component of the MEDD2 sensory response measured in the elbow–wrist (EW) configuration. Reflects pathology preferentially affecting the distal portion of the nerve.

R_MEDD2_ALLCV_EW.name: MEDD2 Total Conduction Velocity Effect (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MEDD2_ALLCV_EW.description: Combined effect of all slowing mechanisms (local, diffuse, distal) on conduction velocity of the MEDD2 sensory response in the elbow–wrist (EW) segment, before observation.

R_MEDD2_CV_EW.name: MEDD2 Conduction Velocity (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MEDD2_CV_EW.description: Observed sensory conduction velocity of the median digit-2 fibers in the elbow–wrist (EW) segment. Reduced values indicate demyelinating or mixed pathology in that segment.

R_LNLW_MEDD2_BLOCK_WD.name: MEDD2 Conduction Block (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_MEDD2_BLOCK_WD.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the MEDD2 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment caused by a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW).

R_MEDD2_BLOCK_WD.name: MEDD2 Conduction Block (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_BLOCK_WD.description: Observed sensory conduction block in the median digit-2 response across the wrist-to-digit (WD) segment. A typical finding in carpal tunnel syndrome and other wrist-level lesions.

R_MEDD2_EFFAXLOSS.name: MEDD2 Effective Axon Loss
R_MEDD2_EFFAXLOSS.description: Effective sensory axon loss for the median digit-2 response, combining true axon loss with the functional axon-loss equivalent produced by conduction block. Drives the observed amplitude.

R_MEDD2_ALLAMP_WD.name: MEDD2 Total Amplitude Effect (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_ALLAMP_WD.description: Aggregated effect of all amplitude-reducing mechanisms (block, dispersion, axon loss) on the MEDD2 sensory response amplitude in the wrist–digit (WD) recording configuration.

R_MEDD2_AMP_WD.name: MEDD2 Amplitude (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_AMP_WD.description: Observed amplitude of the median digit-2 sensory response recorded in the wrist–digit (WD) configuration. Reduced values indicate axon loss or significant block/dispersion.

R_LNLW_MEDD2_LD_WD.name: MEDD2 Distal Latency Contribution (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_MEDD2_LD_WD.description: Intermediate node representing the prolonging contribution of a local wrist lesion (LNLW) to the distal latency of the MEDD2 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment.

R_MEDD2_LD_WD.name: MEDD2 Distal Latency (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_LD_WD.description: Distal latency of the median digit-2 sensory response in the wrist–digit (WD) recording configuration. Prolongation indicates focal slowing at or distal to the wrist.

R_LNLW_MEDD2_RD_WD.name: MEDD2 Proximal Latency Contribution (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_MEDD2_RD_WD.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a local wrist lesion (LNLW) to the proximal latency component of the MEDD2 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment.

R_MEDD2_RD_WD.name: MEDD2 Proximal Latency (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_RD_WD.description: Proximal latency component of the MEDD2 sensory response in the wrist–digit (WD) configuration. Used with distal latency to derive segmental conduction velocity.

R_MEDD2_LSLOW_WD.name: MEDD2 Local Slowing (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_LSLOW_WD.description: Local (focal) conduction slowing of the median digit-2 sensory fibers within the wrist–digit (WD) segment. Characteristic of carpal tunnel-type lesions.

R_LNLBE_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_WD.name: MEDD2 Diffuse Slowing (Wrist–Digit) from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_WD.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse slowing of the MEDD2 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment attributable to retrograde effects of a below-elbow lesion (LNLBE).

R_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_WD.name: MEDD2 Diffuse Slowing (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_WD.description: Diffuse component of conduction slowing in the median digit-2 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment, distinct from focal slowing localized at the wrist.

R_MEDD2_DSLOW_WD.name: MEDD2 Distal Slowing (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_DSLOW_WD.description: Distal-segment slowing of the median digit-2 sensory response in the wrist–digit (WD) configuration. Reflects pathology specifically affecting distal sensory fibers.

R_MEDD2_ALLCV_WD.name: MEDD2 Total Conduction Velocity Effect (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_ALLCV_WD.description: Combined effect of local, diffuse, and distal slowing mechanisms on the conduction velocity of the MEDD2 sensory response in the wrist–digit (WD) segment, before observation.

R_MEDD2_CV_WD.name: MEDD2 Conduction Velocity (Wrist–Digit)
R_MEDD2_CV_WD.description: Observed sensory conduction velocity of the median digit-2 fibers across the wrist–digit (WD) segment. Slowed values are typical of carpal tunnel syndrome and other distal median lesions.

DIFFN_MOT_SEV.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Motor Severity
DIFFN_MOT_SEV.description: Severity of motor fiber involvement in a diffuse peripheral neuropathy. Determines how strongly motor responses (e.g., from APB) and motor conduction parameters are affected.

DIFFN_M_SEV_DIST.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Motor Severity (Distal)
DIFFN_M_SEV_DIST.description: Effective severity of motor fiber involvement at the distal end of the limb in a diffuse neuropathy. Combines overall motor severity with the neuropathy's distribution to localize impact on distal muscles like APB.

R_DIFFN_MED_BLOCK.name: Median Motor Conduction Block from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_MED_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing motor conduction block of the median nerve caused by a diffuse neuropathy with demyelinating features.

R_LNLBE_MED_BLOCK.name: Median Motor Conduction Block from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_MED_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing motor conduction block of the median nerve caused by a focal nerve lesion below the elbow (LNLBE).

R_MED_BLOCK_EW.name: Median Motor Conduction Block (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MED_BLOCK_EW.description: Observed motor conduction block of the median nerve across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment, indicating focal demyelinating pathology in that region.

R_MED_AMPR_EW.name: Median Motor Amplitude Reduction (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MED_AMPR_EW.description: Reduction of the median nerve compound motor action potential amplitude when stimulating at the elbow versus the wrist. Reflects conduction block and temporal dispersion in the EW segment.

R_LNLT1_APB_MALOSS.name: APB Motor Axon Loss from T1 Root Lesion
R_LNLT1_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in the abductor pollicis brevis (APB) muscle resulting from a lesion of the T1 nerve root (LNLT1).

R_LNLLP_APB_MALOSS.name: APB Motor Axon Loss from Lower Plexus Lesion
R_LNLLP_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in the APB muscle caused by a lesion of the lower brachial plexus (LNLLP).

R_LNLT1_LP_APB_MALOSS.name: APB Motor Axon Loss from T1 Root and Lower Plexus Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining motor axon loss in APB caused by T1 root (LNLT1) and lower plexus (LNLLP) lesions, both of which contribute fibers to median-innervated APB.

R_LNLBE_APB_MALOSS.name: APB Motor Axon Loss from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in APB resulting from a local median nerve lesion below the elbow (LNLBE).

R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MALOSS.name: APB Motor Axon Loss from T1, Lower Plexus, and Below-Elbow Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node aggregating motor axon loss in APB from focal lesions at the T1 root, lower brachial plexus, and below the elbow.

R_LNLW_APB_MALOSS.name: APB Motor Axon Loss from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in APB caused by a local median nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW), such as severe carpal tunnel syndrome.

R_DIFFN_APB_MALOSS.name: APB Motor Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in APB caused by a diffuse neuropathy (axonal or mixed). Reflects generalized motor fiber loss reaching the distal hand muscles.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MALOSS.name: APB Motor Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining motor axon loss in APB from diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion.

R_APB_MALOSS.name: APB Motor Axon Loss
R_APB_MALOSS.description: Overall motor axon loss in the abductor pollicis brevis muscle, integrating contributions from focal nerve lesions (root, plexus, elbow, wrist) and diffuse neuropathy. Drives motor amplitude and EMG findings.

R_DIFFN_MED_DIFSLOW.name: Median Motor Diffuse Slowing from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_MED_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse slowing of motor conduction in the median nerve caused by a diffuse neuropathy. Captures generalized rather than focal slowing.

R_MED_DIFSLOW_EW.name: Median Motor Diffuse Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MED_DIFSLOW_EW.description: Diffuse component of motor conduction slowing in the median nerve across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment. Distinguishes generalized neuropathic slowing from focal lesion-induced slowing.

R_MED_DCV_EW.name: Median Motor Distal Conduction Velocity Effect (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MED_DCV_EW.description: Distal slowing component contributing to median motor conduction velocity in the elbow–wrist (EW) segment. Reflects pathology in the more distal portion of the segment.

R_MED_LD_EW.name: Median Motor Distal Latency (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MED_LD_EW.description: Distal motor latency of the median nerve when stimulating at the wrist for the EW measurement. Prolongation suggests slowing of distal motor fibers.

R_MED_RD_EW.name: Median Motor Proximal Latency (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MED_RD_EW.description: Proximal motor latency of the median nerve when stimulating at the elbow. Combined with distal latency to compute motor conduction velocity in the elbow–wrist segment.

R_MED_RDLDCV_EW.name: Median Motor Latency-Difference Conduction Velocity (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MED_RDLDCV_EW.description: Conduction velocity in the median nerve elbow–wrist (EW) segment derived from the difference between proximal and distal motor latencies, before incorporation of additional slowing effects.

R_MED_ALLCV_EW.name: Median Motor Total Conduction Velocity Effect (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MED_ALLCV_EW.description: Combined effect of focal, diffuse, and distal slowing mechanisms on the median motor conduction velocity in the elbow–wrist segment, prior to observation.

R_MED_CV_EW.name: Median Motor Conduction Velocity (Elbow–Wrist)
R_MED_CV_EW.description: Observed motor conduction velocity of the median nerve across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment. Slowing indicates demyelinating or mixed pathology in that region.

R_LNLT1_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB Denervation/Reinnervation from T1 Root Lesion
R_LNLT1_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the degree of denervation and subsequent reinnervation activity in APB muscle EMG caused by a lesion of the T1 nerve root.

R_LNLLP_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB Denervation/Reinnervation from Lower Plexus Lesion
R_LNLLP_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing denervation and reinnervation findings in APB EMG caused by a lower brachial plexus lesion.

R_LNLT1_LP_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB Denervation/Reinnervation from T1 and Lower Plexus Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining denervation/reinnervation contributions in APB EMG from both a T1 root lesion and a lower plexus lesion.

R_LNLBE_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB Denervation/Reinnervation from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing denervation and reinnervation findings in APB EMG caused by a median nerve lesion below the elbow.

R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB Denervation/Reinnervation from T1, Lower Plexus, and Below-Elbow Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node aggregating denervation/reinnervation effects in APB EMG from focal lesions at the T1 root, lower plexus, and below the elbow.

DIFFN_TIME.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Duration
DIFFN_TIME.description: Time elapsed since the onset of a diffuse neuropathy. Influences whether reinnervation has had time to develop and thus the EMG appearance of denervation versus chronic neurogenic changes.

R_DIFFN_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB Denervation/Reinnervation from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing denervation and reinnervation findings in APB EMG caused by a diffuse neuropathy of given severity, type, and duration.

R_LNLW_MED_TIME.name: Median Wrist Lesion Duration
R_LNLW_MED_TIME.description: Time elapsed since the onset of a local median nerve lesion at the wrist. Determines whether sufficient time has passed for denervation and reinnervation to manifest in distal muscles like APB.

R_LNLW_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB Denervation/Reinnervation from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing denervation and reinnervation findings in APB EMG caused by a local median nerve lesion at the wrist, modulated by the lesion's duration.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB Denervation/Reinnervation from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining denervation/reinnervation contributions in APB EMG from a diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion.

R_LNL_DIFFN_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB Denervation/Reinnervation from All Local and Diffuse Neuropathic Causes
R_LNL_DIFFN_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node aggregating all neurogenic contributions (focal lesions at root, plexus, elbow, wrist plus diffuse neuropathy) to APB EMG denervation and reinnervation findings.

R_MYOP_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB EMG Changes from Myopathy
R_MYOP_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a myopathy to EMG findings in APB that resemble or modify denervation/reinnervation patterns. Myopathies can produce small, polyphasic potentials that interact with neurogenic findings.

R_MYDY_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB EMG Changes from Muscular Dystrophy
R_MYDY_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a muscular dystrophy to EMG findings in APB that overlap with denervation/reinnervation patterns.

R_MYOP_MYDY_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB EMG Changes from Myopathy and Muscular Dystrophy
R_MYOP_MYDY_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of myopathy and muscular dystrophy to APB EMG findings that interact with denervation/reinnervation observations.

R_APB_DE_REGEN.name: APB Denervation/Reinnervation
R_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Overall degree of denervation and reinnervation activity observed in APB EMG, integrating contributions from focal nerve lesions, diffuse neuropathy, myopathy, and muscular dystrophy.

R_DE_REGEN_APB_NMT.name: APB Neuromuscular Transmission Effect from Denervation/Reinnervation
R_DE_REGEN_APB_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the impact of denervation and reinnervation processes on apparent neuromuscular transmission in APB. Newly reinnervated endplates can produce transmission instability resembling NMJ disease.

R_MYAS_APB_NMT.name: APB Neuromuscular Transmission Effect from Myasthenia
R_MYAS_APB_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the impact of myasthenia gravis (or other neuromuscular junction disorders) on neuromuscular transmission as measured at APB.

R_APB_NMT.name: APB Neuromuscular Transmission
R_APB_NMT.description: Observed neuromuscular transmission status at APB (e.g., from repetitive stimulation or single-fiber EMG jitter), reflecting combined effects of NMJ disease and reinnervation-related instability.

R_MYDY_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from Muscular Dystrophy
R_MYDY_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of muscular dystrophy on motor unit potential size in APB EMG. Dystrophic muscle typically yields small, short-duration motor units.

R_MYOP_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from Myopathy
R_MYOP_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of myopathy on motor unit potential size in APB EMG, generally producing small, polyphasic motor units.

R_MYOP_MYDY_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from Myopathy and Muscular Dystrophy
R_MYOP_MYDY_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of myopathy and muscular dystrophy on motor unit potential size in APB EMG.

R_LNLW_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the change in APB motor unit potential size resulting from chronic reinnervation following a local median nerve lesion at the wrist. Chronic neurogenic disease typically enlarges motor unit potentials.

R_DIFFN_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the change in APB motor unit potential size due to chronic reinnervation in a diffuse neuropathy.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion on APB motor unit potential size.

R_LNLBE_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the change in APB motor unit potential size due to chronic reinnervation following a median nerve lesion below the elbow.

R_LNLLP_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from Lower Plexus Lesion
R_LNLLP_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the change in APB motor unit potential size due to chronic reinnervation following a lower brachial plexus lesion.

R_LNLT1_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from T1 Root Lesion
R_LNLT1_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the change in APB motor unit potential size due to chronic reinnervation following a lesion of the T1 nerve root.

R_LNLT1_LP_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from T1 Root and Lower Plexus Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of T1 root and lower brachial plexus lesions on APB motor unit potential size through chronic reinnervation.

R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from T1, Lower Plexus, and Below-Elbow Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node aggregating the effects on APB motor unit potential size from chronic reinnervation following focal lesions at the T1 nerve root, lower brachial plexus, and below the elbow.

R_LNL_DIFFN_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size Effect from All Neuropathic Causes
R_LNL_DIFFN_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining all focal nerve lesion (root, plexus, elbow, wrist) and diffuse neuropathy contributions to APB motor unit potential size through chronic reinnervation.

R_APB_MUSIZE.name: APB Motor Unit Size
R_APB_MUSIZE.description: Overall size of motor unit potentials in the abductor pollicis brevis muscle, integrating neurogenic enlargement (from reinnervation) and myopathic reduction. Determines whether MUPs appear large/long or small/short.

R_APB_EFFMUS.name: APB Effective Muscle Mass
R_APB_EFFMUS.description: Effective amount of contractile muscle tissue in APB capable of generating an electrical response, accounting for both motor unit number and per-unit functional muscle. Drives observed CMAP amplitude and force.

R_LNLW_MED_BLOCK.name: Median Motor Conduction Block from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_MED_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing motor conduction block of the median nerve at the wrist due to a local lesion (LNLW), such as severe carpal tunnel syndrome with demyelinating features.

R_MED_BLOCK_WA.name: Median Motor Conduction Block (Wrist–APB)
R_MED_BLOCK_WA.description: Conduction block affecting the median motor response in the wrist-to-APB (WA) segment. Reflects focal demyelinating pathology between the wrist stimulation site and APB.

R_APB_MULOSS.name: APB Motor Unit Loss
R_APB_MULOSS.description: Loss of functional motor units innervating APB, derived from motor axon loss and effective conduction block. Drives reductions in CMAP amplitude and overall muscle response.

R_APB_ALLAMP_WA.name: APB Total Amplitude Effect (Wrist–APB)
R_APB_ALLAMP_WA.description: Aggregated effect of motor unit loss, conduction block, dispersion, and effective muscle mass on the APB compound motor action potential amplitude in the wrist–APB (WA) configuration.

R_MED_AMP_WA.name: Median CMAP Amplitude (Wrist–APB)
R_MED_AMP_WA.description: Observed amplitude of the compound motor action potential recorded from APB when stimulating the median nerve at the wrist. Reduced amplitudes indicate axon loss, conduction block, or muscle disease.

R_MED_LD_WA.name: Median Distal Motor Latency (Wrist–APB)
R_MED_LD_WA.description: Observed distal motor latency from wrist stimulation to APB recording. Prolongation suggests demyelinating slowing in the distal median nerve segment, classically seen in carpal tunnel syndrome.

R_MED_RD_WA.name: Median Reference Latency (Wrist–APB)
R_MED_RD_WA.description: Reference latency component used in computing the median motor delay for the wrist–APB (WA) segment, against which observed latency is compared.

R_MED_RDLDDEL.name: Median Latency Delay (Wrist–APB)
R_MED_RDLDDEL.description: Latency delay derived from comparing observed and reference distal latencies for the median motor wrist–APB measurement, before incorporating diffuse and distal slowing effects.

R_LNLBE_MED_DIFSLOW.name: Median Diffuse Slowing from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_MED_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse slowing of median motor conduction attributable to retrograde or extended effects of a focal nerve lesion below the elbow.

R_MED_DIFSLOW_WA.name: Median Motor Diffuse Slowing (Wrist–APB)
R_MED_DIFSLOW_WA.description: Diffuse component of conduction slowing in the median motor fibers across the wrist–APB (WA) segment, distinct from focal slowing localized at the wrist.

R_MED_DCV_WA.name: Median Distal Conduction Velocity Effect (Wrist–APB)
R_MED_DCV_WA.description: Distal slowing component contributing to conduction velocity in the median motor wrist–APB (WA) segment. Reflects pathology preferentially affecting distal motor fibers.

R_MED_ALLDEL_WA.name: Median Total Latency Delay (Wrist–APB)
R_MED_ALLDEL_WA.description: Combined effect of focal block, diffuse slowing, and distal slowing on median motor latency in the wrist–APB (WA) segment, before observation.

R_MED_LAT_WA.name: Median Motor Latency (Wrist–APB)
R_MED_LAT_WA.description: Observed motor latency of the median nerve from wrist stimulation to APB recording. A key parameter in diagnosing carpal tunnel syndrome and other distal median lesions.

R_APB_VOL_ACT.name: APB Voluntary Activity
R_APB_VOL_ACT.description: Quality and pattern of voluntary motor unit activation in APB during EMG examination. Reduced or altered activation suggests neurogenic or central involvement.

R_APB_FORCE.name: APB Force
R_APB_FORCE.description: Voluntary muscle force generated by APB during clinical examination. Reduced force can indicate neurogenic, myopathic, or NMJ disease as well as effort-related factors.

R_APB_MUSCLE_VOL.name: APB Muscle Volume
R_APB_MUSCLE_VOL.description: Physical bulk/volume of the APB muscle. Atrophy reduces volume in chronic neurogenic disease, while hypertrophy or pseudohypertrophy can occur in some myopathies.

R_APB_MVA_RECRUIT.name: APB Maximal Voluntary Activity Recruitment
R_APB_MVA_RECRUIT.description: Recruitment pattern of motor units in APB during maximal voluntary contraction. Reduced (discrete) recruitment indicates neurogenic disease; early (full) recruitment with low force suggests myopathy.

R_APB_MVA_AMP.name: APB Maximal Voluntary Activity Amplitude
R_APB_MVA_AMP.description: Amplitude of the interference pattern in APB at maximal voluntary contraction. Influenced by motor unit size, density, and the number of recruited units.

R_APB_TA_CONCL.name: APB Turns/Amplitude Analysis Conclusion
R_APB_TA_CONCL.description: Diagnostic conclusion derived from turns/amplitude (interference pattern) analysis of APB EMG, classifying the pattern as normal, neurogenic, or myopathic.

R_APB_MUPAMP.name: APB Motor Unit Potential Amplitude
R_APB_MUPAMP.description: Underlying amplitude of individual motor unit potentials recorded from APB. Increased in chronic neurogenic disease (after reinnervation) and decreased in myopathies.

R_APB_QUAN_MUPAMP.name: APB Quantitative MUP Amplitude
R_APB_QUAN_MUPAMP.description: Observed quantitative measurement of APB motor unit potential amplitude obtained through automated or template-based MUP analysis.

R_APB_QUAL_MUPAMP.name: APB Qualitative MUP Amplitude
R_APB_QUAL_MUPAMP.description: Subjective qualitative assessment of APB motor unit potential amplitude by the examining electromyographer (e.g., 'large', 'small', 'normal').

R_APB_MUPDUR.name: APB Motor Unit Potential Duration
R_APB_MUPDUR.description: Underlying duration of individual motor unit potentials in APB. Prolonged duration indicates chronic neurogenic disease; shortened duration suggests myopathy.

R_APB_QUAN_MUPDUR.name: APB Quantitative MUP Duration
R_APB_QUAN_MUPDUR.description: Observed quantitative measurement of APB motor unit potential duration obtained through MUP analysis software.

R_APB_QUAL_MUPDUR.name: APB Qualitative MUP Duration
R_APB_QUAL_MUPDUR.description: Subjective qualitative assessment of APB motor unit potential duration by the examining electromyographer.

R_APB_QUAN_MUPPOLY.name: APB Quantitative MUP Polyphasia
R_APB_QUAN_MUPPOLY.description: Quantitative measure of polyphasic (multi-phase) motor unit potentials in APB. Increased polyphasia reflects loss of fiber synchrony from reinnervation or myopathy.

R_APB_QUAL_MUPPOLY.name: APB Qualitative MUP Polyphasia
R_APB_QUAL_MUPPOLY.description: Subjective qualitative assessment of polyphasic motor unit potentials in APB during routine EMG examination.

R_APB_MUPSATEL.name: APB MUP Satellite Potentials
R_APB_MUPSATEL.description: Presence of satellite (late) potentials linked to APB motor unit potentials. Indicative of immature reinnervation with slowly conducting axonal sprouts.

R_APB_MUPINSTAB.name: APB MUP Instability
R_APB_MUPINSTAB.description: Variability in shape/amplitude of APB motor unit potentials during sustained discharge. Indicates unstable neuromuscular transmission, often from immature reinnervation or NMJ disease.

R_APB_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.name: APB Repetitive Stimulation CMAP Amplitude
R_APB_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.description: Baseline CMAP amplitude of APB during repetitive nerve stimulation testing, before considering decrement, facilitation, or post-activation effects.

R_APB_REPSTIM_DECR.name: APB Repetitive Stimulation Decrement
R_APB_REPSTIM_DECR.description: Decrement in CMAP amplitude observed during low-frequency repetitive stimulation of the median nerve recording at APB. A pathognomonic finding in postsynaptic NMJ disorders such as myasthenia gravis.

R_APB_REPSTIM_FACILI.name: APB Repetitive Stimulation Facilitation
R_APB_REPSTIM_FACILI.description: Post-tetanic or high-frequency facilitation of APB CMAP amplitude during repetitive stimulation. Marked facilitation suggests presynaptic NMJ disorders such as Lambert–Eaton syndrome.

R_APB_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.name: APB Post-Activation Repetitive Stimulation Decrement
R_APB_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.description: Worsening of CMAP decrement at APB following sustained activation. Characteristic finding in postsynaptic NMJ disorders, reflecting post-activation exhaustion.

R_APB_SF_JITTER.name: APB Single-Fiber EMG Jitter
R_APB_SF_JITTER.description: Jitter (variability of inter-potential interval) observed in single-fiber EMG of APB. Increased jitter is the most sensitive sign of impaired neuromuscular transmission.

R_LNLT1_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from T1 Root Lesion
R_LNLT1_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a T1 nerve root lesion on motor unit fiber density in APB, primarily through reinnervation increasing fibers per motor unit.

R_LNLLP_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from Lower Plexus Lesion
R_LNLLP_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a lower brachial plexus lesion on APB motor unit fiber density via reinnervation.

R_LNLT1_LP_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from T1 Root and Lower Plexus Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of T1 root and lower plexus lesions to APB motor unit fiber density.

R_LNLBE_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a median nerve lesion below the elbow on APB motor unit fiber density.

R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from T1, Lower Plexus, and Below-Elbow Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions to APB motor unit density from focal lesions at the T1 root, lower plexus, and below the elbow.

R_DIFFN_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a diffuse neuropathy on APB motor unit fiber density via chronic reinnervation.

R_LNLW_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a local median nerve lesion at the wrist on APB motor unit fiber density.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions to APB motor unit fiber density from diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion.

R_LNL_DIFFN_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from All Neuropathic Causes
R_LNL_DIFFN_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating all focal nerve lesion and diffuse neuropathy contributions to APB motor unit fiber density via reinnervation.

R_MYOP_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from Myopathy
R_MYOP_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of myopathy on APB motor unit fiber density. Myopathies can produce locally increased fiber density in regenerating fascicles.

R_MYDY_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from Muscular Dystrophy
R_MYDY_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of muscular dystrophy on APB motor unit fiber density, often elevated due to fiber regeneration and grouping.

R_MYOP_MYDY_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from Myopathy and Muscular Dystrophy
R_MYOP_MYDY_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of myopathy and muscular dystrophy to APB motor unit fiber density.

R_MYAS_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from Myasthenia
R_MYAS_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of myasthenia gravis on APB motor unit fiber density. Generally minimal direct effect, but transmission failure can mimic density changes.

R_MUSCLE_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Density Effect from Muscle/NMJ Disorders
R_MUSCLE_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions to APB motor unit fiber density from primary muscle disorders (myopathy, dystrophy) and neuromuscular junction disease.

R_APB_MUDENS.name: APB Motor Unit Fiber Density
R_APB_MUDENS.description: Overall motor unit fiber density in APB, integrating neurogenic and myopathic contributions. Increased density indicates clustering of fibers from the same motor unit, typical of reinnervation.

R_APB_SF_DENSITY.name: APB Single-Fiber EMG Fiber Density
R_APB_SF_DENSITY.description: Fiber density measured by single-fiber EMG in APB. Increased values indicate fiber grouping from reinnervation; this is a sensitive marker of chronic neurogenic disease.

R_LNLT1_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: APB Neuropathic Activity from T1 Root Lesion
R_LNLT1_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neuropathic-type spontaneous activity (e.g., complex repetitive discharges, neurogenic recruitment effects) in APB caused by a T1 root lesion.

R_LNLLP_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: APB Neuropathic Activity from Lower Plexus Lesion
R_LNLLP_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neuropathic spontaneous activity in APB caused by a lower brachial plexus lesion.

R_LNLT1_LP_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: APB Neuropathic Activity from T1 Root and Lower Plexus Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of T1 root and lower plexus lesions to neuropathic spontaneous activity in APB.

R_LNLBE_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: APB Neuropathic Activity from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neuropathic spontaneous activity in APB caused by a median nerve lesion below the elbow.

R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: APB Neuropathic Activity from T1, Lower Plexus, and Below-Elbow Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions to APB neuropathic spontaneous activity from focal lesions at the T1 root, lower plexus, and below the elbow.

R_DIFFN_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: APB Neuropathic Activity from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neuropathic spontaneous activity in APB caused by a diffuse neuropathy reaching the distal hand muscles.

R_LNLW_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: APB Neuropathic Activity from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neuropathic spontaneous activity in APB caused by a local median nerve lesion at the wrist.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: APB Neuropathic Activity from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node combining contributions to APB neuropathic spontaneous activity from diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion.

R_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: APB Neuropathic Activity
R_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Overall neuropathic-type abnormal spontaneous activity in APB EMG, integrating contributions from focal nerve lesions and diffuse neuropathy.

R_APB_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.name: APB Spontaneous Neuropathic Discharges
R_APB_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.description: Observed spontaneous neuropathic discharges in APB EMG (e.g., complex repetitive discharges, neuromyotonic or fasciculation discharges) reflecting chronic neurogenic disease.

R_MYOP_APB_DENERV.name: APB Apparent Denervation from Myopathy
R_MYOP_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myopathy to apparent denervation findings in APB. Some myopathies (notably inflammatory) can produce fibrillations and positive sharp waves mimicking denervation.

R_MYDY_APB_DENERV.name: APB Apparent Denervation from Muscular Dystrophy
R_MYDY_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of muscular dystrophy to apparent denervation findings in APB EMG.

R_MYOP_MYDY_APB_DENERV.name: APB Apparent Denervation from Myopathy and Muscular Dystrophy
R_MYOP_MYDY_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of myopathy and muscular dystrophy to apparent denervation findings in APB EMG.

R_NMT_APB_DENERV.name: APB Apparent Denervation from NMJ Disease
R_NMT_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of neuromuscular transmission disorders to apparent denervation findings in APB. Severe NMJ disease can produce functional denervation effects.

R_MUSCLE_APB_DENERV.name: APB Apparent Denervation from Muscle/NMJ Disorders
R_MUSCLE_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating apparent denervation contributions from myopathy, muscular dystrophy, and neuromuscular junction disease in APB.

R_LNLT1_APB_DENERV.name: APB Denervation from T1 Root Lesion
R_LNLT1_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing acute denervation findings (fibrillations, positive sharp waves) in APB caused by a T1 nerve root lesion.

R_LNLLP_APB_DENERV.name: APB Denervation from Lower Plexus Lesion
R_LNLLP_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing acute denervation findings in APB caused by a lower brachial plexus lesion.

R_LNLT1_LP_APB_DENERV.name: APB Denervation from T1 Root and Lower Plexus Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of T1 root and lower plexus lesions to denervation findings in APB.

R_LNLBE_APB_DENERV.name: APB Denervation from Below-Elbow Lesion
R_LNLBE_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing acute denervation findings in APB caused by a median nerve lesion below the elbow.

R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_DENERV.name: APB Denervation from T1, Lower Plexus, and Below-Elbow Lesions
R_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions to APB denervation from focal lesions at the T1 root, lower plexus, and below the elbow.

R_DIFFN_APB_DENERV.name: APB Denervation from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing acute denervation findings in APB caused by a diffuse neuropathy with active axonal degeneration.

R_LNLW_APB_DENERV.name: APB Denervation from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing acute denervation findings in APB caused by a local median nerve lesion at the wrist.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_DENERV.name: APB Denervation from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining contributions to APB denervation from diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion.

R_LNL_DIFFN_APB_DENERV.name: APB Denervation from All Neuropathic Causes
R_LNL_DIFFN_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating all focal nerve lesion and diffuse neuropathy contributions to acute denervation findings in APB.

R_APB_DENERV.name: APB Denervation
R_APB_DENERV.description: Overall degree of acute denervation in APB, integrating neurogenic causes and apparent denervation produced by muscle and NMJ disorders. Drives observed spontaneous activity such as fibrillations.

R_APB_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.name: APB Spontaneous Denervation Activity
R_APB_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.description: Observed spontaneous denervation activity in APB EMG, including fibrillation potentials and positive sharp waves indicating ongoing or recent muscle fiber denervation.

R_APB_SPONT_HF_DISCH.name: APB Spontaneous High-Frequency Discharges
R_APB_SPONT_HF_DISCH.description: Observed spontaneous high-frequency discharges in APB EMG, including complex repetitive discharges and myotonic discharges, indicating chronic neurogenic or myopathic processes.

R_APB_SPONT_INS_ACT.name: APB Spontaneous and Insertional Activity
R_APB_SPONT_INS_ACT.description: Observed spontaneous and insertional activity in APB EMG. Increased insertional activity can be an early sign of denervation or membrane instability.

DIFFN_M_SEV_PROX.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Motor Severity (Proximal)
DIFFN_M_SEV_PROX.description: Effective severity of motor fiber involvement at the proximal end of the limb in a diffuse neuropathy. Combined with overall motor severity and distribution to localize impact on proximal nerve segments.

DIFFN_DUMMY_1.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Auxiliary Variable 1
DIFFN_DUMMY_1.description: Auxiliary (dummy) node used in the network's structural representation of diffuse neuropathy. Such nodes typically exist to factor large conditional probability tables into smaller, computationally tractable pieces rather than to model a meaningful clinical quantity.

DIFFN_DUMMY_2.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Auxiliary Variable 2
DIFFN_DUMMY_2.description: Auxiliary (dummy) node used in the network's structural representation of diffuse neuropathy. Used to decompose joint distributions for tractable inference rather than to represent a clinical concept.

DIFFN_DUMMY_3.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Auxiliary Variable 3
DIFFN_DUMMY_3.description: Auxiliary (dummy) node used in the network's structural representation of diffuse neuropathy. Helps decompose conditional probability tables into manageable factors.

R_OTHER_ULND5_DISP.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion from Other Causes
R_OTHER_ULND5_DISP.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the ulnar sensory response from digit 5 (ULND5) caused by factors other than the explicitly modeled local lesions and diffuse neuropathy.

R_DIFFN_ULND5_DISP.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_ULND5_DISP.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the ULND5 sensory response caused by diffuse neuropathy with demyelinating features.

R_LNLE_ULN_SEV.name: Ulnar Nerve Severity from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ULN_SEV.description: Intermediate node representing the severity of damage to the ulnar nerve resulting from a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE), such as cubital tunnel syndrome.

R_LNLE_ULN_PATHO.name: Ulnar Nerve Pathophysiology from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ULN_PATHO.description: Intermediate node representing the pathophysiological character (demyelinating vs. axonal) of ulnar nerve damage caused by a local nerve lesion at the elbow.

R_LNLE_ULND5_DISP_E.name: ULND5 Dispersion (Elbow) from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ULND5_DISP_E.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the ULND5 sensory response across the elbow segment caused by a local ulnar nerve lesion at the elbow.

R_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_DISP_E.name: ULND5 Dispersion (Elbow) from Elbow Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy
R_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_DISP_E.description: Intermediate node combining contributions to ULND5 temporal dispersion in the elbow segment from an elbow lesion and a diffuse neuropathy.

R_ULND5_DISP_E.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion (Elbow Segment)
R_ULND5_DISP_E.description: Temporal dispersion of the ulnar digit-5 sensory response across the elbow segment. Increased dispersion indicates demyelinating pathology around the elbow, classic for ulnar neuropathy at the elbow.

R_LNLW_ULND5_DISP_WD.name: ULND5 Dispersion (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_ULND5_DISP_WD.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the ULND5 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment caused by a local ulnar nerve lesion at the wrist.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_ULND5_DISP_WD.name: ULND5 Dispersion (Wrist–Digit) from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_ULND5_DISP_WD.description: Intermediate node combining contributions to ULND5 temporal dispersion in the wrist–digit (WD) segment from diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion.

R_ULND5_DISP_WD.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_DISP_WD.description: Temporal dispersion of the ulnar digit-5 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment. Reflects demyelinating pathology in the distal ulnar sensory pathway.

R_ULND5_DISP_BEW.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion (Below-Elbow to Wrist)
R_ULND5_DISP_BEW.description: Temporal dispersion of the ULND5 sensory response across the below-elbow to wrist (BEW) segment. Helps localize demyelinating pathology in the forearm portion of the ulnar nerve.

R_ULND5_DISP_BED.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion (Below-Elbow to Digit)
R_ULND5_DISP_BED.description: Combined temporal dispersion of the ULND5 sensory response across the below-elbow to digit (BED) pathway. Integrates dispersion contributions from the BEW and WD segments.

R_ULND5_DISP_EED.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion (Entire Elbow to Digit)
R_ULND5_DISP_EED.description: Overall temporal dispersion of the ulnar digit-5 sensory response across the full elbow-to-digit (EED) pathway. Integrates dispersion across all proximal and distal ulnar segments.

R_OTHER_ULND5_BLOCK.name: ULND5 Conduction Block from Other Causes
R_OTHER_ULND5_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing sensory conduction block in the ULND5 pathway caused by factors other than the explicitly modeled focal lesions and diffuse neuropathy.

R_DIFFN_ULND5_BLOCK.name: ULND5 Conduction Block from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_ULND5_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing sensory conduction block in the ulnar digit-5 (ULND5) pathway caused by a diffuse neuropathy with demyelinating features.

R_LNLE_ULND5_BLOCK_E.name: ULND5 Conduction Block (Elbow Segment) from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ULND5_BLOCK_E.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the ULND5 sensory response across the elbow (E) segment caused by a local ulnar nerve lesion at the elbow.

R_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_BLOCK_E.name: ULND5 Conduction Block (Elbow) from Elbow Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy
R_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_BLOCK_E.description: Intermediate node combining contributions to ULND5 conduction block in the elbow segment from an elbow lesion (LNLE) and a diffuse neuropathy.

R_ULND5_BLOCK_E.name: ULND5 Conduction Block (Elbow Segment)
R_ULND5_BLOCK_E.description: Sensory conduction block in the ulnar digit-5 response across the elbow (E) segment. A characteristic finding in ulnar neuropathy at the elbow.

R_ULND5_AMPR_E.name: ULND5 Amplitude Reduction (Elbow Segment)
R_ULND5_AMPR_E.description: Reduction in amplitude of the ULND5 sensory response when comparing elbow-segment recordings. Combines effects of conduction block and temporal dispersion across the elbow.

R_OTHER_ULND5_LD.name: ULND5 Distal Latency Contribution from Other Causes
R_OTHER_ULND5_LD.description: Intermediate node representing contributions to the distal latency of the ULND5 sensory response from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions.

R_LNLE_ULND5_LD_E.name: ULND5 Distal Latency Contribution (Elbow) from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ULND5_LD_E.description: Intermediate node representing the latency-prolonging effect on the ULND5 sensory response in the elbow (E) segment due to a local ulnar nerve lesion at the elbow.

R_ULND5_LD_E.name: ULND5 Distal Latency (Elbow Segment)
R_ULND5_LD_E.description: Distal latency of the ulnar digit-5 sensory response in the elbow segment configuration. Prolongation indicates slowed conduction across the elbow.

R_OTHER_ULND5_RD.name: ULND5 Proximal Latency Contribution from Other Causes
R_OTHER_ULND5_RD.description: Intermediate node representing contributions to the proximal (rostral) latency of the ULND5 sensory response from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions.

R_LNLE_ULND5_RD_E.name: ULND5 Proximal Latency Contribution (Elbow) from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ULND5_RD_E.description: Intermediate node representing the proximal latency contribution to the ULND5 sensory response in the elbow segment from an ulnar lesion at the elbow.

R_ULND5_RD_E.name: ULND5 Proximal Latency (Elbow Segment)
R_ULND5_RD_E.description: Proximal latency component of the ULND5 sensory response in the elbow segment. Used together with distal latency to compute conduction velocity across the elbow.

R_ULND5_LSLOW_E.name: ULND5 Local Slowing (Elbow Segment)
R_ULND5_LSLOW_E.description: Local conduction slowing of the ulnar digit-5 sensory fibers within the elbow segment. Indicates focal demyelinating pathology localized to the elbow region.

R_OTHER_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Other Causes
R_OTHER_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing sensory axon loss affecting the ULND5 response from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions and diffuse neuropathy.

R_LNLW_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing sensory axon loss in the ULND5 pathway due to a local ulnar nerve lesion at the wrist.

R_DIFFN_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing sensory axon loss in the ULND5 pathway caused by a diffuse neuropathy, especially its axonal component.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining ULND5 sensory axon loss contributions from diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion.

R_LNLE_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing sensory axon loss in the ULND5 pathway caused by a local ulnar nerve lesion at the elbow.

R_LNLLP_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Lower Plexus Lesion
R_LNLLP_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing sensory axon loss in the ULND5 pathway caused by a lesion of the lower brachial plexus, which contributes ulnar sensory fibers.

R_LNLLP_E_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Lower Plexus and Elbow Lesions
R_LNLLP_E_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining sensory axon loss contributions to the ULND5 response from lower plexus and elbow lesions.

R_LNL_DIFFN_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from All Neuropathic Causes
R_LNL_DIFFN_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node aggregating all focal nerve lesion (plexus, elbow, wrist) and diffuse neuropathy contributions to ULND5 sensory axon loss.

R_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss
R_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Overall sensory axon loss affecting the ulnar digit-5 sensory response, integrating contributions from focal lesions and diffuse neuropathy. Manifests primarily as reduced sensory response amplitude.

R_OTHER_ULND5_DIFSLOW.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing from Other Causes
R_OTHER_ULND5_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse conduction slowing of the ULND5 sensory fibers from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions and diffuse neuropathy.

R_LNLE_ULND5_DIFSLOW.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ULND5_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse slowing of the ULND5 sensory response attributable to retrograde or extended effects of a focal ulnar lesion at the elbow.

R_DIFFN_ULND5_DIFSLOW.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_ULND5_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse (length-uniform) slowing of the ulnar digit-5 sensory fibers caused by a diffuse neuropathy.

R_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_DIFSLOW_E.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing (Elbow) from Elbow Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy
R_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_DIFSLOW_E.description: Intermediate node combining contributions to diffuse slowing of the ULND5 sensory response in the elbow segment from elbow lesion and diffuse neuropathy.

R_ULND5_DIFSLOW_E.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing (Elbow Segment)
R_ULND5_DIFSLOW_E.description: Diffuse component of conduction slowing in the ULND5 sensory response across the elbow segment, distinct from focal slowing localized at the elbow.

R_ULND5_DSLOW_E.name: ULND5 Distal Slowing (Elbow Segment)
R_ULND5_DSLOW_E.description: Distal-segment slowing component of the ULND5 sensory response in the elbow segment configuration. Reflects pathology preferentially affecting more distal sensory fibers.

R_ULND5_ALLCV_E.name: ULND5 Total Conduction Velocity Effect (Elbow Segment)
R_ULND5_ALLCV_E.description: Combined effect of all slowing mechanisms (local, diffuse, distal) on conduction velocity of the ULND5 sensory response across the elbow segment, before observation.

R_ULND5_CV_E.name: ULND5 Conduction Velocity (Elbow Segment)
R_ULND5_CV_E.description: Observed sensory conduction velocity of the ulnar digit-5 fibers across the elbow segment. Reduced values are characteristic of ulnar neuropathy at the elbow.

R_ULND5_DISP_EWD.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion (Elbow–Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_DISP_EWD.description: Overall temporal dispersion of the ULND5 sensory response across the full elbow-to-digit (EWD) pathway. Integrates contributions from elbow, EW, and WD segments.

R_ULND5_BLOCK_EW.name: ULND5 Conduction Block (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULND5_BLOCK_EW.description: Sensory conduction block in the ULND5 response across the elbow-to-wrist (EW) segment, indicating focal demyelinating pathology in the forearm portion of the ulnar nerve.

R_ULND5_AMPR_EW.name: ULND5 Amplitude Reduction (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULND5_AMPR_EW.description: Amplitude reduction of the ULND5 sensory response between elbow and wrist stimulation/recording sites. Combines effects of block and dispersion across the EW segment.

R_ULND5_DIFSLOW_EW.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULND5_DIFSLOW_EW.description: Diffuse component of conduction slowing in the ULND5 sensory response across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment.

R_ULND5_DSLOW_EW.name: ULND5 Distal Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULND5_DSLOW_EW.description: Distal-segment slowing component of the ULND5 sensory response in the elbow–wrist (EW) configuration.

R_ULND5_ALLCV_EW.name: ULND5 Total Conduction Velocity Effect (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULND5_ALLCV_EW.description: Combined effect of all slowing mechanisms on the conduction velocity of the ULND5 sensory response in the elbow–wrist (EW) segment, before observation.

R_ULND5_CV_EW.name: ULND5 Conduction Velocity (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULND5_CV_EW.description: Observed sensory conduction velocity of the ulnar digit-5 fibers in the elbow–wrist (EW) segment. Slowing indicates demyelinating or mixed pathology in the forearm.

R_LNLW_ULND5_BLOCK_WD.name: ULND5 Conduction Block (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_ULND5_BLOCK_WD.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the ULND5 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment caused by a local ulnar lesion at the wrist.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_ULND5_BLOCK_WD.name: ULND5 Conduction Block (Wrist–Digit) from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_ULND5_BLOCK_WD.description: Intermediate node combining contributions to ULND5 conduction block in the wrist–digit (WD) segment from diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion.

R_ULND5_BLOCK_WD.name: ULND5 Conduction Block (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_BLOCK_WD.description: Observed sensory conduction block in the ULND5 response across the wrist-to-digit (WD) segment, indicating focal demyelination in the distal ulnar pathway.

R_ULND5_EFFAXLOSS.name: ULND5 Effective Axon Loss
R_ULND5_EFFAXLOSS.description: Effective sensory axon loss for the ULND5 response, combining true axon loss with the functional axon-loss equivalent produced by conduction block. Drives the observed sensory amplitude.

R_ULND5_ALLAMP_WD.name: ULND5 Total Amplitude Effect (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_ALLAMP_WD.description: Aggregated effect of all amplitude-reducing mechanisms (block, dispersion, axon loss) on the ULND5 sensory amplitude in the wrist–digit (WD) recording configuration.

R_ULND5_AMP_WD.name: ULND5 Sensory Amplitude (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_AMP_WD.description: Observed amplitude of the ulnar digit-5 sensory response recorded in the wrist–digit (WD) configuration. Reduced values indicate axon loss or significant block/dispersion.

R_LNLW_ULND5_LD_WD.name: ULND5 Distal Latency Contribution (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_ULND5_LD_WD.description: Intermediate node representing the prolonging contribution of a local wrist lesion to the distal latency of the ULND5 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment.

R_ULND5_LD_WD.name: ULND5 Distal Latency (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_LD_WD.description: Distal latency of the ulnar digit-5 sensory response in the wrist–digit (WD) recording configuration. Prolongation indicates slowing at or distal to the wrist.

R_LNLW_ULND5_RD_WD.name: ULND5 Proximal Latency Contribution (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_ULND5_RD_WD.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a local wrist lesion to the proximal latency component of the ULND5 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment.

R_ULND5_RD_WD.name: ULND5 Proximal Latency (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_RD_WD.description: Proximal latency component of the ULND5 sensory response in the wrist–digit (WD) configuration. Used with distal latency to derive segmental conduction velocity.

R_ULND5_LSLOW_WD.name: ULND5 Local Slowing (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_LSLOW_WD.description: Local (focal) conduction slowing of the ulnar digit-5 sensory fibers within the wrist–digit (WD) segment. Suggests demyelinating pathology localized at the wrist.

R_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_DIFSLOW_WD.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing (Wrist–Digit) from Elbow Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy
R_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_DIFSLOW_WD.description: Intermediate node combining contributions to diffuse slowing of the ULND5 sensory response in the wrist–digit (WD) segment from elbow lesion and diffuse neuropathy.

R_ULND5_DIFSLOW_WD.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_DIFSLOW_WD.description: Diffuse component of conduction slowing in the ULND5 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment, distinct from focal slowing at the wrist.

R_ULND5_DSLOW_WD.name: ULND5 Distal Slowing (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_DSLOW_WD.description: Distal-segment slowing of the ULND5 sensory response in the wrist–digit (WD) configuration. Reflects pathology specifically affecting distal sensory fibers.

R_ULND5_ALLCV_WD.name: ULND5 Total Conduction Velocity Effect (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_ALLCV_WD.description: Combined effect of local, diffuse, and distal slowing mechanisms on the conduction velocity of the ULND5 sensory response in the wrist–digit (WD) segment, before observation.

R_ULND5_CV_WD.name: ULND5 Conduction Velocity (Wrist–Digit)
R_ULND5_CV_WD.description: Observed sensory conduction velocity of the ulnar digit-5 fibers across the wrist–digit (WD) segment. Slowing indicates demyelinating or mixed pathology in the distal ulnar pathway.

R_DIFFN_ULN_BLOCK.name: Ulnar Motor Conduction Block from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_ULN_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing motor conduction block of the ulnar nerve caused by a diffuse neuropathy with demyelinating features.

R_LNLE_ULN_BLOCK.name: Ulnar Motor Conduction Block from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ULN_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing motor conduction block of the ulnar nerve caused by a focal lesion at the elbow (LNLE), characteristic of ulnar neuropathy at the elbow.

R_ULN_BLOCK_E.name: Ulnar Motor Conduction Block (Elbow Segment)
R_ULN_BLOCK_E.description: Observed motor conduction block of the ulnar nerve across the elbow segment, indicating focal demyelinating pathology at or near the elbow.

R_ULN_AMPR_E.name: Ulnar Motor Amplitude Reduction (Elbow Segment)
R_ULN_AMPR_E.description: Reduction of the ulnar nerve compound motor action potential amplitude across the elbow segment. Reflects conduction block and temporal dispersion at the elbow.

R_OTHER_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss from Other Causes
R_OTHER_ADM_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle from causes other than the explicitly modeled focal lesions and diffuse neuropathy.

R_LNLC8_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss from C8 Root Lesion
R_LNLC8_ADM_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in ADM resulting from a lesion of the C8 nerve root, which contributes major motor fibers to the ulnar-innervated hand muscles.

R_LNLLP_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss from Lower Plexus Lesion
R_LNLLP_ADM_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in ADM caused by a lesion of the lower brachial plexus.

R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss from C8 Root and Lower Plexus Lesions
R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining motor axon loss in ADM caused by C8 root and lower plexus lesions, both of which contribute fibers to the ulnar nerve.

R_LNLE_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ADM_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in ADM caused by a focal ulnar nerve lesion at the elbow.

R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss from C8, Lower Plexus, and Elbow Lesions
R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node aggregating motor axon loss in ADM from focal lesions at the C8 root, lower brachial plexus, and elbow.

R_LNLW_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_ADM_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in ADM resulting from a local ulnar nerve lesion at the wrist.

R_DIFFN_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_ADM_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing motor axon loss in ADM caused by a diffuse neuropathy reaching the distal hand muscles.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining motor axon loss in ADM from diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion.

R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss from All Neuropathic Causes
R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node aggregating all focal nerve lesion (root, plexus, elbow, wrist) and diffuse neuropathy contributions to motor axon loss in ADM.

R_ADM_MALOSS.name: ADM Motor Axon Loss
R_ADM_MALOSS.description: Overall motor axon loss in the abductor digiti minimi muscle, integrating contributions from focal nerve lesions and diffuse neuropathy. Drives motor amplitude and EMG findings in ADM.

R_LNLE_ULN_DIFSLOW.name: Ulnar Motor Diffuse Slowing from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ULN_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse slowing of ulnar motor conduction attributable to retrograde or extended effects of a focal ulnar lesion at the elbow.

R_DIFFN_ULN_DIFSLOW.name: Ulnar Motor Diffuse Slowing from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_ULN_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse slowing of ulnar motor conduction caused by a diffuse neuropathy.

R_ULN_DIFSLOW_E.name: Ulnar Motor Diffuse Slowing (Elbow Segment)
R_ULN_DIFSLOW_E.description: Diffuse component of motor conduction slowing in the ulnar nerve across the elbow segment, distinct from focal slowing at the elbow.

R_ULN_DCV_E.name: Ulnar Motor Distal Conduction Velocity Effect (Elbow Segment)
R_ULN_DCV_E.description: Distal slowing component contributing to ulnar motor conduction velocity in the elbow segment. Reflects pathology in more distal ulnar motor fibers.

R_ULN_LD_EW.name: Ulnar Motor Distal Latency (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULN_LD_EW.description: Distal motor latency of the ulnar nerve when stimulating at the wrist for the elbow–wrist (EW) measurement. Used to compute conduction velocity across the EW segment.

R_ULN_RD_EW.name: Ulnar Motor Proximal Latency (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULN_RD_EW.description: Proximal motor latency of the ulnar nerve when stimulating above the elbow. Used together with distal latency to compute motor conduction velocity in the EW segment.

R_ULN_RDLDCV_E.name: Ulnar Motor Latency-Difference Conduction Velocity (Elbow Segment)
R_ULN_RDLDCV_E.description: Conduction velocity in the ulnar nerve elbow segment derived from the difference between proximal and distal motor latencies, before incorporation of additional slowing effects.

R_ULN_ALLCV_E.name: Ulnar Motor Total Conduction Velocity Effect (Elbow Segment)
R_ULN_ALLCV_E.description: Combined effect of focal, diffuse, and distal slowing mechanisms on the ulnar motor conduction velocity in the elbow segment, prior to observation.

R_ULN_CV_E.name: Ulnar Motor Conduction Velocity (Elbow Segment)
R_ULN_CV_E.description: Observed motor conduction velocity of the ulnar nerve across the elbow segment. Slowing across the elbow is a hallmark of ulnar neuropathy at the elbow.

R_ULN_BLOCK_EW.name: Ulnar Motor Conduction Block (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULN_BLOCK_EW.description: Observed motor conduction block of the ulnar nerve across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment, indicating focal demyelinating pathology in the forearm.

R_ULN_AMPR_EW.name: Ulnar Motor Amplitude Reduction (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULN_AMPR_EW.description: Reduction of the ulnar CMAP amplitude when stimulating at the elbow versus the wrist. Reflects conduction block and temporal dispersion in the EW segment.

R_ULN_DIFSLOW_EW.name: Ulnar Motor Diffuse Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULN_DIFSLOW_EW.description: Diffuse component of motor conduction slowing in the ulnar nerve across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment.

R_ULN_DCV_EW.name: Ulnar Motor Distal Conduction Velocity Effect (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULN_DCV_EW.description: Distal slowing component contributing to ulnar motor conduction velocity in the elbow–wrist (EW) segment.

R_ULN_ALLCV_EW.name: Ulnar Motor Total Conduction Velocity Effect (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULN_ALLCV_EW.description: Combined effect of focal, diffuse, and distal slowing mechanisms on the ulnar motor conduction velocity in the elbow–wrist segment, prior to observation.

R_ULN_CV_EW.name: Ulnar Motor Conduction Velocity (Elbow–Wrist)
R_ULN_CV_EW.description: Observed motor conduction velocity of the ulnar nerve across the elbow–wrist (EW) segment. Reduced values suggest demyelinating or mixed pathology in the forearm.

R_OTHER_ADM_NMT.name: ADM Neuromuscular Transmission Effect from Other Causes
R_OTHER_ADM_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the impact on neuromuscular transmission at ADM from causes other than the explicitly modeled NMJ disease and reinnervation.

R_LNLC8_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation from C8 Root Lesion
R_LNLC8_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the degree of denervation and subsequent reinnervation activity in ADM EMG caused by a lesion of the C8 nerve root.

R_LNLLP_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation from Lower Plexus Lesion
R_LNLLP_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing denervation and reinnervation findings in ADM EMG caused by a lower brachial plexus lesion.

R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation from C8 and Lower Plexus Lesions
R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining denervation/reinnervation contributions in ADM EMG from C8 root and lower plexus lesions.

R_LNLE_ULN_TIME.name: Ulnar Elbow Lesion Duration
R_LNLE_ULN_TIME.description: Time elapsed since the onset of a local ulnar nerve lesion at the elbow. Determines whether sufficient time has passed for denervation and reinnervation to manifest in distal muscles like ADM.

R_LNLE_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation from Elbow Lesion
R_LNLE_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing denervation and reinnervation findings in ADM EMG caused by a focal ulnar lesion at the elbow, modulated by the lesion's duration.

R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation from C8, Lower Plexus, and Elbow Lesions
R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node aggregating denervation/reinnervation contributions in ADM EMG from focal lesions at the C8 root, lower plexus, and elbow.

R_DIFFN_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation from Diffuse Neuropathy
R_DIFFN_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing denervation and reinnervation findings in ADM EMG caused by a diffuse neuropathy of given severity, type, and duration.

R_LNLW_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation from Wrist Lesion
R_LNLW_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing denervation and reinnervation findings in ADM EMG caused by a local ulnar lesion at the wrist.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining denervation/reinnervation contributions in ADM EMG from diffuse neuropathy and a local wrist lesion.

R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation from All Neuropathic Causes
R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node aggregating all focal nerve lesion and diffuse neuropathy contributions to ADM EMG denervation and reinnervation findings.

R_MYOP_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM EMG Changes from Myopathy
R_MYOP_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a myopathy to ADM EMG findings that resemble or modify denervation/reinnervation patterns.

R_MYDY_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM EMG Changes from Muscular Dystrophy
R_MYDY_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a muscular dystrophy to ADM EMG findings that overlap with denervation/reinnervation patterns.

R_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM EMG Changes from Myopathy and Muscular Dystrophy
R_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of myopathy and muscular dystrophy to ADM EMG findings interacting with denervation/reinnervation observations.

R_OTHER_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation from Other Causes
R_OTHER_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing denervation and reinnervation findings in ADM EMG caused by factors other than the explicitly modeled disease processes.

R_MUSCLE_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM EMG Changes from Muscle/NMJ Disorders
R_MUSCLE_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions to ADM EMG denervation/reinnervation-related findings from primary muscle disorders and other muscle-level causes.

R_ADM_DE_REGEN.name: ADM Denervation/Reinnervation
R_ADM_DE_REGEN.description: Overall degree of denervation and reinnervation activity observed in ADM EMG, integrating contributions from focal nerve lesions, diffuse neuropathy, myopathy, muscular dystrophy, and other muscle-level causes.

R_DE_REGEN_ADM_NMT.name: ADM Neuromuscular Transmission Effect from Denervation/Reinnervation
R_DE_REGEN_ADM_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the impact of denervation and reinnervation processes on apparent neuromuscular transmission at ADM. Newly reinnervated endplates can produce transmission instability resembling NMJ disease.

R_MYAS_ADM_NMT.name: Myasthenia Effect on ADM Neuromuscular Transmission
R_MYAS_ADM_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of myasthenia (a neuromuscular junction disorder such as myasthenia gravis) on neuromuscular transmission (NMT) in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle. Captures how presynaptic or postsynaptic NMJ pathology impairs reliable transmission of motor impulses to the ADM.

R_MYAS_DE_REGEN_ADM_NMT.name: Myasthenia and Denervation/Reinnervation Effect on ADM NMT
R_MYAS_DE_REGEN_ADM_NMT.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of myasthenia and ongoing denervation/reinnervation processes on neuromuscular transmission (NMT) in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM). Reflects that immature reinnervating motor endplates can also exhibit NMT failure, mimicking or compounding myasthenic defects.
