R_ADM_NMT.name: ADM Neuromuscular Transmission
R_ADM_NMT.description: Node representing the overall integrity of neuromuscular transmission (NMT) at the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle. Determines whether motor nerve action potentials reliably trigger muscle fiber action potentials, influencing decrement on repetitive stimulation and jitter on single-fiber EMG.

R_OTHER_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Other Causes' Effect on ADM Motor Unit Size
R_OTHER_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of unspecified or miscellaneous disease processes (other than the explicitly modeled ones) on motor unit (MU) size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM). Acts as a residual contributor in the model.

R_MYDY_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Myodystrophy Effect on ADM Motor Unit Size
R_MYDY_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a myodystrophic process (muscular dystrophy) on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM). Loss of muscle fibers within motor units typically reduces MU size.

R_MYOP_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Myopathy Effect on ADM Motor Unit Size
R_MYOP_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a non-dystrophic myopathy on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM). Reflects loss or dysfunction of muscle fibers within otherwise normally innervated motor units.

R_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Combined Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on ADM Motor Unit Size
R_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of myopathy and myodystrophy on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM). Aggregates the impact of primary muscle diseases on MU size before being combined with other contributors.

R_MUSCLE_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Muscle Disease Effect on ADM Motor Unit Size
R_MUSCLE_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the combined effect of all primary muscle diseases (myopathy, dystrophy, etc.) on the motor unit size of the abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

R_LNLW_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Wrist Lesion Effect on ADM Motor Unit Size
R_LNLW_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW) on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM). Axonal loss at the wrist would reduce surviving MUs but allow collateral reinnervation to enlarge them.

R_DIFFN_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on ADM Motor Unit Size
R_DIFFN_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN), such as a generalized polyneuropathy, on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM). Chronic axonal loss with reinnervation typically yields enlarged MUs.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Combined Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion Effect on ADM MU Size
R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) and a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW) on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

R_LNLE_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Elbow Lesion Effect on ADM Motor Unit Size
R_LNLE_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a local ulnar nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE) on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM). Axonal loss above the wrist with reinnervation would enlarge surviving MUs.

R_LNLLP_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on ADM Motor Unit Size
R_LNLLP_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a local nerve lesion in the lower brachial plexus (LNLLP) on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

R_LNLC8_ADM_MUSIZE.name: C8 Root Lesion Effect on ADM Motor Unit Size
R_LNLC8_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a local nerve lesion at the C8 root (LNLC8) on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM), since ADM is innervated by C8/T1 fibers.

R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_MUSIZE.name: C8 Root and Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on ADM MU Size
R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node aggregating the combined effects of C8 root and lower plexus lesions on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_MUSIZE.name: C8/Lower Plexus/Elbow Lesion Effect on ADM MU Size
R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node aggregating the combined effects of lesions at the C8 root, lower brachial plexus, and ulnar nerve at the elbow on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_MUSIZE.name: Combined Local Nerve Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on ADM MU Size
R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining all local nerve lesion effects (along the ulnar nerve pathway) with diffuse neuropathy effects on motor unit size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

R_ADM_MUSIZE.name: ADM Motor Unit Size
R_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Node representing the average motor unit (MU) size in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle, integrating all neurogenic and myopathic contributions. Larger MUs indicate chronic reinnervation; smaller MUs indicate myopathic loss of fibers.

R_ADM_EFFMUS.name: ADM Effective Muscle Mass
R_ADM_EFFMUS.description: Node representing the effective contractile/electrical muscle mass of the abductor digiti minimi (ADM), combining the number of functioning motor units with their size. Drives the amplitude of the compound muscle action potential (CMAP).

R_OTHER_ULN_BLOCK_WA.name: Other Causes of Ulnar Nerve Conduction Block (Wrist–Above)
R_OTHER_ULN_BLOCK_WA.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the ulnar nerve between the wrist and proximal stimulation sites attributable to causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions.

R_LNLW_ULN_BLOCK.name: Wrist Lesion–Induced Ulnar Conduction Block
R_LNLW_ULN_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the ulnar nerve caused by a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW). Demyelinating wrist lesions can produce focal block of impulses across the lesion site.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_ULN_BLOCK_WA.name: Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion Effect on Ulnar Block (Wrist–Above)
R_DIFFN_LNLW_ULN_BLOCK_WA.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) and a wrist lesion (LNLW) on ulnar nerve conduction block measured between wrist and above-wrist stimulation sites.

R_ULN_BLOCK_WA.name: Ulnar Nerve Conduction Block (Wrist–Above)
R_ULN_BLOCK_WA.description: Node representing the overall degree of conduction block in the ulnar nerve between distal (wrist) and proximal (above-wrist) stimulation sites. Manifests as drop in CMAP amplitude with proximal stimulation.

R_ADM_MULOSS.name: ADM Motor Unit Loss
R_ADM_MULOSS.description: Node representing the loss of functioning motor units innervating the abductor digiti minimi (ADM). Reduced MU count contributes to reduced CMAP amplitude and altered recruitment.

R_ADM_ALLAMP_WA.name: ADM CMAP Amplitude Reduction (Wrist–Above) — All Causes
R_ADM_ALLAMP_WA.description: Intermediate node aggregating all sources of compound muscle action potential (CMAP) amplitude reduction at the ADM with stimulation between wrist and proximal sites, including motor unit loss, conduction block, and reduced effective muscle mass.

R_ULN_AMP_WA.name: Ulnar CMAP Amplitude (Wrist–Above)
R_ULN_AMP_WA.description: Observable node representing the measured compound muscle action potential (CMAP) amplitude recorded from ADM after ulnar nerve stimulation, comparing wrist and above-wrist stimulation sites.

R_ULN_LD_WA.name: Ulnar Latency Difference (Wrist–Above)
R_ULN_LD_WA.description: Node representing the latency difference of the ulnar nerve CMAP between wrist and above-wrist stimulation sites, used to assess conduction velocity along that segment.

R_ULN_RD_WA.name: Ulnar Response Duration Increase (Wrist–Above)
R_ULN_RD_WA.description: Node representing the increase in CMAP response duration when stimulating the ulnar nerve proximally (above) versus distally (at the wrist), reflecting temporal dispersion across the segment.

R_ULN_RDLDDEL.name: Ulnar Response Duration/Latency Delay
R_ULN_RDLDDEL.description: Intermediate node combining response-duration and latency-difference based measures into an overall delay/dispersion indicator for the ulnar nerve segment.

R_ULN_DIFSLOW_WA.name: Ulnar Differential Slowing (Wrist–Above)
R_ULN_DIFSLOW_WA.description: Intermediate node representing differential (non-uniform) slowing of conduction in the ulnar nerve between wrist and above-wrist sites, characteristic of acquired demyelinating neuropathies.

R_ULN_DCV_WA.name: Ulnar Distal Conduction Velocity (Wrist–Above)
R_ULN_DCV_WA.description: Observable node representing the distal motor conduction velocity of the ulnar nerve computed from the wrist–above-wrist segment.

R_ULN_ALLDEL_WA.name: Ulnar Total Conduction Delay (Wrist–Above) — All Causes
R_ULN_ALLDEL_WA.description: Intermediate node aggregating all contributions to delayed conduction in the ulnar nerve between wrist and above-wrist stimulation sites.

R_ULN_LAT_WA.name: Ulnar Distal Motor Latency (Wrist–Above)
R_ULN_LAT_WA.description: Observable node representing the distal motor latency of the ulnar nerve from the wrist or above-wrist stimulation site to the ADM recording site.

R_ADM_VOL_ACT.name: ADM Voluntary Activation
R_ADM_VOL_ACT.description: Node representing the level of voluntary activation/effort applied by the patient when contracting the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) during EMG examination. Influences recruitment and interference pattern.

R_ADM_FORCE.name: ADM Force
R_ADM_FORCE.description: Node representing the actual force generated by the abductor digiti minimi (ADM), determined by voluntary activation, effective muscle mass, and neuromuscular transmission integrity.

R_ADM_MUSCLE_VOL.name: ADM Muscle Volume
R_ADM_MUSCLE_VOL.description: Node representing the physical volume/bulk of the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle, which influences force output and electrophysiological measurements.

R_ADM_MVA_RECRUIT.name: ADM Maximum Voluntary Activation Recruitment
R_ADM_MVA_RECRUIT.description: Observable node representing the recruitment pattern of motor units in the ADM at maximum voluntary effort. Reduced recruitment suggests neurogenic loss; early/full recruitment with low force suggests myopathy.

R_ADM_MVA_AMP.name: ADM Maximum Voluntary Activation Amplitude
R_ADM_MVA_AMP.description: Observable node representing the amplitude of the EMG interference pattern in ADM at maximum voluntary effort.

R_ADM_TA_CONCL.name: ADM Turns/Amplitude Analysis Conclusion
R_ADM_TA_CONCL.description: Node representing the conclusion of turns–amplitude (interference pattern) analysis on the abductor digiti minimi (ADM), classifying the pattern as normal, neurogenic, or myopathic.

R_ADM_MUPAMP.name: ADM MUP Amplitude
R_ADM_MUPAMP.description: Node representing the amplitude of motor unit potentials (MUPs) recorded from the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) during needle EMG.

R_ADM_QUAN_MUPAMP.name: ADM Quantitative MUP Amplitude
R_ADM_QUAN_MUPAMP.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured motor unit potential amplitude in ADM, expressed numerically (e.g., in microvolts).

R_ADM_QUAL_MUPAMP.name: ADM Qualitative MUP Amplitude
R_ADM_QUAL_MUPAMP.description: Observable node representing a qualitative (visual) assessment of motor unit potential amplitude in ADM as low, normal, or high during needle EMG examination.

R_ADM_MUPDUR.name: ADM MUP Duration
R_ADM_MUPDUR.description: Node representing the duration of motor unit potentials (MUPs) recorded from the abductor digiti minimi (ADM). Longer durations suggest chronic neurogenic change; shorter suggest myopathy.

R_ADM_QUAN_MUPDUR.name: ADM Quantitative MUP Duration
R_ADM_QUAN_MUPDUR.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured motor unit potential duration in ADM (in milliseconds).

R_ADM_QUAL_MUPDUR.name: ADM Qualitative MUP Duration
R_ADM_QUAL_MUPDUR.description: Observable node representing a qualitative assessment of motor unit potential duration in the ADM as short, normal, or long.

R_ADM_QUAN_MUPPOLY.name: ADM Quantitative MUP Polyphasicity
R_ADM_QUAN_MUPPOLY.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured proportion of polyphasic motor unit potentials in ADM during needle EMG.

R_ADM_QUAL_MUPPOLY.name: ADM Qualitative MUP Polyphasicity
R_ADM_QUAL_MUPPOLY.description: Observable node representing a qualitative assessment of polyphasicity of motor unit potentials in ADM. Increased polyphasicity reflects desynchronized firing of muscle fibers within MUs.

R_ADM_MUPSATEL.name: ADM MUP Satellite Potentials
R_ADM_MUPSATEL.description: Observable node representing the presence of satellite (linked) potentials on MUPs in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM), an indicator of recent reinnervation by collateral sprouting.

R_ADM_MUPINSTAB.name: ADM MUP Instability
R_ADM_MUPINSTAB.description: Observable node representing the instability (jiggle) of motor unit potentials in ADM on consecutive firings, indicating immature/unstable neuromuscular junctions in reinnervating fibers or NMT disorders.

R_ADM_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.name: ADM Repetitive Stimulation CMAP Amplitude
R_ADM_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.description: Observable node representing the CMAP amplitude obtained from the ADM during repetitive nerve stimulation (RNS) testing.

R_ADM_REPSTIM_DECR.name: ADM Repetitive Stimulation Decrement
R_ADM_REPSTIM_DECR.description: Observable node representing the percentage decrement of CMAP amplitude on slow repetitive nerve stimulation in ADM, a hallmark finding in postsynaptic NMJ disorders such as myasthenia gravis.

R_ADM_REPSTIM_FACILI.name: ADM Repetitive Stimulation Facilitation
R_ADM_REPSTIM_FACILI.description: Observable node representing CMAP facilitation (incremental response) on high-frequency repetitive stimulation or post-exercise in ADM, characteristic of presynaptic NMJ disorders such as Lambert–Eaton syndrome.

R_ADM_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.name: ADM Post-Activation Repetitive Stimulation Decrement
R_ADM_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.description: Observable node representing the decrement of CMAP amplitude in ADM observed after a period of post-activation exhaustion following sustained voluntary contraction during repetitive stimulation testing.

R_ADM_SF_JITTER.name: ADM Single-Fiber EMG Jitter
R_ADM_SF_JITTER.description: Observable node representing the temporal variability (jitter) between paired muscle fiber potentials on single-fiber EMG of ADM. Increased jitter is a sensitive marker of neuromuscular transmission abnormality.

R_LNLC8_ADM_MUDENS.name: C8 Lesion Effect on ADM Muscle Fiber Density
R_LNLC8_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a C8 root lesion on muscle fiber density in the ADM, as measured by single-fiber EMG. Reinnervation increases fiber density.

R_LNLLP_ADM_MUDENS.name: Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on ADM Muscle Fiber Density
R_LNLLP_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a lower brachial plexus lesion on muscle fiber density in the ADM.

R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_MUDENS.name: C8/Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating the effects of C8 root and lower plexus lesions on muscle fiber density in the ADM.

R_LNLE_ADM_MUDENS.name: Elbow Lesion Effect on ADM Muscle Fiber Density
R_LNLE_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a local ulnar nerve lesion at the elbow on muscle fiber density in the ADM.

R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_MUDENS.name: C8/Plexus/Elbow Lesion Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating the effects of C8 root, lower plexus, and elbow ulnar lesions on muscle fiber density in the ADM.

R_DIFFN_ADM_MUDENS.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_DIFFN_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a diffuse neuropathy on muscle fiber density in the ADM. Chronic reinnervation increases fiber density.

R_LNLW_ADM_MUDENS.name: Wrist Lesion Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_LNLW_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a local nerve lesion at the wrist on muscle fiber density in the ADM.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_MUDENS.name: Diffuse Neuropathy/Wrist Lesion Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion on muscle fiber density in the ADM.

R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_MUDENS.name: Local Nerve Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating all local nerve lesion effects together with diffuse neuropathy effects on muscle fiber density in the ADM.

R_MYOP_ADM_MUDENS.name: Myopathy Effect on ADM Muscle Fiber Density
R_MYOP_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a myopathy on muscle fiber density in the ADM, where loss/regeneration of fibers can locally increase apparent fiber density.

R_MYDY_ADM_MUDENS.name: Myodystrophy Effect on ADM Muscle Fiber Density
R_MYDY_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of muscular dystrophy on muscle fiber density in the ADM.

R_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_MUDENS.name: Combined Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of myopathy and myodystrophy on muscle fiber density in the ADM.

R_MYAS_ADM_MUDENS.name: Myasthenia Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_MYAS_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of myasthenia (NMJ disorder) on apparent muscle fiber density in the ADM measured by single-fiber EMG.

R_OTHER_ADM_MUDENS.name: Other Causes' Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_OTHER_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of unspecified or miscellaneous disease processes on muscle fiber density in the ADM.

R_MYAS_OTHER_ADM_MUDENS.name: Myasthenia/Other Causes Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_MYAS_OTHER_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining myasthenic and other miscellaneous contributions to ADM muscle fiber density.

R_MUSCLE_ADM_MUDENS.name: Muscle Disease Effect on ADM Fiber Density
R_MUSCLE_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from primary muscle diseases (myopathy, dystrophy, etc.) to ADM muscle fiber density.

R_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density
R_ADM_MUDENS.description: Node representing the overall muscle fiber density in the ADM as would be measured electrophysiologically. Increased density typically indicates collateral reinnervation.

R_ADM_SF_DENSITY.name: ADM Single-Fiber Density
R_ADM_SF_DENSITY.description: Observable node representing the fiber density measured by single-fiber EMG in the ADM, the average number of muscle fiber action potentials recorded per needle position within a motor unit territory.

R_LNLC8_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: C8 Lesion Effect on ADM Neurogenic Activity
R_LNLC8_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a C8 root lesion to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity (e.g., fibrillations, positive sharp waves) in the ADM.

R_LNLLP_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on ADM Neurogenic Activity
R_LNLLP_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a lower brachial plexus lesion to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the ADM.

R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: C8/Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on ADM Neurogenic Activity
R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node aggregating the contributions of C8 root and lower plexus lesions to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the ADM.

R_LNLE_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: Elbow Lesion Effect on ADM Neurogenic Activity
R_LNLE_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of an ulnar nerve lesion at the elbow to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the ADM.

R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: C8/Plexus/Elbow Lesion Effect on ADM Neurogenic Activity
R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node aggregating the effects of C8 root, lower plexus, and elbow ulnar lesions on abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the ADM.

R_DIFFN_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on ADM Neurogenic Activity
R_DIFFN_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse neuropathy to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the ADM.

R_LNLW_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: Wrist Lesion Effect on ADM Neurogenic Activity
R_LNLW_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a local nerve lesion at the wrist to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the ADM.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: Diffuse Neuropathy/Wrist Lesion Effect on ADM Neurogenic Activity
R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node combining the contributions of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the ADM.

R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: Local Nerve Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on ADM Neurogenic Activity
R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from all local nerve lesions and diffuse neuropathy to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the ADM.

R_OTHER_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: Other Causes' Effect on ADM Neurogenic Activity
R_OTHER_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of unspecified disease processes to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the ADM.

R_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Spontaneous Neurogenic Activity
R_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Node representing the overall level of abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity (e.g., fibrillation potentials, positive sharp waves) in the ADM, integrating contributions from all neurogenic disease sources.

R_ADM_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.name: ADM Spontaneous Neurogenic Discharges
R_ADM_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.description: Observable node representing the spontaneous discharges (fibrillations, positive sharp waves, fasciculations) observed at rest during needle EMG of the ADM.

R_MYOP_ADM_DENERV.name: Myopathy Effect on ADM Denervation
R_MYOP_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a myopathy to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the ADM. Some myopathies (e.g., inflammatory) produce fibrillation-like activity.

R_MYDY_ADM_DENERV.name: Myodystrophy Effect on ADM Denervation
R_MYDY_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of muscular dystrophy to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the ADM.

R_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_DENERV.name: Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on ADM Denervation
R_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining myopathy and myodystrophy contributions to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the ADM.

R_OTHER_ADM_DENERV.name: Other Causes' Effect on ADM Denervation
R_OTHER_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of unspecified disease processes to denervation activity in the ADM.

R_NMT_ADM_DENERV.name: Neuromuscular Transmission Effect on ADM Denervation
R_NMT_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of neuromuscular transmission disorders to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the ADM.

R_OTHER_NMT_ADM_DENERV.name: Other and NMT Causes Effect on ADM Denervation
R_OTHER_NMT_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from miscellaneous causes and neuromuscular transmission disorders to denervation-like activity in the ADM.

R_MUSCLE_ADM_DENERV.name: Muscle Disease Effect on ADM Denervation
R_MUSCLE_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating the contributions of primary muscle diseases to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the ADM.

R_LNLC8_ADM_DENERV.name: C8 Lesion Effect on ADM Denervation
R_LNLC8_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a C8 root lesion to denervation activity (fibrillations, positive sharp waves) in the ADM.

R_LNLLP_ADM_DENERV.name: Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on ADM Denervation
R_LNLLP_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a lower brachial plexus lesion to denervation activity in the ADM.

R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_DENERV.name: C8/Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on ADM Denervation
R_LNLC8_LP_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of C8 root and lower plexus lesions to denervation activity in the ADM.

R_LNLE_ADM_DENERV.name: Elbow Lesion Effect on ADM Denervation
R_LNLE_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of an ulnar nerve lesion at the elbow to denervation activity in the ADM.

R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_DENERV.name: C8/Plexus/Elbow Lesion Effect on ADM Denervation
R_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from C8 root, lower plexus, and elbow ulnar lesions to denervation activity in the ADM.

R_DIFFN_ADM_DENERV.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on ADM Denervation
R_DIFFN_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse neuropathy to denervation activity in the ADM.

R_LNLW_ADM_DENERV.name: Wrist Lesion Effect on ADM Denervation
R_LNLW_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a local nerve lesion at the wrist to denervation activity in the ADM.

R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_DENERV.name: Diffuse Neuropathy/Wrist Lesion Effect on ADM Denervation
R_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining the contributions of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion to denervation activity in the ADM.

R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_DENERV.name: Local Nerve Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on ADM Denervation
R_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from all local nerve lesions and diffuse neuropathy to denervation activity in the ADM, feeding into the overall ADM denervation node.

R_ADM_DENERV.name: ADM Denervation
R_ADM_DENERV.description: Node representing the overall level of denervation in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM), integrating contributions from all neurogenic and non-neurogenic causes. Drives the appearance of fibrillation potentials and positive sharp waves on needle EMG.

R_ADM_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.name: ADM Spontaneous Denervation Activity
R_ADM_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.description: Observable node representing the spontaneous denervation activity (e.g., fibrillation potentials, positive sharp waves) recorded at rest in the ADM during needle EMG.

R_ADM_SPONT_HF_DISCH.name: ADM Spontaneous High-Frequency Discharges
R_ADM_SPONT_HF_DISCH.description: Observable node representing high-frequency spontaneous discharges (e.g., complex repetitive discharges, myotonic discharges) recorded at rest in the ADM during needle EMG.

R_ADM_SPONT_INS_ACT.name: ADM Spontaneous Insertional Activity
R_ADM_SPONT_INS_ACT.description: Observable node representing the insertional activity observed when the EMG needle is moved through the ADM. Increased insertional activity suggests denervation or membrane instability; decreased suggests fibrosis or fatty replacement.

R_OTHER_DELT_NMT.name: Other Causes' Effect on Deltoid NMT
R_OTHER_DELT_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of unspecified or miscellaneous disease processes on neuromuscular transmission (NMT) in the deltoid muscle.

R_LNLPC5_AXIL_SEV.name: C5/Upper Plexus Lesion Severity on Axillary Nerve
R_LNLPC5_AXIL_SEV.description: Intermediate node representing the severity of damage to the axillary nerve resulting from a local nerve lesion at the C5 root or upper brachial plexus (LNLPC5). Drives the magnitude of downstream electrophysiological abnormalities.

R_LNLPC5_AXIL_TIME.name: C5/Upper Plexus Lesion Temporal Stage on Axillary Nerve
R_LNLPC5_AXIL_TIME.description: Intermediate node representing the temporal stage (acute, subacute, chronic) of an axillary nerve lesion stemming from a C5/upper plexus lesion. Determines whether findings reflect recent denervation versus chronic reinnervation.

R_LNLPC5_AXIL_PATHO.name: C5/Upper Plexus Lesion Pathophysiology on Axillary Nerve
R_LNLPC5_AXIL_PATHO.description: Intermediate node representing the pathophysiological character (demyelinating vs. axonal) of axillary nerve damage caused by a C5/upper plexus lesion.

R_LNLPC5_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: C5/Upper Plexus Effect on Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
R_LNLPC5_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a C5/upper plexus lesion to ongoing denervation and reinnervation in the deltoid muscle.

R_DIFFN_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
R_DIFFN_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse neuropathy to ongoing denervation and reinnervation in the deltoid.

R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: C5/Plexus and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid De/Reinnervation
R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining the contributions of a C5/upper plexus lesion and a diffuse neuropathy to ongoing denervation/reinnervation in the deltoid.

R_MYOP_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Myopathy Effect on Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
R_MYOP_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a myopathic process to apparent denervation/reinnervation activity in the deltoid (e.g., regenerating fibers after necrosis).

R_MYDY_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Myodystrophy Effect on Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
R_MYDY_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a muscular dystrophy to apparent denervation/reinnervation activity in the deltoid.

R_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on Deltoid De/Reinnervation
R_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining the contributions of myopathy and myodystrophy to denervation/reinnervation-like changes in the deltoid.

R_OTHER_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Other Causes' Effect on Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
R_OTHER_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of unspecified or miscellaneous disease processes to denervation/reinnervation in the deltoid.

R_MUSCLE_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Muscle Disease Effect on Deltoid De/Reinnervation
R_MUSCLE_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from primary muscle diseases to denervation/reinnervation-like activity in the deltoid.

R_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
R_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Node representing the overall level of ongoing denervation and reinnervation in the deltoid muscle, integrating neurogenic and myopathic contributions. Drives features such as immature endplates and unstable MUPs.

R_DE_REGEN_DELT_NMT.name: Denervation/Reinnervation Effect on Deltoid NMT
R_DE_REGEN_DELT_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of ongoing denervation/reinnervation on neuromuscular transmission (NMT) in the deltoid. Immature reinnervating endplates exhibit unreliable transmission and increased jitter.

R_MYAS_DELT_NMT.name: Myasthenia Effect on Deltoid NMT
R_MYAS_DELT_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of myasthenia (NMJ disorder) on neuromuscular transmission in the deltoid muscle.

R_MYAS_DE_REGEN_DELT_NMT.name: Myasthenia and De/Reinnervation Effect on Deltoid NMT
R_MYAS_DE_REGEN_DELT_NMT.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of myasthenia and active denervation/reinnervation on neuromuscular transmission in the deltoid.

R_DELT_NMT.name: Deltoid Neuromuscular Transmission
R_DELT_NMT.description: Node representing the overall integrity of neuromuscular transmission in the deltoid muscle, integrating contributions from NMJ disorders, ongoing reinnervation, and other factors.

R_OTHER_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Other Causes' Effect on Deltoid MU Size
R_OTHER_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of unspecified disease processes on motor unit size in the deltoid muscle.

R_MYDY_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Myodystrophy Effect on Deltoid MU Size
R_MYDY_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of muscular dystrophy on motor unit size in the deltoid. Loss of fibers within MUs reduces MU size.

R_MYOP_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Myopathy Effect on Deltoid MU Size
R_MYOP_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a non-dystrophic myopathy on motor unit size in the deltoid.

R_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on Deltoid MU Size
R_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of myopathy and myodystrophy on motor unit size in the deltoid.

R_MUSCLE_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Muscle Disease Effect on Deltoid MU Size
R_MUSCLE_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node aggregating the effects of primary muscle diseases on motor unit size in the deltoid.

R_DIFFN_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid MU Size
R_DIFFN_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a diffuse neuropathy on motor unit size in the deltoid. Chronic axonal loss with reinnervation enlarges surviving MUs.

R_LNLPC5_DELT_MUSIZE.name: C5/Upper Plexus Lesion Effect on Deltoid MU Size
R_LNLPC5_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a C5/upper plexus lesion on motor unit size in the deltoid (which is innervated via C5/C6 through the axillary nerve).

R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MUSIZE.name: C5/Plexus and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid MU Size
R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of a C5/upper plexus lesion and a diffuse neuropathy on motor unit size in the deltoid.

R_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Deltoid Motor Unit Size
R_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Node representing the overall motor unit size in the deltoid muscle, integrating all neurogenic and myopathic contributions.

R_DELT_EFFMUS.name: Deltoid Effective Muscle Mass
R_DELT_EFFMUS.description: Node representing the effective contractile/electrical muscle mass of the deltoid, combining MU count and MU size. Drives the amplitude of the axillary CMAP recorded from deltoid.

R_DIFFN_AXIL_BLOCK.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Axillary Conduction Block
R_DIFFN_AXIL_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the axillary nerve attributable to a diffuse neuropathy.

R_OTHER_AXIL_BLOCK.name: Other Causes of Axillary Conduction Block
R_OTHER_AXIL_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing axillary nerve conduction block from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions.

R_AXIL_BLOCK_ED.name: Axillary Conduction Block (Erb's Point–Deltoid)
R_AXIL_BLOCK_ED.description: Node representing the degree of conduction block in the axillary nerve along the segment between Erb's point stimulation and the deltoid recording site.

R_LNLPC5_DELT_MALOSS.name: C5/Upper Plexus Lesion Effect on Deltoid Muscle Mass Loss
R_LNLPC5_DELT_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the loss of effective muscle mass in the deltoid attributable to a C5/upper plexus lesion (axonal loss leads to denervation atrophy).

R_DIFFN_DELT_MALOSS.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid Muscle Mass Loss
R_DIFFN_DELT_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the loss of effective muscle mass in the deltoid attributable to a diffuse neuropathy.

R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MALOSS.name: C5/Plexus and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid Mass Loss
R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining the contributions of a C5/upper plexus lesion and a diffuse neuropathy to loss of effective muscle mass in the deltoid.

R_OTHER_DELT_MALOSS.name: Other Causes' Effect on Deltoid Muscle Mass Loss
R_OTHER_DELT_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing loss of effective muscle mass in the deltoid attributable to unspecified disease processes.

R_DELT_MALOSS.name: Deltoid Muscle Mass Loss
R_DELT_MALOSS.description: Node representing the overall loss of effective muscle mass in the deltoid, integrating neurogenic and other contributions.

R_DELT_MULOSS.name: Deltoid Motor Unit Loss
R_DELT_MULOSS.description: Node representing the loss of functioning motor units innervating the deltoid muscle. Reduced MU count contributes to lowered CMAP amplitude and altered recruitment.

R_DELT_ALLAMP.name: Deltoid CMAP Amplitude Reduction — All Causes
R_DELT_ALLAMP.description: Intermediate node aggregating all contributions to reduction of the compound muscle action potential (CMAP) amplitude recorded from the deltoid, including motor unit loss, conduction block, and reduced effective muscle mass.

R_AXIL_AMP_E.name: Axillary CMAP Amplitude (Erb's Point)
R_AXIL_AMP_E.description: Observable node representing the measured CMAP amplitude recorded from the deltoid after axillary nerve stimulation at Erb's point.

R_AXIL_RD_ED.name: Axillary Response Duration (Erb's Point–Deltoid)
R_AXIL_RD_ED.description: Node representing the duration of the deltoid CMAP elicited by stimulation at Erb's point. Increased duration reflects temporal dispersion along the axillary nerve segment.

R_LNLPC5_AXIL_DIFSLOW.name: C5/Upper Plexus Lesion Effect on Axillary Differential Slowing
R_LNLPC5_AXIL_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing differential (non-uniform) slowing in the axillary nerve attributable to a C5/upper plexus lesion.

R_DIFFN_AXIL_DIFSLOW.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Axillary Differential Slowing
R_DIFFN_AXIL_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing differential slowing in the axillary nerve attributable to a diffuse neuropathy.

R_AXIL_DIFSLOW_ED.name: Axillary Differential Slowing (Erb's Point–Deltoid)
R_AXIL_DIFSLOW_ED.description: Node representing differential slowing of conduction along the axillary nerve from Erb's point to the deltoid, characteristic of acquired demyelinating processes.

R_AXIL_DCV.name: Axillary Distal Conduction Velocity
R_AXIL_DCV.description: Observable node representing the distal motor conduction velocity of the axillary nerve.

R_AXIL_DEL.name: Axillary Conduction Delay
R_AXIL_DEL.description: Intermediate node aggregating all contributions to delayed conduction in the axillary nerve.

R_AXIL_LAT_ED.name: Axillary Distal Motor Latency (Erb's Point–Deltoid)
R_AXIL_LAT_ED.description: Observable node representing the distal motor latency of the axillary nerve from Erb's point stimulation to the deltoid recording site.

R_DELT_VOL_ACT.name: Deltoid Voluntary Activation
R_DELT_VOL_ACT.description: Node representing the level of voluntary activation/effort applied during deltoid contraction in EMG examination.

R_DELT_FORCE.name: Deltoid Force
R_DELT_FORCE.description: Node representing the force generated by the deltoid muscle, determined by voluntary activation, effective muscle mass, and NMT integrity.

R_DELT_MUSCLE_VOL.name: Deltoid Muscle Volume
R_DELT_MUSCLE_VOL.description: Node representing the physical volume/bulk of the deltoid muscle, which influences force output and electrophysiological measurements.

R_DELT_MVA_RECRUIT.name: Deltoid Maximum Voluntary Activation Recruitment
R_DELT_MVA_RECRUIT.description: Observable node representing the recruitment pattern of motor units in the deltoid at maximum voluntary effort. Reduced recruitment suggests neurogenic loss; early/full recruitment with low force suggests myopathy.

R_DELT_MVA_AMP.name: Deltoid Maximum Voluntary Activation Amplitude
R_DELT_MVA_AMP.description: Observable node representing the amplitude of the EMG interference pattern in the deltoid at maximum voluntary effort.

R_DELT_TA_CONCL.name: Deltoid Turns/Amplitude Analysis Conclusion
R_DELT_TA_CONCL.description: Node representing the conclusion of turns–amplitude (interference pattern) analysis in the deltoid, classifying the pattern as normal, neurogenic, or myopathic.

R_DELT_MUPAMP.name: Deltoid MUP Amplitude
R_DELT_MUPAMP.description: Node representing the amplitude of motor unit potentials (MUPs) recorded in the deltoid during needle EMG.

R_DELT_QUAN_MUPAMP.name: Deltoid Quantitative MUP Amplitude
R_DELT_QUAN_MUPAMP.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured MUP amplitude in the deltoid (in microvolts).

R_DELT_QUAL_MUPAMP.name: Deltoid Qualitative MUP Amplitude
R_DELT_QUAL_MUPAMP.description: Observable node representing a qualitative (visual) assessment of MUP amplitude in the deltoid as low, normal, or high.

R_DELT_MUPDUR.name: Deltoid MUP Duration
R_DELT_MUPDUR.description: Node representing the duration of motor unit potentials in the deltoid. Long durations suggest chronic neurogenic change; short durations suggest myopathy.

R_DELT_QUAN_MUPDUR.name: Deltoid Quantitative MUP Duration
R_DELT_QUAN_MUPDUR.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured MUP duration in the deltoid (in milliseconds).

R_DELT_QUAL_MUPDUR.name: Deltoid Qualitative MUP Duration
R_DELT_QUAL_MUPDUR.description: Observable node representing a qualitative assessment of MUP duration in the deltoid as short, normal, or long.

R_DELT_QUAN_MUPPOLY.name: Deltoid Quantitative MUP Polyphasicity
R_DELT_QUAN_MUPPOLY.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured proportion of polyphasic MUPs in the deltoid.

R_DELT_QUAL_MUPPOLY.name: Deltoid Qualitative MUP Polyphasicity
R_DELT_QUAL_MUPPOLY.description: Observable node representing a qualitative assessment of polyphasicity of MUPs in the deltoid.

R_DELT_MUPSATEL.name: Deltoid MUP Satellite Potentials
R_DELT_MUPSATEL.description: Observable node representing the presence of satellite (linked) potentials on MUPs in the deltoid, indicating recent reinnervation by collateral sprouting.

R_DELT_MUPINSTAB.name: Deltoid MUP Instability
R_DELT_MUPINSTAB.description: Observable node representing the instability (jiggle) of MUPs in the deltoid on consecutive firings, indicating immature endplates or NMT abnormality.

R_DELT_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.name: Deltoid Repetitive Stimulation CMAP Amplitude
R_DELT_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.description: Observable node representing the deltoid CMAP amplitude obtained during repetitive nerve stimulation.

R_DELT_REPSTIM_DECR.name: Deltoid Repetitive Stimulation Decrement
R_DELT_REPSTIM_DECR.description: Observable node representing the percentage decrement of CMAP amplitude in the deltoid on slow repetitive nerve stimulation, characteristic of postsynaptic NMJ disorders.

R_DELT_REPSTIM_FACILI.name: Deltoid Repetitive Stimulation Facilitation
R_DELT_REPSTIM_FACILI.description: Observable node representing the facilitation (incremental response) of deltoid CMAP on high-frequency repetitive stimulation or post-exercise, characteristic of presynaptic NMJ disorders.

R_DELT_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.name: Deltoid Post-Activation Repetitive Stimulation Decrement
R_DELT_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.description: Observable node representing the post-exercise/post-activation decrement of CMAP amplitude in the deltoid during repetitive stimulation testing.

R_DELT_SF_JITTER.name: Deltoid Single-Fiber EMG Jitter
R_DELT_SF_JITTER.description: Observable node representing the temporal jitter between paired muscle fiber potentials on single-fiber EMG of the deltoid, a sensitive marker of neuromuscular transmission abnormality.

R_LNLPC5_DELT_MUDENS.name: C5/Upper Plexus Lesion Effect on Deltoid Fiber Density
R_LNLPC5_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a C5/upper plexus lesion on muscle fiber density in the deltoid as measured by single-fiber EMG. Reinnervation increases fiber density.

R_DIFFN_DELT_MUDENS.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid Fiber Density
R_DIFFN_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a diffuse neuropathy on muscle fiber density in the deltoid.

R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MUDENS.name: C5/Plexus and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid Fiber Density
R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of a C5/upper plexus lesion and a diffuse neuropathy on muscle fiber density in the deltoid.

R_MYOP_DELT_MUDENS.name: Myopathy Effect on Deltoid Fiber Density
R_MYOP_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a myopathy on muscle fiber density in the deltoid; fiber loss/regeneration can locally increase apparent fiber density.

R_MYDY_DELT_MUDENS.name: Myodystrophy Effect on Deltoid Fiber Density
R_MYDY_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of muscular dystrophy on muscle fiber density in the deltoid.

R_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_MUDENS.name: Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on Deltoid Fiber Density
R_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of myopathy and myodystrophy on muscle fiber density in the deltoid.

R_MYAS_DELT_MUDENS.name: Myasthenia Effect on Deltoid Fiber Density
R_MYAS_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of myasthenia (NMJ disorder) on apparent muscle fiber density in the deltoid measured by single-fiber EMG.

R_OTHER_DELT_MUDENS.name: Other Causes' Effect on Deltoid Fiber Density
R_OTHER_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of unspecified disease processes on muscle fiber density in the deltoid.

R_MYAS_OTHER_DELT_MUDENS.name: Myasthenia/Other Causes Effect on Deltoid Fiber Density
R_MYAS_OTHER_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining myasthenic and other miscellaneous contributions to deltoid muscle fiber density.

R_MUSCLE_DELT_MUDENS.name: Muscle Disease Effect on Deltoid Fiber Density
R_MUSCLE_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from primary muscle diseases to deltoid muscle fiber density.

R_DELT_MUDENS.name: Deltoid Muscle Fiber Density
R_DELT_MUDENS.description: Node representing the overall muscle fiber density in the deltoid, integrating all contributing disease processes. Increased density typically indicates collateral reinnervation.

R_DELT_SF_DENSITY.name: Deltoid Single-Fiber Density
R_DELT_SF_DENSITY.description: Observable node representing the fiber density measured by single-fiber EMG in the deltoid, quantifying the average number of muscle fiber action potentials per needle position within an MU territory.

R_LNLPC5_DELT_NEUR_ACT.name: C5/Upper Plexus Lesion Effect on Deltoid Neurogenic Activity
R_LNLPC5_DELT_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a C5/upper plexus lesion to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the deltoid.

R_DIFFN_DELT_NEUR_ACT.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid Neurogenic Activity
R_DIFFN_DELT_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse neuropathy to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the deltoid.

R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_NEUR_ACT.name: C5/Plexus and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid Neurogenic Activity
R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a C5/upper plexus lesion and a diffuse neuropathy to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the deltoid.

R_OTHER_DELT_NEUR_ACT.name: Other Causes' Effect on Deltoid Neurogenic Activity
R_OTHER_DELT_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of unspecified disease processes to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the deltoid.

R_DELT_NEUR_ACT.name: Deltoid Spontaneous Neurogenic Activity
R_DELT_NEUR_ACT.description: Node representing the overall level of abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity (e.g., fibrillations, positive sharp waves) in the deltoid, integrating contributions from all neurogenic disease sources.

R_DELT_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.name: Deltoid Spontaneous Neurogenic Discharges
R_DELT_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.description: Observable node representing spontaneous discharges (fibrillations, positive sharp waves, fasciculations) observed at rest during needle EMG of the deltoid.

R_MYOP_DELT_DENERV.name: Myopathy Effect on Deltoid Denervation
R_MYOP_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a myopathy to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the deltoid.

R_MYDY_DELT_DENERV.name: Myodystrophy Effect on Deltoid Denervation
R_MYDY_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of muscular dystrophy to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the deltoid.

R_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_DENERV.name: Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on Deltoid Denervation
R_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of myopathy and myodystrophy to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the deltoid.

R_OTHER_DELT_DENERV.name: Other Causes' Effect on Deltoid Denervation
R_OTHER_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of unspecified disease processes to denervation activity in the deltoid.

R_NMT_DELT_DENERV.name: NMT Effect on Deltoid Denervation
R_NMT_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of neuromuscular transmission disorders to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the deltoid.

R_OTHER_NMT_DELT_DENERV.name: Other and NMT Causes Effect on Deltoid Denervation
R_OTHER_NMT_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from miscellaneous causes and NMT disorders to denervation-like activity in the deltoid.

R_MUSCLE_DELT_DENERV.name: Muscle Disease Effect on Deltoid Denervation
R_MUSCLE_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of primary muscle diseases to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the deltoid.

R_LNLPC5_DELT_DENERV.name: C5/Upper Plexus Lesion Effect on Deltoid Denervation
R_LNLPC5_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a C5/upper plexus lesion to denervation activity in the deltoid.

R_DIFFN_DELT_DENERV.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid Denervation
R_DIFFN_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse neuropathy to denervation activity in the deltoid.

R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_DENERV.name: C5/Plexus and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Deltoid Denervation
R_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a C5/upper plexus lesion and a diffuse neuropathy to denervation activity in the deltoid.

R_DELT_DENERV.name: Deltoid Denervation
R_DELT_DENERV.description: Node representing the overall level of denervation in the deltoid, integrating contributions from all neurogenic and non-neurogenic causes. Drives the appearance of fibrillation potentials and positive sharp waves.

R_DELT_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.name: Deltoid Spontaneous Denervation Activity
R_DELT_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.description: Observable node representing the spontaneous denervation activity (e.g., fibrillation potentials, positive sharp waves) recorded at rest in the deltoid during needle EMG.

R_DELT_SPONT_HF_DISCH.name: Deltoid Spontaneous High-Frequency Discharges
R_DELT_SPONT_HF_DISCH.description: Observable node representing high-frequency spontaneous discharges (e.g., complex repetitive discharges, myotonic discharges) recorded at rest in the deltoid during needle EMG.

R_DELT_SPONT_INS_ACT.name: Deltoid Spontaneous Insertional Activity
R_DELT_SPONT_INS_ACT.description: Observable node representing the insertional activity in the deltoid as the EMG needle is moved. Increased activity suggests denervation/membrane instability; decreased suggests fibrosis or fatty replacement.

R_OTHER_ISCH_DISP.name: Other Causes' Effect on Sural Temporal Dispersion
R_OTHER_ISCH_DISP.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the sural sensory response attributable to unspecified or miscellaneous causes (sometimes labeled 'ischemic'/non-specific) other than the explicitly modeled lesions.

R_DIFFN_ISCH_DISP.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Sural Temporal Dispersion
R_DIFFN_ISCH_DISP.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the sural sensory response attributable to a diffuse neuropathy. Differential conduction velocities along fibers broaden the SNAP.

R_SUR_DISP_CA.name: Sural Temporal Dispersion (Calf–Ankle)
R_SUR_DISP_CA.description: Node representing the overall temporal dispersion of the sural sensory nerve action potential along the calf–ankle recording segment, integrating contributions from diffuse neuropathy and other causes.

R_OTHER_ISCH_BLOCK.name: Other Causes' Effect on Sural Conduction Block
R_OTHER_ISCH_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the sural nerve attributable to unspecified or miscellaneous causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions.

R_DIFFN_ISCH_BLOCK.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Sural Conduction Block
R_DIFFN_ISCH_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the sural nerve attributable to a diffuse (e.g., demyelinating) neuropathy.

R_SUR_BLOCK_CA.name: Sural Conduction Block (Calf–Ankle)
R_SUR_BLOCK_CA.description: Node representing the overall degree of conduction block in the sural nerve along the calf–ankle segment.

R_OTHER_ISCH_SALOSS.name: Other Causes' Effect on Sural Sensory Axon Loss
R_OTHER_ISCH_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing loss of sensory axons in the sural nerve attributable to unspecified or miscellaneous causes.

R_DIFFN_ISCH_SALOSS.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Sural Sensory Axon Loss
R_DIFFN_ISCH_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing loss of sensory axons in the sural nerve attributable to a diffuse neuropathy. Length-dependent neuropathies preferentially affect distal sensory nerves like the sural.

R_LNL_ISCH_SEV.name: Local Sural Lesion Severity
R_LNL_ISCH_SEV.description: Intermediate node representing the severity of a local lesion affecting the sural nerve. Drives the magnitude of associated sensory abnormalities.

R_LNL_ISCH_PATHO.name: Local Sural Lesion Pathophysiology
R_LNL_ISCH_PATHO.description: Intermediate node representing the pathophysiological character (demyelinating vs. axonal) of a local lesion affecting the sural nerve.

R_LNL_ISCH_SALOSS_CA.name: Local Sural Lesion Effect on Sensory Axon Loss (Calf–Ankle)
R_LNL_ISCH_SALOSS_CA.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a local sural nerve lesion to sensory axon loss along the calf–ankle segment.

R_DIFFN_LNL_ISCH_SALOSS.name: Diffuse Neuropathy and Local Lesion Effect on Sural Sensory Axon Loss
R_DIFFN_LNL_ISCH_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a diffuse neuropathy and a local sural lesion to sensory axon loss in the sural nerve.

R_SUR_SALOSS.name: Sural Sensory Axon Loss
R_SUR_SALOSS.description: Node representing the overall loss of sensory axons in the sural nerve, aggregating contributions from all relevant disease processes.

R_SUR_EFFAXLOSS.name: Sural Effective Axon Loss
R_SUR_EFFAXLOSS.description: Node representing the effective sensory axon loss in the sural nerve as relevant for SNAP amplitude generation, combining axon loss and conduction block.

R_SUR_ALLAMP_CA.name: Sural SNAP Amplitude Reduction (Calf–Ankle) — All Causes
R_SUR_ALLAMP_CA.description: Intermediate node aggregating all contributions to the reduction in amplitude of the sural sensory nerve action potential (SNAP) recorded along the calf–ankle segment.

R_SUR_AMP_CA.name: Sural SNAP Amplitude (Calf–Ankle)
R_SUR_AMP_CA.description: Observable node representing the measured SNAP amplitude of the sural nerve along the calf–ankle recording segment.

R_SUR_LD_CA.name: Sural Latency Difference (Calf–Ankle)
R_SUR_LD_CA.description: Node representing the latency difference along the calf–ankle segment of the sural nerve, used to characterize conduction along that segment.

R_SUR_RD_CA.name: Sural Response Duration (Calf–Ankle)
R_SUR_RD_CA.description: Node representing the duration of the sural SNAP measured across the calf–ankle segment, reflecting temporal dispersion.

R_SUR_LSLOW_CA.name: Sural Local Slowing (Calf–Ankle)
R_SUR_LSLOW_CA.description: Intermediate node representing local (uniform) slowing of conduction along the calf–ankle segment of the sural nerve.

R_OTHER_ISCH_DIFSLOW.name: Other Causes' Effect on Sural Differential Slowing
R_OTHER_ISCH_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing differential (non-uniform) slowing in the sural nerve attributable to unspecified or miscellaneous causes.

R_DIFFN_ISCH_DIFSLOW.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on Sural Differential Slowing
R_DIFFN_ISCH_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing differential slowing in the sural nerve attributable to a diffuse neuropathy, characteristic of acquired demyelinating processes.

R_SUR_DIFSLOW_CA.name: Sural Differential Slowing (Calf–Ankle)
R_SUR_DIFSLOW_CA.description: Node representing differential slowing of conduction along the calf–ankle segment of the sural nerve.

R_SUR_DSLOW_CA.name: Sural Distal Slowing (Calf–Ankle)
R_SUR_DSLOW_CA.description: Intermediate node representing the overall distal slowing along the calf–ankle segment of the sural nerve, integrating local and differential slowing components.

R_SUR_ALLCV_CA.name: Sural Conduction Velocity Reduction (Calf–Ankle) — All Causes
R_SUR_ALLCV_CA.description: Intermediate node aggregating all contributions to reduction of conduction velocity in the sural nerve along the calf–ankle segment.

R_SUR_CV_CA.name: Sural Conduction Velocity (Calf–Ankle)
R_SUR_CV_CA.description: Observable node representing the measured sensory conduction velocity of the sural nerve along the calf–ankle segment.

L_LNLW_MED_SEV.name: Left Median Nerve Severity from Wrist Lesion
L_LNLW_MED_SEV.description: Intermediate node representing the severity of damage to the left median nerve resulting from a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW), such as carpal tunnel syndrome.

L_LNLW_MED_PATHO.name: Left Median Nerve Pathophysiology from Wrist Lesion
L_LNLW_MED_PATHO.description: Intermediate node representing the pathophysiological character (demyelinating vs. axonal) of left median nerve damage caused by a local nerve lesion at the wrist.

L_LNLW_MEDD2_DISP_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Temporal Dispersion (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
L_LNLW_MEDD2_DISP_WD.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the left median sensory response recorded from digit 2 across the wrist–digit segment, attributable to a wrist lesion.

L_DIFFN_MEDD2_DISP.name: Left MEDD2 Temporal Dispersion from Diffuse Neuropathy
L_DIFFN_MEDD2_DISP.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the left median digit-2 sensory response attributable to a diffuse neuropathy.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_MEDD2_DISP_WD.name: Left MEDD2 (Wrist–Digit) Dispersion from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
L_DIFFN_LNLW_MEDD2_DISP_WD.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion to temporal dispersion of the left MEDD2 response across the wrist–digit segment.

L_MEDD2_DISP_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Temporal Dispersion (Wrist–Digit)
L_MEDD2_DISP_WD.description: Node representing the overall temporal dispersion of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the wrist–digit segment.

L_LNLBE_MEDD2_DISP_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Dispersion (Elbow–Wrist) from Below-Elbow Lesion
L_LNLBE_MEDD2_DISP_EW.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist segment, attributable to a local nerve lesion at/below the elbow (LNLBE).

L_MEDD2_DISP_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Temporal Dispersion (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MEDD2_DISP_EW.description: Node representing the overall temporal dispersion of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_MEDD2_DISP_EWD.name: Left MEDD2 Temporal Dispersion (Elbow–Wrist–Digit)
L_MEDD2_DISP_EWD.description: Node representing the overall temporal dispersion of the left median digit-2 sensory response over the full elbow–wrist–digit conduction path.

L_DIFFN_MEDD2_BLOCK.name: Left MEDD2 Conduction Block from Diffuse Neuropathy
L_DIFFN_MEDD2_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block of the left median digit-2 sensory response attributable to a diffuse neuropathy.

L_LNLBE_MEDD2_BLOCK_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Conduction Block (Elbow–Wrist) from Below-Elbow Lesion
L_LNLBE_MEDD2_BLOCK_EW.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist segment, attributable to a below-elbow lesion.

L_MEDD2_BLOCK_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Conduction Block (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MEDD2_BLOCK_EW.description: Node representing the overall degree of conduction block of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_MEDD2_AMPR_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Amplitude Ratio (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MEDD2_AMPR_EW.description: Observable node representing the amplitude ratio of the left median digit-2 sensory response between elbow and wrist stimulation sites, used to detect conduction block and dispersion.

L_LNLBE_MEDD2_LD_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Latency Difference (Elbow–Wrist) from Below-Elbow Lesion
L_LNLBE_MEDD2_LD_EW.description: Intermediate node representing the latency difference of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist segment, attributable to a below-elbow lesion.

L_MEDD2_LD_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Latency Difference (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MEDD2_LD_EW.description: Node representing the latency difference of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_LNLBE_MEDD2_RD_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Response Duration (Elbow–Wrist) from Below-Elbow Lesion
L_LNLBE_MEDD2_RD_EW.description: Intermediate node representing the increase in response duration of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist segment, attributable to a below-elbow lesion.

L_MEDD2_RD_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Response Duration (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MEDD2_RD_EW.description: Node representing the response duration of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the elbow–wrist segment, reflecting temporal dispersion.

L_MEDD2_LSLOW_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Local Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MEDD2_LSLOW_EW.description: Intermediate node representing local (uniform) slowing of conduction along the elbow–wrist segment in the left median digit-2 sensory pathway.

L_LNLW_MEDD2_SALOSS_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Sensory Axon Loss (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
L_LNLW_MEDD2_SALOSS_WD.description: Intermediate node representing loss of sensory axons in the left median digit-2 pathway across the wrist–digit segment, attributable to a wrist lesion.

L_DIFFN_MEDD2_SALOSS.name: Left MEDD2 Sensory Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy
L_DIFFN_MEDD2_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing loss of sensory axons in the left median digit-2 pathway attributable to a diffuse neuropathy.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_MEDD2_SALOSS.name: Left MEDD2 Sensory Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
L_DIFFN_LNLW_MEDD2_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion to sensory axon loss in the left median digit-2 pathway.

L_LNLBE_MEDD2_SALOSS_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Sensory Axon Loss (Elbow–Wrist) from Below-Elbow Lesion
L_LNLBE_MEDD2_SALOSS_EW.description: Intermediate node representing loss of sensory axons in the left median digit-2 pathway across the elbow–wrist segment, attributable to a below-elbow lesion.

L_MEDD2_SALOSS.name: Left MEDD2 Sensory Axon Loss
L_MEDD2_SALOSS.description: Node representing the overall loss of sensory axons in the left median digit-2 pathway, integrating contributions from all relevant disease processes.

L_DIFFN_MEDD2_DIFSLOW.name: Left MEDD2 Differential Slowing from Diffuse Neuropathy
L_DIFFN_MEDD2_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing differential (non-uniform) slowing of conduction in the left median digit-2 pathway attributable to a diffuse neuropathy.

L_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Differential Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_EW.description: Node representing differential slowing of conduction in the left median digit-2 pathway across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_MEDD2_DSLOW_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Distal Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MEDD2_DSLOW_EW.description: Intermediate node representing the overall slowing along the elbow–wrist segment in the left median digit-2 pathway, integrating local and differential slowing.

L_MEDD2_ALLCV_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Conduction Velocity Reduction (Elbow–Wrist) — All Causes
L_MEDD2_ALLCV_EW.description: Intermediate node aggregating all contributions to reduction of conduction velocity in the left median digit-2 pathway across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_MEDD2_CV_EW.name: Left MEDD2 Conduction Velocity (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MEDD2_CV_EW.description: Observable node representing the measured sensory conduction velocity of the left median digit-2 pathway across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_LNLW_MEDD2_BLOCK_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Conduction Block (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
L_LNLW_MEDD2_BLOCK_WD.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the wrist–digit segment, attributable to a wrist lesion.

L_MEDD2_BLOCK_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Conduction Block (Wrist–Digit)
L_MEDD2_BLOCK_WD.description: Node representing the overall degree of conduction block of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the wrist–digit segment.

L_MEDD2_EFFAXLOSS.name: Left MEDD2 Effective Axon Loss
L_MEDD2_EFFAXLOSS.description: Node representing the effective sensory axon loss in the left median digit-2 pathway as relevant for SNAP amplitude generation, combining axon loss and conduction block.

L_MEDD2_ALLAMP_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Amplitude Reduction (Wrist–Digit) — All Causes
L_MEDD2_ALLAMP_WD.description: Intermediate node aggregating all contributions to reduction of the left median digit-2 SNAP amplitude across the wrist–digit segment.

L_MEDD2_AMP_WD.name: Left MEDD2 SNAP Amplitude (Wrist–Digit)
L_MEDD2_AMP_WD.description: Observable node representing the measured amplitude of the left median digit-2 SNAP across the wrist–digit segment.

L_LNLW_MEDD2_LD_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Latency Difference (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
L_LNLW_MEDD2_LD_WD.description: Intermediate node representing the latency difference of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the wrist–digit segment, attributable to a wrist lesion.

L_MEDD2_LD_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Latency Difference (Wrist–Digit)
L_MEDD2_LD_WD.description: Node representing the latency difference of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the wrist–digit segment.

L_LNLW_MEDD2_RD_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Response Duration (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion
L_LNLW_MEDD2_RD_WD.description: Intermediate node representing the increase in response duration of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the wrist–digit segment, attributable to a wrist lesion.

L_MEDD2_RD_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Response Duration (Wrist–Digit)
L_MEDD2_RD_WD.description: Node representing the response duration of the left median digit-2 sensory response across the wrist–digit segment.

L_MEDD2_LSLOW_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Local Slowing (Wrist–Digit)
L_MEDD2_LSLOW_WD.description: Intermediate node representing local (uniform) slowing of conduction along the wrist–digit segment of the left median digit-2 pathway, typical of focal demyelination at the wrist.

L_LNLBE_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Differential Slowing (Wrist–Digit) from Below-Elbow Lesion
L_LNLBE_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_WD.description: Intermediate node representing differential slowing in the left median digit-2 pathway across the wrist–digit segment, attributable to a below-elbow lesion.

L_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Differential Slowing (Wrist–Digit)
L_MEDD2_DIFSLOW_WD.description: Node representing differential slowing of conduction in the left median digit-2 pathway across the wrist–digit segment.

L_MEDD2_DSLOW_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Distal Slowing (Wrist–Digit)
L_MEDD2_DSLOW_WD.description: Intermediate node representing the overall slowing along the wrist–digit segment in the left median digit-2 pathway, integrating local and differential slowing.

L_MEDD2_ALLCV_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Conduction Velocity Reduction (Wrist–Digit) — All Causes
L_MEDD2_ALLCV_WD.description: Intermediate node aggregating all contributions to reduction of conduction velocity in the left median digit-2 pathway across the wrist–digit segment.

L_MEDD2_CV_WD.name: Left MEDD2 Conduction Velocity (Wrist–Digit)
L_MEDD2_CV_WD.description: Observable node representing the measured sensory conduction velocity of the left median digit-2 pathway across the wrist–digit segment.

L_DIFFN_MED_BLOCK.name: Left Median Motor Conduction Block from Diffuse Neuropathy
L_DIFFN_MED_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing motor conduction block in the left median nerve attributable to a diffuse neuropathy.

L_LNLBE_MED_BLOCK.name: Left Median Motor Conduction Block from Below-Elbow Lesion
L_LNLBE_MED_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing motor conduction block in the left median nerve attributable to a local lesion at/below the elbow.

L_MED_BLOCK_EW.name: Left Median Motor Conduction Block (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MED_BLOCK_EW.description: Node representing the overall degree of motor conduction block in the left median nerve across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_MED_AMPR_EW.name: Left Median Motor Amplitude Ratio (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MED_AMPR_EW.description: Observable node representing the CMAP amplitude ratio of the left median nerve between elbow and wrist stimulation sites, used to detect motor conduction block.

L_LNLT1_APB_MALOSS.name: Left T1 Lesion Effect on APB Muscle Mass Loss
L_LNLT1_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the loss of effective muscle mass in the left abductor pollicis brevis (APB) attributable to a T1 root lesion.

L_LNLLP_APB_MALOSS.name: Left Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB Muscle Mass Loss
L_LNLLP_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the loss of effective muscle mass in the left APB attributable to a lower brachial plexus lesion.

L_LNLT1_LP_APB_MALOSS.name: Left T1/Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB Muscle Mass Loss
L_LNLT1_LP_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of T1 root and lower plexus lesions to muscle mass loss in the left APB.

L_LNLBE_APB_MALOSS.name: Left Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB Muscle Mass Loss
L_LNLBE_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the loss of effective muscle mass in the left APB attributable to a median nerve lesion at/below the elbow.

L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MALOSS.name: Left T1/Plexus/Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB Muscle Mass Loss
L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of T1 root, lower plexus, and below-elbow lesions to muscle mass loss in the left APB.

L_LNLW_APB_MALOSS.name: Left Wrist Lesion Effect on APB Muscle Mass Loss
L_LNLW_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the loss of effective muscle mass in the left APB attributable to a median nerve lesion at the wrist (carpal tunnel).

L_DIFFN_APB_MALOSS.name: Left Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on APB Muscle Mass Loss
L_DIFFN_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the loss of effective muscle mass in the left APB attributable to a diffuse neuropathy.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MALOSS.name: Left APB Muscle Mass Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion to muscle mass loss in the left APB.

L_APB_MALOSS.name: Left APB Muscle Mass Loss
L_APB_MALOSS.description: Node representing the overall loss of effective muscle mass in the left abductor pollicis brevis, integrating contributions from all relevant lesions and neuropathies.

L_DIFFN_MED_DIFSLOW.name: Left Median Motor Differential Slowing from Diffuse Neuropathy
L_DIFFN_MED_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing differential slowing of motor conduction in the left median nerve attributable to a diffuse neuropathy.

L_MED_DIFSLOW_EW.name: Left Median Motor Differential Slowing (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MED_DIFSLOW_EW.description: Node representing differential slowing of motor conduction in the left median nerve across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_MED_DCV_EW.name: Left Median Distal Conduction Velocity (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MED_DCV_EW.description: Observable node representing the distal motor conduction velocity of the left median nerve across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_MED_LD_EW.name: Left Median Motor Latency Difference (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MED_LD_EW.description: Node representing the latency difference of the left median motor response between elbow and wrist stimulation sites.

L_MED_RD_EW.name: Left Median Motor Response Duration (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MED_RD_EW.description: Node representing the increase in CMAP response duration of the left median nerve when stimulating at elbow versus wrist, reflecting temporal dispersion across the segment.

L_MED_RDLDCV_EW.name: Left Median Motor Response-Duration/Latency-Based CV (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MED_RDLDCV_EW.description: Intermediate node combining response-duration and latency-difference based measures into an overall delay/dispersion-derived conduction velocity indicator across the left median elbow–wrist segment.

L_MED_ALLCV_EW.name: Left Median Motor Conduction Velocity Reduction (Elbow–Wrist) — All Causes
L_MED_ALLCV_EW.description: Intermediate node aggregating all contributions to reduction of motor conduction velocity in the left median nerve across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_MED_CV_EW.name: Left Median Motor Conduction Velocity (Elbow–Wrist)
L_MED_CV_EW.description: Observable node representing the measured motor conduction velocity of the left median nerve across the elbow–wrist segment.

L_LNLT1_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left T1 Lesion Effect on APB Denervation/Reinnervation
L_LNLT1_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a T1 root lesion to ongoing denervation and reinnervation in the left abductor pollicis brevis.

L_LNLLP_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB De/Reinnervation
L_LNLLP_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a lower brachial plexus lesion to ongoing denervation and reinnervation in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_LP_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left T1/Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB De/Reinnervation
L_LNLT1_LP_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node aggregating the contributions of T1 root and lower plexus lesions to denervation/reinnervation activity in the left APB.

L_LNLBE_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB De/Reinnervation
L_LNLBE_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a median nerve lesion at/below the elbow to denervation/reinnervation activity in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left T1/Plexus/Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB De/Reinnervation
L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node aggregating the contributions of T1 root, lower plexus, and below-elbow lesions to denervation/reinnervation activity in the left APB.

L_DIFFN_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on APB De/Reinnervation
L_DIFFN_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse neuropathy to denervation/reinnervation activity in the left APB.

L_LNLW_MED_TIME.name: Left Median Wrist Lesion Temporal Stage
L_LNLW_MED_TIME.description: Intermediate node representing the temporal stage (acute, subacute, chronic) of a left median nerve lesion at the wrist. Determines whether observed findings reflect recent denervation versus chronic reinnervation.

L_LNLW_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left Wrist Lesion Effect on APB De/Reinnervation
L_LNLW_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a left median wrist lesion to ongoing denervation and reinnervation in the left APB.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left APB De/Reinnervation from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion to ongoing denervation and reinnervation in the left APB.

L_LNL_DIFFN_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left Local Nerve Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on APB De/Reinnervation
L_LNL_DIFFN_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from all local nerve lesions along the median pathway and from diffuse neuropathy to denervation/reinnervation activity in the left abductor pollicis brevis (APB).

L_MYOP_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left Myopathy Effect on APB De/Reinnervation
L_MYOP_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a myopathic process to apparent denervation/reinnervation activity in the left APB (e.g., regenerating muscle fibers after necrosis).

L_MYDY_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left Myodystrophy Effect on APB De/Reinnervation
L_MYDY_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of muscular dystrophy to apparent denervation/reinnervation activity in the left APB.

L_MYOP_MYDY_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on APB De/Reinnervation
L_MYOP_MYDY_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of myopathy and muscular dystrophy to denervation/reinnervation-like changes in the left APB.

L_APB_DE_REGEN.name: Left APB Denervation/Reinnervation
L_APB_DE_REGEN.description: Node representing the overall level of ongoing denervation and reinnervation in the left APB, integrating neurogenic and myopathic contributions. Drives features such as immature endplates and unstable MUPs.

L_DE_REGEN_APB_NMT.name: Left De/Reinnervation Effect on APB NMT
L_DE_REGEN_APB_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of ongoing denervation/reinnervation on neuromuscular transmission (NMT) in the left APB. Immature reinnervating endplates exhibit unreliable transmission and increased jitter.

L_MYAS_APB_NMT.name: Left Myasthenia Effect on APB NMT
L_MYAS_APB_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of myasthenia (NMJ disorder) on neuromuscular transmission in the left APB.

L_APB_NMT.name: Left APB Neuromuscular Transmission
L_APB_NMT.description: Node representing the overall integrity of neuromuscular transmission at the left APB, integrating contributions from NMJ disorders and ongoing reinnervation.

L_MYDY_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left Myodystrophy Effect on APB MU Size
L_MYDY_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of muscular dystrophy on motor unit size in the left APB. Loss of muscle fibers within MUs reduces MU size.

L_MYOP_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left Myopathy Effect on APB MU Size
L_MYOP_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a non-dystrophic myopathy on motor unit size in the left APB.

L_MYOP_MYDY_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on APB MU Size
L_MYOP_MYDY_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of myopathy and myodystrophy on motor unit size in the left APB.

L_LNLW_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left Wrist Lesion Effect on APB MU Size
L_LNLW_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a left median nerve lesion at the wrist on motor unit size in the left APB. Axonal loss with collateral reinnervation enlarges surviving MUs.

L_DIFFN_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on APB MU Size
L_DIFFN_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a diffuse neuropathy on motor unit size in the left APB. Chronic axonal loss with reinnervation enlarges surviving MUs.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left APB MU Size from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion to motor unit size in the left APB.

L_LNLBE_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB MU Size
