L_LNLBE_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a left median nerve lesion at/below the elbow on motor unit size in the left APB.

L_LNLLP_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB MU Size
L_LNLLP_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a left lower brachial plexus lesion on motor unit size in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left T1 Root Lesion Effect on APB MU Size
L_LNLT1_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a left T1 root lesion on motor unit size in the left APB (which is innervated by C8/T1 fibers via the median nerve).

L_LNLT1_LP_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left T1/Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB MU Size
L_LNLT1_LP_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of T1 root and lower plexus lesions to motor unit size in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left T1/Plexus/Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB MU Size
L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of T1 root, lower plexus, and below-elbow median lesions to motor unit size in the left APB.

L_LNL_DIFFN_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left Local Nerve Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on APB MU Size
L_LNL_DIFFN_APB_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of all local nerve lesions along the median pathway and diffuse neuropathy to motor unit size in the left APB.

L_APB_MUSIZE.name: Left APB Motor Unit Size
L_APB_MUSIZE.description: Node representing the average motor unit size in the left APB, integrating all neurogenic and myopathic contributions.

L_APB_EFFMUS.name: Left APB Effective Muscle Mass
L_APB_EFFMUS.description: Node representing the effective contractile/electrical muscle mass of the left APB, combining motor unit count and motor unit size. Drives the median CMAP amplitude recorded from APB.

L_LNLW_MED_BLOCK.name: Left Median Conduction Block from Wrist Lesion
L_LNLW_MED_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing motor conduction block in the left median nerve attributable to a wrist lesion (e.g., severe carpal tunnel syndrome with focal demyelination).

L_MED_BLOCK_WA.name: Left Median Motor Conduction Block (Wrist–Above)
L_MED_BLOCK_WA.description: Node representing the overall degree of motor conduction block in the left median nerve between distal (wrist) and proximal (above-wrist) stimulation sites.

L_APB_MULOSS.name: Left APB Motor Unit Loss
L_APB_MULOSS.description: Node representing the loss of functioning motor units innervating the left APB. Reduced MU count contributes to lowered CMAP amplitude and altered recruitment.

L_APB_ALLAMP_WA.name: Left APB CMAP Amplitude Reduction (Wrist–Above) — All Causes
L_APB_ALLAMP_WA.description: Intermediate node aggregating all sources of CMAP amplitude reduction at the left APB with stimulation between wrist and proximal sites, including motor unit loss, conduction block, and reduced effective muscle mass.

L_MED_AMP_WA.name: Left Median CMAP Amplitude (Wrist–Above)
L_MED_AMP_WA.description: Observable node representing the measured CMAP amplitude recorded from the left APB after median nerve stimulation, comparing wrist and above-wrist stimulation sites.

L_MED_LD_WA.name: Left Median Latency Difference (Wrist–Above)
L_MED_LD_WA.description: Node representing the latency difference of the left median CMAP between wrist and above-wrist stimulation sites, used to assess conduction velocity along that segment.

L_MED_RD_WA.name: Left Median Response Duration (Wrist–Above)
L_MED_RD_WA.description: Node representing the increase in CMAP response duration of the left median nerve when stimulating proximally versus at the wrist, reflecting temporal dispersion.

L_MED_RDLDDEL.name: Left Median Response Duration/Latency Delay
L_MED_RDLDDEL.description: Intermediate node combining response-duration and latency-difference based measures into an overall delay/dispersion indicator for the left median nerve segment.

L_LNLBE_MED_DIFSLOW.name: Left Median Differential Slowing from Below-Elbow Lesion
L_LNLBE_MED_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing differential (non-uniform) slowing of motor conduction in the left median nerve attributable to a lesion at/below the elbow.

L_MED_DIFSLOW_WA.name: Left Median Differential Slowing (Wrist–Above)
L_MED_DIFSLOW_WA.description: Intermediate node representing differential slowing of motor conduction in the left median nerve between wrist and above-wrist sites, characteristic of acquired demyelinating neuropathies.

L_MED_DCV_WA.name: Left Median Distal Conduction Velocity (Wrist–Above)
L_MED_DCV_WA.description: Observable node representing the distal motor conduction velocity of the left median nerve computed from the wrist–above-wrist segment.

L_MED_ALLDEL_WA.name: Left Median Total Conduction Delay (Wrist–Above) — All Causes
L_MED_ALLDEL_WA.description: Intermediate node aggregating all contributions to delayed conduction in the left median nerve between wrist and above-wrist stimulation sites.

L_MED_LAT_WA.name: Left Median Distal Motor Latency (Wrist–Above)
L_MED_LAT_WA.description: Observable node representing the distal motor latency of the left median nerve from wrist or above-wrist stimulation to the APB recording site.

L_APB_VOL_ACT.name: Left APB Voluntary Activation
L_APB_VOL_ACT.description: Node representing the level of voluntary activation/effort applied during contraction of the left APB during EMG examination.

L_APB_FORCE.name: Left APB Force
L_APB_FORCE.description: Node representing the force generated by the left APB, determined by voluntary activation, effective muscle mass, and NMT integrity.

L_APB_MUSCLE_VOL.name: Left APB Muscle Volume
L_APB_MUSCLE_VOL.description: Node representing the physical volume/bulk of the left APB muscle, which influences force output and electrophysiological measurements.

L_APB_MVA_RECRUIT.name: Left APB Maximum Voluntary Activation Recruitment
L_APB_MVA_RECRUIT.description: Observable node representing the recruitment pattern of motor units in the left APB at maximum voluntary effort. Reduced recruitment suggests neurogenic loss; early/full recruitment with low force suggests myopathy.

L_APB_MVA_AMP.name: Left APB Maximum Voluntary Activation Amplitude
L_APB_MVA_AMP.description: Observable node representing the amplitude of the EMG interference pattern in the left APB at maximum voluntary effort.

L_APB_TA_CONCL.name: Left APB Turns/Amplitude Analysis Conclusion
L_APB_TA_CONCL.description: Node representing the conclusion of turns–amplitude (interference pattern) analysis on the left APB, classifying the pattern as normal, neurogenic, or myopathic.

L_APB_MUPAMP.name: Left APB MUP Amplitude
L_APB_MUPAMP.description: Node representing the amplitude of motor unit potentials (MUPs) recorded from the left APB during needle EMG.

L_APB_QUAN_MUPAMP.name: Left APB Quantitative MUP Amplitude
L_APB_QUAN_MUPAMP.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured MUP amplitude in the left APB (in microvolts).

L_APB_QUAL_MUPAMP.name: Left APB Qualitative MUP Amplitude
L_APB_QUAL_MUPAMP.description: Observable node representing a qualitative (visual) assessment of MUP amplitude in the left APB as low, normal, or high.

L_APB_MUPDUR.name: Left APB MUP Duration
L_APB_MUPDUR.description: Node representing the duration of motor unit potentials in the left APB. Long durations suggest chronic neurogenic change; short durations suggest myopathy.

L_APB_QUAN_MUPDUR.name: Left APB Quantitative MUP Duration
L_APB_QUAN_MUPDUR.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured MUP duration in the left APB (in milliseconds).

L_APB_QUAL_MUPDUR.name: Left APB Qualitative MUP Duration
L_APB_QUAL_MUPDUR.description: Observable node representing a qualitative assessment of MUP duration in the left APB as short, normal, or long.

L_APB_QUAN_MUPPOLY.name: Left APB Quantitative MUP Polyphasicity
L_APB_QUAN_MUPPOLY.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured proportion of polyphasic MUPs in the left APB.

L_APB_QUAL_MUPPOLY.name: Left APB Qualitative MUP Polyphasicity
L_APB_QUAL_MUPPOLY.description: Observable node representing a qualitative assessment of polyphasicity of MUPs in the left APB.

L_APB_MUPSATEL.name: Left APB MUP Satellite Potentials
L_APB_MUPSATEL.description: Observable node representing the presence of satellite (linked) potentials on MUPs in the left APB, an indicator of recent reinnervation by collateral sprouting.

L_APB_MUPINSTAB.name: Left APB MUP Instability
L_APB_MUPINSTAB.description: Observable node representing the instability (jiggle) of MUPs in the left APB on consecutive firings, indicating immature endplates or NMT abnormality.

L_APB_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.name: Left APB Repetitive Stimulation CMAP Amplitude
L_APB_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.description: Observable node representing the CMAP amplitude obtained from the left APB during repetitive nerve stimulation testing.

L_APB_REPSTIM_DECR.name: Left APB Repetitive Stimulation Decrement
L_APB_REPSTIM_DECR.description: Observable node representing the percentage decrement of CMAP amplitude in the left APB on slow repetitive nerve stimulation, characteristic of postsynaptic NMJ disorders.

L_APB_REPSTIM_FACILI.name: Left APB Repetitive Stimulation Facilitation
L_APB_REPSTIM_FACILI.description: Observable node representing CMAP facilitation (incremental response) on high-frequency repetitive stimulation or post-exercise in the left APB, characteristic of presynaptic NMJ disorders.

L_APB_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.name: Left APB Post-Activation Repetitive Stimulation Decrement
L_APB_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.description: Observable node representing the post-exercise/post-activation decrement of CMAP amplitude in the left APB during repetitive stimulation testing.

L_APB_SF_JITTER.name: Left APB Single-Fiber EMG Jitter
L_APB_SF_JITTER.description: Observable node representing the temporal jitter between paired muscle fiber potentials on single-fiber EMG of the left APB, a sensitive marker of neuromuscular transmission abnormality.

L_LNLT1_APB_MUDENS.name: Left T1 Lesion Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_LNLT1_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a left T1 root lesion on muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_LNLLP_APB_MUDENS.name: Left Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_LNLLP_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a left lower brachial plexus lesion on muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_LP_APB_MUDENS.name: Left T1/Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_LNLT1_LP_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating effects of T1 root and lower plexus lesions on muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_LNLBE_APB_MUDENS.name: Left Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_LNLBE_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a left median nerve lesion at/below the elbow on muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MUDENS.name: Left T1/Plexus/Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating effects of T1 root, lower plexus, and below-elbow median lesions on muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_DIFFN_APB_MUDENS.name: Left Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_DIFFN_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a diffuse neuropathy on muscle fiber density in the left APB. Chronic reinnervation increases fiber density.

L_LNLW_APB_MUDENS.name: Left Wrist Lesion Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_LNLW_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a left median nerve lesion at the wrist on muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MUDENS.name: Left APB Fiber Density from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining effects of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion on muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_LNL_DIFFN_APB_MUDENS.name: Left Local Nerve Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_LNL_DIFFN_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of all local nerve lesions along the median pathway and diffuse neuropathy to muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_MYOP_APB_MUDENS.name: Left Myopathy Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_MYOP_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of a myopathy on muscle fiber density in the left APB; fiber loss/regeneration can locally increase apparent fiber density.

L_MYDY_APB_MUDENS.name: Left Myodystrophy Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_MYDY_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of muscular dystrophy on muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_MYOP_MYDY_APB_MUDENS.name: Left Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_MYOP_MYDY_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of myopathy and myodystrophy on muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_MYAS_APB_MUDENS.name: Left Myasthenia Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_MYAS_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the effect of myasthenia (NMJ disorder) on apparent muscle fiber density in the left APB measured by single-fiber EMG.

L_MUSCLE_APB_MUDENS.name: Left Muscle Disease Effect on APB Fiber Density
L_MUSCLE_APB_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from primary muscle diseases (myopathy, dystrophy, myasthenic effects) to muscle fiber density in the left APB.

L_APB_MUDENS.name: Left APB Muscle Fiber Density
L_APB_MUDENS.description: Node representing the overall muscle fiber density in the left APB, integrating all contributing disease processes. Increased density typically indicates collateral reinnervation.

L_APB_SF_DENSITY.name: Left APB Single-Fiber Density
L_APB_SF_DENSITY.description: Observable node representing the fiber density measured by single-fiber EMG in the left APB, the average number of muscle fiber action potentials per needle position within an MU territory.

L_LNLT1_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: Left T1 Lesion Effect on APB Neurogenic Activity
L_LNLT1_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a left T1 root lesion to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the left APB.

L_LNLLP_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: Left Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB Neurogenic Activity
L_LNLLP_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a left lower plexus lesion to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_LP_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: Left T1/Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB Neurogenic Activity
L_LNLT1_LP_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of T1 root and lower plexus lesions to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the left APB.

L_LNLBE_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: Left Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB Neurogenic Activity
L_LNLBE_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a left median nerve lesion at/below the elbow to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: Left T1/Plexus/Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB Neurogenic Activity
L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from T1 root, lower plexus, and below-elbow median lesions to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the left APB.

L_DIFFN_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: Left Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on APB Neurogenic Activity
L_DIFFN_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse neuropathy to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the left APB.

L_LNLW_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: Left Wrist Lesion Effect on APB Neurogenic Activity
L_LNLW_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a left median wrist lesion to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the left APB.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: Left APB Neurogenic Activity from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion to abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity in the left APB.

L_APB_NEUR_ACT.name: Left APB Spontaneous Neurogenic Activity
L_APB_NEUR_ACT.description: Node representing the overall level of abnormal spontaneous neurogenic activity (e.g., fibrillations, positive sharp waves) in the left APB, integrating contributions from all neurogenic disease sources.

L_APB_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.name: Left APB Spontaneous Neurogenic Discharges
L_APB_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.description: Observable node representing spontaneous discharges (fibrillations, positive sharp waves, fasciculations) observed at rest during needle EMG of the left APB.

L_MYOP_APB_DENERV.name: Left Myopathy Effect on APB Denervation
L_MYOP_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a myopathy to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the left APB.

L_MYDY_APB_DENERV.name: Left Myodystrophy Effect on APB Denervation
L_MYDY_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of muscular dystrophy to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the left APB.

L_MYOP_MYDY_APB_DENERV.name: Left Myopathy/Myodystrophy Effect on APB Denervation
L_MYOP_MYDY_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of myopathy and myodystrophy to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the left APB.

L_NMT_APB_DENERV.name: Left NMT Effect on APB Denervation
L_NMT_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of neuromuscular transmission disorders to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the left APB.

L_MUSCLE_APB_DENERV.name: Left Muscle Disease Effect on APB Denervation
L_MUSCLE_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of primary muscle diseases and NMT disorders to denervation-like spontaneous activity in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_APB_DENERV.name: Left T1 Lesion Effect on APB Denervation
L_LNLT1_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a left T1 root lesion to denervation activity in the left APB.

L_LNLLP_APB_DENERV.name: Left Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB Denervation
L_LNLLP_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a left lower plexus lesion to denervation activity in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_LP_APB_DENERV.name: Left T1/Lower Plexus Lesion Effect on APB Denervation
L_LNLT1_LP_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of T1 root and lower plexus lesions to denervation activity in the left APB.

L_LNLBE_APB_DENERV.name: Left Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB Denervation
L_LNLBE_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a left median nerve lesion at/below the elbow to denervation activity in the left APB.

L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_DENERV.name: Left T1/Plexus/Below-Elbow Lesion Effect on APB Denervation
L_LNLT1_LP_BE_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions of T1 root, lower plexus, and below-elbow median lesions to denervation activity in the left APB.

L_DIFFN_APB_DENERV.name: Left Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on APB Denervation
L_DIFFN_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse neuropathy to denervation activity in the left APB.

L_LNLW_APB_DENERV.name: Left Wrist Lesion Effect on APB Denervation
L_LNLW_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a left median wrist lesion to denervation activity in the left APB.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_DENERV.name: Left APB Denervation from Diffuse Neuropathy and Wrist Lesion
L_DIFFN_LNLW_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of diffuse neuropathy and a wrist lesion to denervation activity in the left APB.

L_LNL_DIFFN_APB_DENERV.name: Left Local Nerve Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy Effect on APB Denervation
L_LNL_DIFFN_APB_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating contributions from all local nerve lesions along the median pathway and diffuse neuropathy to denervation activity in the left APB.

L_APB_DENERV.name: Left APB Denervation
L_APB_DENERV.description: Node representing the overall level of denervation in the left APB, integrating contributions from all neurogenic and non-neurogenic causes. Drives the appearance of fibrillation potentials and positive sharp waves on needle EMG.

L_APB_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.name: Left APB Spontaneous Denervation Activity
L_APB_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.description: Observable node representing the spontaneous denervation activity (e.g., fibrillation potentials, positive sharp waves) recorded at rest in the left APB during needle EMG.

L_APB_SPONT_HF_DISCH.name: Left APB Spontaneous High-Frequency Discharges
L_APB_SPONT_HF_DISCH.description: Observable node representing high-frequency spontaneous discharges (e.g., complex repetitive discharges, myotonic discharges) recorded at rest in the left APB during needle EMG.

L_APB_SPONT_INS_ACT.name: Left APB Spontaneous Insertional Activity
L_APB_SPONT_INS_ACT.description: Observable node representing the insertional activity in the left APB as the EMG needle is moved. Increased activity suggests denervation/membrane instability; decreased suggests fibrosis or fatty replacement.

L_OTHER_ULND5_DISP.name: Other Causes of ULND5 Temporal Dispersion (Left)
L_OTHER_ULND5_DISP.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the ulnar nerve sensory response recorded from digit 5 (ULND5) on the left side, attributable to causes other than the explicitly modeled nerve lesions and diffuse neuropathy. Captures background or unmodeled sources of dispersion.

L_DIFFN_ULND5_DISP.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to ULND5 Dispersion (Left)
L_DIFFN_ULND5_DISP.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to temporal dispersion of the left ulnar sensory response recorded from digit 5 (ULND5). Reflects how generalized demyelinating processes broaden the sensory action potential.

L_LNLE_ULN_SEV.name: Ulnar Nerve Severity from Elbow Lesion (Left)
L_LNLE_ULN_SEV.description: Intermediate node representing the severity of damage to the left ulnar nerve resulting from a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE), such as cubital tunnel syndrome. Combines the presence and severity of the elbow lesion into a measure of how severely the ulnar nerve is affected at that site.

L_LNLE_ULN_PATHO.name: Ulnar Nerve Pathophysiology from Elbow Lesion (Left)
L_LNLE_ULN_PATHO.description: Intermediate node representing the pathophysiological character (e.g., demyelinating vs. axonal) of left ulnar nerve damage caused by a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE). Determines the type of electrophysiological abnormalities expected downstream.

L_LNLE_ULND5_DISP_E.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion at Elbow from Elbow Lesion (Left)
L_LNLE_ULND5_DISP_E.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion in the left ulnar sensory response from digit 5 (ULND5) measured across the elbow segment (E), attributable to a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE). Reflects how a focal demyelinating elbow lesion broadens the sensory action potential at that segment.

L_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_DISP_E.name: ULND5 Dispersion at Elbow from Combined Elbow Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_DISP_E.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE) and diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to temporal dispersion of the left ULND5 sensory response across the elbow segment (E). Models the joint effect of focal and generalized demyelinating processes.

L_ULND5_DISP_E.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion at Elbow Segment (Left)
L_ULND5_DISP_E.description: Aggregate node representing total temporal dispersion of the left ulnar sensory response from digit 5 (ULND5) measured across the elbow segment (E), integrating contributions from elbow lesions, diffuse neuropathy, and other causes.

L_LNLW_ULND5_DISP_WD.name: ULND5 Dispersion (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion (Left)
L_LNLW_ULND5_DISP_WD.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the left ULND5 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment, attributable to a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW). Reflects how a focal demyelinating wrist lesion broadens the sensory action potential.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_ULND5_DISP_WD.name: ULND5 Dispersion (Wrist–Digit) from Wrist Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_DIFFN_LNLW_ULND5_DISP_WD.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW) and a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) on temporal dispersion of the left ULND5 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment.

L_ULND5_DISP_WD.name: ULND5 Temporal Dispersion at Wrist–Digit Segment (Left)
L_ULND5_DISP_WD.description: Aggregate node representing total temporal dispersion of the left ULND5 sensory response across the wrist–digit (WD) segment, combining contributions from the wrist lesion, diffuse neuropathy, and other causes.

L_ULND5_DISP_BEW.name: ULND5 Dispersion Below-Elbow to Wrist (Left)
L_ULND5_DISP_BEW.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the left ULND5 sensory response measured across the below-elbow to wrist (BEW) segment, integrating segmental contributions along that portion of the ulnar nerve.

L_ULND5_DISP_BED.name: ULND5 Dispersion Below-Elbow to Digit (Left)
L_ULND5_DISP_BED.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the left ULND5 sensory response measured across the below-elbow to digit (BED) segment, combining wrist–digit and below-elbow to wrist contributions.

L_ULND5_DISP_EED.name: ULND5 Dispersion Elbow to Digit (Left)
L_ULND5_DISP_EED.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the left ULND5 sensory response measured across the entire elbow-to-digit (EED) segment, integrating contributions from all underlying segments.

L_OTHER_ULND5_BLOCK.name: Other Causes of ULND5 Conduction Block (Left)
L_OTHER_ULND5_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the left ULND5 sensory response attributable to causes other than the explicitly modeled focal lesions and diffuse neuropathy. Captures background sources of conduction failure.

L_DIFFN_ULND5_BLOCK.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to ULND5 Conduction Block (Left)
L_DIFFN_ULND5_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to conduction block in the left ULND5 sensory response. Reflects how generalized demyelinating processes can cause failure of action potential propagation.

L_LNLE_ULND5_BLOCK_E.name: ULND5 Conduction Block at Elbow from Elbow Lesion (Left)
L_LNLE_ULND5_BLOCK_E.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the left ULND5 sensory response across the elbow segment (E), attributable to a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE).

L_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_BLOCK_E.name: ULND5 Block at Elbow from Combined Elbow Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_BLOCK_E.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE) and diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to conduction block in the left ULND5 sensory response across the elbow segment (E).

L_ULND5_BLOCK_E.name: ULND5 Conduction Block at Elbow Segment (Left)
L_ULND5_BLOCK_E.description: Aggregate node representing total conduction block in the left ULND5 sensory response across the elbow segment (E), integrating contributions from elbow lesions, diffuse neuropathy, and other causes.

L_ULND5_AMPR_E.name: ULND5 Amplitude Ratio at Elbow Segment (Left)
L_ULND5_AMPR_E.description: Intermediate node representing the amplitude ratio of the left ULND5 sensory response across the elbow segment (E). Used to detect conduction block, where a drop in amplitude across the segment indicates failure of fibers to conduct through the elbow.

L_OTHER_ULND5_LD.name: Other Causes of ULND5 Long-Latency Distal Slowing (Left)
L_OTHER_ULND5_LD.description: Intermediate node representing long-distance distal slowing (LD) of the left ULND5 sensory response from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions. Captures unmodeled background contributions.

L_LNLE_ULND5_LD_E.name: ULND5 Long-Distance Slowing at Elbow from Elbow Lesion (Left)
L_LNLE_ULND5_LD_E.description: Intermediate node representing long-distance (LD) slowing of the left ULND5 sensory response at the elbow segment (E), attributable to a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE).

L_ULND5_LD_E.name: ULND5 Long-Distance Slowing at Elbow Segment (Left)
L_ULND5_LD_E.description: Aggregate node representing total long-distance (LD) conduction slowing of the left ULND5 sensory response across the elbow segment (E), integrating contributions from elbow lesions and other causes.

L_OTHER_ULND5_RD.name: Other Causes of ULND5 Restricted-Distance Slowing (Left)
L_OTHER_ULND5_RD.description: Intermediate node representing restricted-distance (RD) slowing of the left ULND5 sensory response attributable to causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions. Captures unmodeled background contributions to focal slowing.

L_LNLE_ULND5_RD_E.name: ULND5 Restricted-Distance Slowing at Elbow from Elbow Lesion (Left)
L_LNLE_ULND5_RD_E.description: Intermediate node representing restricted-distance (RD) slowing of the left ULND5 sensory response at the elbow segment (E), attributable to a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE). Reflects focal slowing concentrated within the lesion site.

L_ULND5_RD_E.name: ULND5 Restricted-Distance Slowing at Elbow Segment (Left)
L_ULND5_RD_E.description: Aggregate node representing total restricted-distance (RD) conduction slowing of the left ULND5 sensory response across the elbow segment (E), integrating contributions from elbow lesions and other causes.

L_ULND5_LSLOW_E.name: ULND5 Local Slowing at Elbow Segment (Left)
L_ULND5_LSLOW_E.description: Intermediate node representing local conduction slowing of the left ULND5 sensory response at the elbow segment (E), derived from restricted-distance and long-distance slowing components. Indicates focal demyelinating slowing at the elbow.

L_OTHER_ULND5_SALOSS.name: Other Causes of ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss (Left)
L_OTHER_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing loss of sensory axons (SALOSS) in the left ulnar nerve to digit 5 from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions and neuropathies. Captures unmodeled background sources of axonal loss.

L_LNLW_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Wrist Lesion (Left)
L_LNLW_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing loss of sensory axons in the left ULND5 pathway attributable to a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW). Reflects axonal damage from a focal lesion at the wrist.

L_DIFFN_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_DIFFN_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing loss of sensory axons in the left ULND5 pathway attributable to a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN). Reflects generalized axonal damage along the nerve.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Combined Wrist Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_DIFFN_LNLW_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW) and a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to sensory axon loss in the left ULND5 pathway.

L_LNLE_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Elbow Lesion (Left)
L_LNLE_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing loss of sensory axons in the left ULND5 pathway attributable to a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE). Reflects axonal damage from a focal lesion at the elbow.

L_LNLLP_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Lower Plexus Lesion (Left)
L_LNLLP_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing loss of sensory axons in the left ULND5 pathway attributable to a local nerve lesion at the lower brachial plexus (LNLLP). Reflects axonal damage from a focal lesion proximal to the elbow.

L_LNLLP_E_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Combined Lower Plexus and Elbow Lesions (Left)
L_LNLLP_E_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a lower brachial plexus lesion (LNLLP) and a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE) to sensory axon loss in the left ULND5 pathway.

L_LNL_DIFFN_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Sensory Axon Loss from Combined Local Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_LNL_DIFFN_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of local nerve lesions (LNL, e.g., wrist, elbow, plexus) with diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to overall sensory axon loss in the left ULND5 pathway.

L_ULND5_SALOSS.name: ULND5 Total Sensory Axon Loss (Left)
L_ULND5_SALOSS.description: Aggregate node representing the total loss of sensory axons in the left ULND5 pathway, integrating contributions from wrist lesions, elbow lesions, lower plexus lesions, diffuse neuropathy, and other causes.

L_OTHER_ULND5_DIFSLOW.name: Other Causes of ULND5 Diffuse Slowing (Left)
L_OTHER_ULND5_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse conduction slowing (DIFSLOW) along the left ULND5 pathway from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions and neuropathy. Captures unmodeled background sources of generalized slowing.

L_LNLE_ULND5_DIFSLOW.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing from Elbow Lesion (Left)
L_LNLE_ULND5_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse conduction slowing (DIFSLOW) of the left ULND5 sensory response attributable to a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE), reflecting how a focal lesion can induce broader slowing effects.

L_DIFFN_ULND5_DIFSLOW.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing from Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_DIFFN_ULND5_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse conduction slowing (DIFSLOW) of the left ULND5 sensory response attributable to a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN). Reflects generalized demyelinating slowing along the entire nerve.

L_LNLE_DIFFN_ULND5_DIFSLOW_E.name: ULND5 Diffuse Slowing at Elbow from Combined Elbow Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
