L_LNLE_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing reduced size (MUSIZE) of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle attributable to a local nerve lesion at the elbow (LNLE), reflecting neurogenic atrophy.

L_LNLLP_ADM_MUSIZE.name: ADM Muscle Size from Lower Plexus Lesion (Left)
L_LNLLP_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing reduced size (MUSIZE) of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle attributable to a local nerve lesion at the lower brachial plexus (LNLLP).

L_LNLC8_ADM_MUSIZE.name: ADM Muscle Size from C8 Root Lesion (Left)
L_LNLC8_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing reduced size (MUSIZE) of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle attributable to a local nerve lesion at the C8 nerve root (LNLC8).

L_LNLC8_LP_ADM_MUSIZE.name: ADM Muscle Size from Combined C8 and Lower Plexus Lesions (Left)
L_LNLC8_LP_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a C8 root lesion (LNLC8) and a lower plexus lesion (LNLLP) to reduced size (MUSIZE) of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_MUSIZE.name: ADM Muscle Size from Combined C8, Lower Plexus, and Elbow Lesions (Left)
L_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of C8 root, lower plexus, and elbow lesions to reduced size (MUSIZE) of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_MUSIZE.name: ADM Muscle Size from Combined Local Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of all local nerve lesions (LNL) and diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to reduced size (MUSIZE) of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_ADM_MUSIZE.name: ADM Total Muscle Size (Left)
L_ADM_MUSIZE.description: Aggregate node representing the total size (MUSIZE) of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle, integrating contributions from local nerve lesions, diffuse neuropathy, muscle disease, and other causes of atrophy or hypertrophy.

L_ADM_EFFMUS.name: ADM Effective Muscle (Left)
L_ADM_EFFMUS.description: Intermediate node representing the effective muscle bulk and function of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), combining muscle size and the residual functioning fibers available to generate motor responses.

L_OTHER_ULN_BLOCK_WA.name: Other Causes of Ulnar Nerve Block Wrist–ADM (Left)
L_OTHER_ULN_BLOCK_WA.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the left ulnar motor nerve across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions and neuropathies. Captures unmodeled background sources.

L_LNLW_ULN_BLOCK.name: Ulnar Nerve Conduction Block from Wrist Lesion (Left)
L_LNLW_ULN_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the left ulnar motor nerve attributable to a local nerve lesion at the wrist (LNLW), such as a deep ulnar branch lesion causing demyelinating block.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_ULN_BLOCK_WA.name: Ulnar Nerve Block Wrist–ADM from Combined Wrist Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_DIFFN_LNLW_ULN_BLOCK_WA.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a wrist lesion (LNLW) and a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to conduction block in the left ulnar motor nerve across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment.

L_ULN_BLOCK_WA.name: Ulnar Nerve Conduction Block at Wrist–ADM Segment (Left)
L_ULN_BLOCK_WA.description: Aggregate node representing total conduction block in the left ulnar motor nerve across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment, integrating contributions from wrist lesions, diffuse neuropathy, and other causes.

L_ADM_MULOSS.name: ADM Motor Unit Loss (Left)
L_ADM_MULOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the loss of functional motor units (MULOSS) supplying the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle, integrating effective axon loss and conduction block effects.

L_ADM_ALLAMP_WA.name: ADM Combined Amplitude Effects Wrist–ADM (Left)
L_ADM_ALLAMP_WA.description: Intermediate node integrating all factors influencing the amplitude of the left ulnar motor response recorded at the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment, including motor unit loss, effective muscle, and dispersion.

L_ULN_AMP_WA.name: Ulnar Nerve Amplitude Wrist–ADM (Left)
L_ULN_AMP_WA.description: Observable node representing the measured amplitude of the left ulnar motor response recorded from the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) following stimulation across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment.

L_ULN_LD_WA.name: Ulnar Nerve Long-Distance Slowing Wrist–ADM (Left)
L_ULN_LD_WA.description: Intermediate node representing long-distance (LD) conduction slowing of the left ulnar motor nerve across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment.

L_ULN_RD_WA.name: Ulnar Nerve Restricted-Distance Slowing Wrist–ADM (Left)
L_ULN_RD_WA.description: Intermediate node representing restricted-distance (RD) conduction slowing of the left ulnar motor nerve across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment, indicating focal slowing in the distal segment.

L_ULN_RDLDDEL.name: Ulnar Nerve Combined RD/LD Conduction Delay (Left)
L_ULN_RDLDDEL.description: Intermediate node integrating restricted-distance (RD) and long-distance (LD) conduction delays in the left ulnar motor nerve, contributing to the overall distal motor latency.

L_ULN_DIFSLOW_WA.name: Ulnar Nerve Diffuse Slowing Wrist–ADM (Left)
L_ULN_DIFSLOW_WA.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse conduction slowing (DIFSLOW) of the left ulnar motor nerve across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment.

L_ULN_DCV_WA.name: Ulnar Nerve Distal Conduction Velocity Effects Wrist–ADM (Left)
L_ULN_DCV_WA.description: Intermediate node representing distal conduction velocity (DCV) effects on the left ulnar motor nerve across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment.

L_ULN_ALLDEL_WA.name: Ulnar Nerve Combined Delay Effects Wrist–ADM (Left)
L_ULN_ALLDEL_WA.description: Intermediate node integrating all sources of conduction delay on the left ulnar motor nerve across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment, contributing to distal motor latency.

L_ULN_LAT_WA.name: Ulnar Nerve Distal Motor Latency Wrist–ADM (Left)
L_ULN_LAT_WA.description: Observable node representing the measured distal motor latency (LAT) of the left ulnar motor response recorded from the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) across the wrist-to-ADM (WA) segment.

L_ADM_VOL_ACT.name: ADM Voluntary Activation (Left)
L_ADM_VOL_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the level of voluntary activation of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle by the patient during examination, influencing observed recruitment and force.

L_ADM_FORCE.name: ADM Force (Left)
L_ADM_FORCE.description: Observable node representing the force generated by the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle during voluntary contraction, reflecting muscle bulk, motor unit availability, and voluntary activation.

L_ADM_MUSCLE_VOL.name: ADM Muscle Volume (Left)
L_ADM_MUSCLE_VOL.description: Intermediate node representing the volume of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle, derived from muscle size and contributing to force generation.

L_ADM_MVA_RECRUIT.name: ADM Maximal Voluntary Activation Recruitment (Left)
L_ADM_MVA_RECRUIT.description: Intermediate node representing the recruitment pattern of motor units in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) during maximal voluntary activation (MVA), affected by motor unit loss and voluntary effort.

L_ADM_MVA_AMP.name: ADM Maximal Voluntary Activation Amplitude (Left)
L_ADM_MVA_AMP.description: Intermediate node representing the EMG interference pattern amplitude of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) during maximal voluntary activation (MVA).

L_ADM_TA_CONCL.name: ADM Turns/Amplitude Conclusion (Left)
L_ADM_TA_CONCL.description: Observable node representing the conclusion drawn from turns-amplitude (TA) analysis of the EMG interference pattern in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), categorizing the pattern as normal, neurogenic, or myopathic.

L_ADM_MUPAMP.name: ADM Motor Unit Potential Amplitude (Left)
L_ADM_MUPAMP.description: Intermediate node representing the amplitude of motor unit potentials (MUPs) recorded from the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), reflecting motor unit size and reinnervation status.

L_ADM_QUAN_MUPAMP.name: ADM Quantitative MUP Amplitude (Left)
L_ADM_QUAN_MUPAMP.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured motor unit potential (MUP) amplitude from the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), as obtained via quantitative EMG analysis.

L_ADM_QUAL_MUPAMP.name: ADM Qualitative MUP Amplitude (Left)
L_ADM_QUAL_MUPAMP.description: Observable node representing the qualitative (visually assessed) motor unit potential (MUP) amplitude from the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), as judged by the examiner during routine EMG.

L_ADM_MUPDUR.name: ADM Motor Unit Potential Duration (Left)
L_ADM_MUPDUR.description: Intermediate node representing the duration of motor unit potentials (MUPs) recorded from the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), reflecting motor unit territory and synchronization.

L_ADM_QUAN_MUPDUR.name: ADM Quantitative MUP Duration (Left)
L_ADM_QUAN_MUPDUR.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured motor unit potential (MUP) duration from the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), as obtained via quantitative EMG analysis.

L_ADM_QUAL_MUPDUR.name: ADM Qualitative MUP Duration (Left)
L_ADM_QUAL_MUPDUR.description: Observable node representing the qualitative (visually assessed) motor unit potential (MUP) duration from the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), as judged by the examiner during routine EMG.

L_ADM_QUAN_MUPPOLY.name: ADM Quantitative MUP Polyphasia (Left)
L_ADM_QUAN_MUPPOLY.description: Observable node representing the quantitatively measured polyphasia of motor unit potentials (MUPs) from the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), reflecting fiber asynchrony from reinnervation or muscle disease.

L_ADM_QUAL_MUPPOLY.name: ADM Qualitative MUP Polyphasia (Left)
L_ADM_QUAL_MUPPOLY.description: Observable node representing the qualitative (visually assessed) polyphasia of motor unit potentials (MUPs) from the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), as judged by the examiner during routine EMG.

L_ADM_MUPSATEL.name: ADM MUP Satellite Potentials (Left)
L_ADM_MUPSATEL.description: Observable node representing the presence of satellite (linked) potentials in motor unit potentials (MUPs) of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), an indicator of recent reinnervation.

L_ADM_MUPINSTAB.name: ADM MUP Instability (Left)
L_ADM_MUPINSTAB.description: Observable node representing the instability (amplitude/shape variation between successive firings) of motor unit potentials (MUPs) from the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), reflecting unstable neuromuscular transmission in immature endplates.

L_ADM_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.name: ADM Repetitive Stimulation CMAP Amplitude (Left)
L_ADM_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.description: Intermediate node representing the baseline compound muscle action potential (CMAP) amplitude of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) during repetitive nerve stimulation testing.

L_ADM_REPSTIM_DECR.name: ADM Repetitive Stimulation Decrement (Left)
L_ADM_REPSTIM_DECR.description: Observable node representing the decrement in CMAP amplitude on slow repetitive nerve stimulation of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), a hallmark of postsynaptic neuromuscular transmission disorders such as myasthenia gravis.

L_ADM_REPSTIM_FACILI.name: ADM Repetitive Stimulation Facilitation (Left)
L_ADM_REPSTIM_FACILI.description: Observable node representing the post-exercise or high-frequency facilitation (increment) in CMAP amplitude of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) on repetitive stimulation, characteristic of presynaptic disorders such as Lambert-Eaton syndrome.

L_ADM_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.name: ADM Repetitive Stimulation Post-Exercise Decrement (Left)
L_ADM_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.description: Observable node representing the decrement in CMAP amplitude of the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) on repetitive stimulation following exercise (post-exercise exhaustion), used to detect neuromuscular junction disorders.

L_ADM_SF_JITTER.name: ADM Single-Fiber Jitter (Left)
L_ADM_SF_JITTER.description: Observable node representing the jitter (variability of interpotential intervals) measured by single-fiber EMG in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), a sensitive marker of neuromuscular transmission abnormality.

L_LNLC8_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from C8 Root Lesion (Left)
L_LNLC8_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing increased muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to a C8 root lesion (LNLC8), reflecting reinnervation-induced fiber clustering.

L_LNLLP_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Lower Plexus Lesion (Left)
L_LNLLP_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing increased muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to a lower plexus lesion (LNLLP), reflecting reinnervation.

L_LNLC8_LP_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Combined C8 and Lower Plexus Lesions (Left)
L_LNLC8_LP_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a C8 root lesion (LNLC8) and a lower plexus lesion (LNLLP) to muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_LNLE_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Elbow Lesion (Left)
L_LNLE_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing increased muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to an elbow lesion (LNLE), reflecting reinnervation-induced fiber clustering.

L_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Combined C8, Lower Plexus, and Elbow Lesions (Left)
L_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of C8 root, lower plexus, and elbow lesions to muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_DIFFN_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_DIFFN_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing increased muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN), reflecting reinnervation following generalized axon loss.

L_LNLW_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Wrist Lesion (Left)
L_LNLW_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing increased muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to a wrist lesion (LNLW).

L_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Combined Wrist Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a wrist lesion (LNLW) and a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Combined Local Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of all local nerve lesions (LNL) and diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_MYOP_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Myopathy (Left)
L_MYOP_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing alterations in muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to a myopathic process (MYOP), often reflecting fiber splitting or grouping.

L_MYDY_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Myotonic Dystrophy (Left)
L_MYDY_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing alterations in muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to myotonic dystrophy (MYDY).

L_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Combined Myopathy and Myotonic Dystrophy (Left)
L_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of myopathy (MYOP) and myotonic dystrophy (MYDY) to muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_MYAS_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Myasthenia (Left)
L_MYAS_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a myasthenic disorder (MYAS) to apparent changes in muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), as measured by single-fiber EMG.

L_OTHER_ADM_MUDENS.name: Other Causes of ADM Muscle Fiber Density Change (Left)
L_OTHER_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing changes in muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions and disorders.

L_MYAS_OTHER_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle Fiber Density from Combined Myasthenia and Other Causes (Left)
L_MYAS_OTHER_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a myasthenic disorder (MYAS) and other unmodeled causes to changes in muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_MUSCLE_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Muscle-Related Fiber Density Change (Left)
L_MUSCLE_ADM_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the muscle-disease-related contribution to changes in muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), aggregating myopathic and dystrophic effects.

L_ADM_MUDENS.name: ADM Total Muscle Fiber Density (Left)
L_ADM_MUDENS.description: Aggregate node representing the total muscle fiber density (MUDENS) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), integrating contributions from local nerve lesions, diffuse neuropathy, muscle disease, myasthenia, and other causes.

L_ADM_SF_DENSITY.name: ADM Single-Fiber Density (Left)
L_ADM_SF_DENSITY.description: Observable node representing the fiber density measured by single-fiber EMG in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), used as an indicator of reinnervation and motor unit remodeling.

L_LNLC8_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity from C8 Root Lesion (Left)
L_LNLC8_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neurogenic spontaneous activity (NEUR_ACT, e.g., fibrillations, positive sharp waves) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to a C8 root lesion (LNLC8).

L_LNLLP_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity from Lower Plexus Lesion (Left)
L_LNLLP_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neurogenic spontaneous activity in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to a lower plexus lesion (LNLLP).

L_LNLC8_LP_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity from Combined C8 and Lower Plexus Lesions (Left)
L_LNLC8_LP_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a C8 root lesion (LNLC8) and a lower plexus lesion (LNLLP) to neurogenic spontaneous activity in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_LNLE_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity from Elbow Lesion (Left)
L_LNLE_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neurogenic spontaneous activity in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to an elbow lesion (LNLE).

L_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity from Combined C8, Lower Plexus, and Elbow Lesions (Left)
L_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of C8 root, lower plexus, and elbow lesions to neurogenic spontaneous activity in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_DIFFN_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity from Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_DIFFN_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neurogenic spontaneous activity in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN).

L_LNLW_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity from Wrist Lesion (Left)
L_LNLW_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neurogenic spontaneous activity in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) attributable to a wrist lesion (LNLW).

L_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity from Combined Wrist Lesion and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of a wrist lesion (LNLW) and a diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to neurogenic spontaneous activity in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity from Combined Local Lesions and Diffuse Neuropathy (Left)
L_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node combining contributions of all local nerve lesions (LNL) and diffuse neuropathy (DIFFN) to neurogenic spontaneous activity in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_OTHER_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: Other Causes of ADM Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity (Left)
L_OTHER_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing neurogenic spontaneous activity in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM) from causes other than the explicitly modeled lesions and neuropathies.

L_ADM_NEUR_ACT.name: ADM Total Neurogenic Spontaneous Activity (Left)
L_ADM_NEUR_ACT.description: Aggregate node representing the total neurogenic spontaneous activity (NEUR_ACT, e.g., fibrillations, positive sharp waves) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), integrating contributions from all local nerve lesions, diffuse neuropathy, and other causes.

L_ADM_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.name: ADM Spontaneous Neurogenic Discharges (Left)
L_ADM_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.description: Observable node representing the presence of spontaneous neurogenic discharges (e.g., fibrillation potentials, positive sharp waves) recorded by needle EMG in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM), indicating active denervation.

L_MYOP_ADM_DENERV.name: ADM Denervation-Like Activity from Myopathy (Left)
L_MYOP_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a myopathic process (MYOP) to denervation-like spontaneous activity (e.g., fibrillation potentials seen in some inflammatory or necrotizing myopathies) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_MYDY_ADM_DENERV.name: ADM Denervation-Like Activity from Myotonic Dystrophy (Left)
L_MYDY_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myotonic dystrophy (MYDY) to denervation-like spontaneous activity (e.g., fibrillation potentials, myotonic discharges) in the left abductor digiti minimi (ADM).

L_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_DENERV.name: Myopathy/Myodystrophy Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_MYOP_MYDY_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myopathy and/or myodystrophy to denervation-like findings in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle. Combines myopathic and myodystrophic processes that can produce spontaneous activity resembling denervation.

L_OTHER_ADM_DENERV.name: Other Causes of ADM Denervation
L_OTHER_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing contributions from miscellaneous or unspecified pathological processes (other than the explicitly modeled neuropathies, myopathies, and neuromuscular transmission disorders) to denervation findings in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_NMT_ADM_DENERV.name: Neuromuscular Transmission Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_NMT_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of neuromuscular transmission (NMT) disorders, such as myasthenia, to denervation-like findings in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_OTHER_NMT_ADM_DENERV.name: Combined Other and NMT Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_OTHER_NMT_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of 'other' pathologies and neuromuscular transmission (NMT) disorders on denervation-like findings in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_MUSCLE_ADM_DENERV.name: Muscle-Level Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_MUSCLE_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating all muscle-intrinsic causes (myopathy, myodystrophy, NMT, and other) that contribute to denervation-like findings in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_LNLC8_ADM_DENERV.name: C8 Root Lesion Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_LNLC8_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a local nerve lesion at the C8 root (LNLC8) to denervation in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle, which is innervated through the C8 myotome via the ulnar nerve.

L_LNLLP_ADM_DENERV.name: Lower Plexus Lesion Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_LNLLP_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a local nerve lesion at the lower brachial plexus (LNLLP) to denervation in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_LNLC8_LP_ADM_DENERV.name: Combined C8/Lower Plexus Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_LNLC8_LP_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of C8 root lesions and lower brachial plexus lesions on denervation findings in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_LNLE_ADM_DENERV.name: Elbow Ulnar Lesion Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_LNLE_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a local nerve lesion of the ulnar nerve at the elbow (LNLE) to denervation in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_DENERV.name: Combined C8/Lower Plexus/Elbow Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_LNLC8_LP_E_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of C8 root, lower brachial plexus, and elbow ulnar nerve lesions on denervation findings in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_DIFFN_ADM_DENERV.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_DIFFN_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a diffuse (generalized) neuropathy to denervation in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_LNLW_ADM_DENERV.name: Wrist Ulnar Lesion Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_LNLW_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of a local nerve lesion of the ulnar nerve at the wrist (LNLW) to denervation in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_DENERV.name: Combined Diffuse Neuropathy/Wrist Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_DIFFN_LNLW_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of diffuse neuropathy and a local ulnar nerve lesion at the wrist on denervation findings in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_DENERV.name: Combined Local and Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to ADM Denervation
L_LNL_DIFFN_ADM_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating the contributions of all local nerve lesions (C8, lower plexus, elbow, wrist) and diffuse neuropathy to denervation findings in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_ADM_DENERV.name: ADM Denervation
L_ADM_DENERV.description: Overall node representing the presence and degree of denervation in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle, integrating contributions from all neurogenic and muscle-intrinsic causes.

L_ADM_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.name: ADM Spontaneous Denervation Activity
L_ADM_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.description: Observable node representing spontaneous denervation activity (e.g., fibrillation potentials and positive sharp waves) recorded by needle EMG at rest in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_ADM_SPONT_HF_DISCH.name: ADM Spontaneous High-Frequency Discharges
L_ADM_SPONT_HF_DISCH.description: Observable node representing spontaneous high-frequency discharges (e.g., complex repetitive discharges, myotonic discharges) detected at rest by needle EMG in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle.

L_ADM_SPONT_INS_ACT.name: ADM Spontaneous Insertional Activity
L_ADM_SPONT_INS_ACT.description: Observable node representing insertional activity recorded by needle EMG upon needle movement in the abductor digiti minimi (ADM) muscle. Increased insertional activity suggests denervation or muscle membrane instability.

L_OTHER_DELT_NMT.name: Other Contribution to Deltoid NMT Disorder
L_OTHER_DELT_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of miscellaneous or unspecified pathological processes to neuromuscular transmission (NMT) abnormalities in the deltoid muscle.

L_LNLPC5_AXIL_SEV.name: C5 Posterior Cord Lesion Severity (Axillary)
L_LNLPC5_AXIL_SEV.description: Intermediate node representing the severity of damage to the axillary nerve resulting from a local nerve lesion at the C5 root or posterior cord (LNLPC5). Reflects how strongly the axillary nerve is affected.

L_LNLPC5_AXIL_TIME.name: C5 Posterior Cord Axillary Lesion Time Course
L_LNLPC5_AXIL_TIME.description: Intermediate node representing the temporal evolution (acute, subacute, chronic) of axillary nerve injury from an LNLPC5 lesion. Determines whether downstream findings reflect acute denervation or chronic reinnervation patterns.

L_LNLPC5_AXIL_PATHO.name: C5 Posterior Cord Axillary Pathophysiology
L_LNLPC5_AXIL_PATHO.description: Intermediate node representing the pathophysiological character (demyelinating vs. axonal) of axillary nerve damage from an LNLPC5 lesion. Determines the expected pattern of electrophysiological abnormalities.

L_LNLPC5_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: C5 Posterior Cord Contribution to Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
L_LNLPC5_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of an LNLPC5 lesion to chronic denervation and reinnervation changes in the deltoid muscle, such as enlarged/polyphasic motor unit potentials.

L_DIFFN_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
L_DIFFN_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to chronic denervation and reinnervation changes in the deltoid muscle.

L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Combined C5 Posterior Cord/Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of LNLPC5 lesion and diffuse neuropathy on chronic denervation/reinnervation findings in the deltoid muscle.

L_MYOP_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Myopathy Contribution to Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
L_MYOP_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myopathy to motor unit potential changes mimicking denervation/reinnervation in the deltoid muscle.

L_MYDY_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Myodystrophy Contribution to Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
L_MYDY_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myodystrophy (muscular dystrophy) to motor unit potential changes mimicking denervation/reinnervation in the deltoid muscle.

L_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Combined Myopathy/Myodystrophy Contribution to Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
L_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node combining myopathic and myodystrophic contributions to motor unit potential changes in the deltoid muscle.

L_OTHER_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Other Contribution to Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
L_OTHER_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to denervation/reinnervation findings in the deltoid muscle.

L_MUSCLE_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Muscle-Level Contribution to Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
L_MUSCLE_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Intermediate node aggregating all muscle-intrinsic causes (myopathy, myodystrophy, other) of motor unit potential changes mimicking denervation/reinnervation in the deltoid muscle.

L_DELT_DE_REGEN.name: Deltoid Denervation/Reinnervation
L_DELT_DE_REGEN.description: Overall node representing the degree of chronic denervation and reinnervation in the deltoid muscle, integrating contributions from neurogenic and muscle-intrinsic processes.

L_DE_REGEN_DELT_NMT.name: Denervation/Reinnervation Contribution to Deltoid NMT Findings
L_DE_REGEN_DELT_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing how chronic denervation/reinnervation in the deltoid (with immature reinnervating endplates) can produce abnormal neuromuscular transmission (NMT) findings such as jitter.

L_MYAS_DELT_NMT.name: Myasthenia Contribution to Deltoid NMT
L_MYAS_DELT_NMT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myasthenia (a primary disorder of neuromuscular transmission) to NMT abnormalities in the deltoid muscle.

L_MYAS_DE_REGEN_DELT_NMT.name: Combined Myasthenia/Reinnervation Contribution to Deltoid NMT
L_MYAS_DE_REGEN_DELT_NMT.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of myasthenia and chronic denervation/reinnervation on neuromuscular transmission abnormalities in the deltoid muscle.

L_DELT_NMT.name: Deltoid Neuromuscular Transmission Status
L_DELT_NMT.description: Overall node representing the integrity of neuromuscular transmission in the deltoid muscle, integrating myasthenic, reinnervation-related, and other contributions.

L_OTHER_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Other Contribution to Deltoid Muscle Fiber Size
L_OTHER_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to abnormalities of muscle fiber size in the deltoid.

L_MYDY_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Myodystrophy Contribution to Deltoid Muscle Fiber Size
L_MYDY_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myodystrophy to abnormal muscle fiber size (atrophy/hypertrophy) in the deltoid.

L_MYOP_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Myopathy Contribution to Deltoid Muscle Fiber Size
L_MYOP_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myopathy to abnormal muscle fiber size in the deltoid muscle.

L_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Combined Myopathy/Myodystrophy Contribution to Deltoid Muscle Fiber Size
L_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining myopathic and myodystrophic contributions to abnormal muscle fiber size in the deltoid.

L_MUSCLE_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Muscle-Level Contribution to Deltoid Muscle Fiber Size
L_MUSCLE_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node aggregating all muscle-intrinsic causes of abnormal muscle fiber size in the deltoid.

L_DIFFN_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Muscle Fiber Size
L_DIFFN_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy (causing neurogenic atrophy) to abnormal muscle fiber size in the deltoid.

L_LNLPC5_DELT_MUSIZE.name: C5 Posterior Cord Contribution to Deltoid Muscle Fiber Size
L_LNLPC5_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of an LNLPC5 lesion (causing neurogenic atrophy of axillary-innervated fibers) to abnormal muscle fiber size in the deltoid.

L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Combined C5 Posterior Cord/Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Muscle Fiber Size
L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Intermediate node combining LNLPC5 and diffuse neuropathy contributions to neurogenic muscle fiber size changes in the deltoid.

L_DELT_MUSIZE.name: Deltoid Muscle Fiber Size
L_DELT_MUSIZE.description: Overall node representing the muscle fiber size status (atrophy or hypertrophy) of the deltoid, integrating all neurogenic and muscle-intrinsic contributions.

L_DELT_EFFMUS.name: Deltoid Effective Muscle
L_DELT_EFFMUS.description: Intermediate node representing the effective amount of functional muscle tissue in the deltoid available for force generation and electrical activity, after accounting for fiber size and loss.

L_DIFFN_AXIL_BLOCK.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Axillary Conduction Block
L_DIFFN_AXIL_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to conduction block along the axillary nerve.

L_OTHER_AXIL_BLOCK.name: Other Contribution to Axillary Conduction Block
L_OTHER_AXIL_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to conduction block along the axillary nerve.

L_AXIL_BLOCK_ED.name: Axillary Conduction Block at Erb's Point–Deltoid Segment
L_AXIL_BLOCK_ED.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the axillary nerve along the Erb's point to deltoid (ED) recording segment, manifesting as a drop in CMAP amplitude with proximal stimulation.

L_LNLPC5_DELT_MALOSS.name: C5 Posterior Cord Contribution to Deltoid Muscle Axon Loss
L_LNLPC5_DELT_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of an LNLPC5 lesion to loss of motor axons innervating the deltoid muscle.

L_DIFFN_DELT_MALOSS.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Muscle Axon Loss
L_DIFFN_DELT_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to loss of motor axons innervating the deltoid.

L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MALOSS.name: Combined C5 Posterior Cord/Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Motor Axon Loss
L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining LNLPC5 and diffuse neuropathy contributions to loss of motor axons innervating the deltoid muscle.

L_OTHER_DELT_MALOSS.name: Other Contribution to Deltoid Motor Axon Loss
L_OTHER_DELT_MALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to motor axon loss in the deltoid.

L_DELT_MALOSS.name: Deltoid Motor Axon Loss
L_DELT_MALOSS.description: Overall node representing the degree of motor axon loss affecting the deltoid muscle, integrating contributions from local lesions, diffuse neuropathy, and other causes.

L_DELT_MULOSS.name: Deltoid Motor Unit Loss
L_DELT_MULOSS.description: Overall node representing the loss of functional motor units in the deltoid muscle, derived from motor axon loss and reflecting the reduction in the number of innervating motor neurons.

L_DELT_ALLAMP.name: Deltoid Overall CMAP Amplitude
L_DELT_ALLAMP.description: Intermediate node representing the overall expected compound muscle action potential (CMAP) amplitude from the deltoid, before localization-specific adjustments. Reflects effective muscle and motor unit numbers.

L_AXIL_AMP_E.name: Axillary CMAP Amplitude at Erb's Point
L_AXIL_AMP_E.description: Observable node representing the CMAP amplitude recorded from the deltoid muscle when stimulating the axillary nerve at Erb's point.

L_AXIL_RD_ED.name: Axillary Relative Drop (Erb–Deltoid)
L_AXIL_RD_ED.description: Observable node representing the relative drop in CMAP amplitude between distal and proximal (Erb's point) stimulation across the Erb–deltoid segment of the axillary nerve, indicating partial conduction block or temporal dispersion.

L_LNLPC5_AXIL_DIFSLOW.name: C5 Posterior Cord Contribution to Axillary Differential Slowing
L_LNLPC5_AXIL_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of an LNLPC5 lesion to differential (non-uniform) slowing of conduction in the axillary nerve.

L_DIFFN_AXIL_DIFSLOW.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Axillary Differential Slowing
L_DIFFN_AXIL_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to differential slowing of conduction in the axillary nerve.

L_AXIL_DIFSLOW_ED.name: Axillary Differential Slowing (Erb–Deltoid)
L_AXIL_DIFSLOW_ED.description: Intermediate node representing differential (non-uniform) slowing of conduction in the axillary nerve over the Erb–deltoid segment, leading to temporal dispersion of the CMAP.

L_AXIL_DCV.name: Axillary Distal Conduction Velocity
L_AXIL_DCV.description: Intermediate node representing the conduction velocity of the axillary nerve along its distal portion.

L_AXIL_DEL.name: Axillary Distal Endplate Latency
L_AXIL_DEL.description: Intermediate node representing the distal endplate-related latency component of axillary nerve conduction, contributing to overall measured latency to the deltoid.

L_AXIL_LAT_ED.name: Axillary Latency (Erb–Deltoid)
L_AXIL_LAT_ED.description: Observable node representing the conduction latency of the axillary nerve from Erb's point stimulation to deltoid CMAP recording.

L_DELT_VOL_ACT.name: Deltoid Voluntary Activation
L_DELT_VOL_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the level of voluntary muscle activation by the patient during deltoid testing. Affects the interpretability of force, recruitment, and EMG findings.

L_DELT_FORCE.name: Deltoid Force
L_DELT_FORCE.description: Observable node representing the clinically measured strength or force generated by the deltoid muscle, depending on effective muscle, motor unit count, and voluntary activation.

L_DELT_MUSCLE_VOL.name: Deltoid Muscle Volume
L_DELT_MUSCLE_VOL.description: Observable node representing the gross muscle volume or bulk of the deltoid muscle, reflecting overall muscle mass.

L_DELT_MVA_RECRUIT.name: Deltoid Maximum Voluntary Activity Recruitment
L_DELT_MVA_RECRUIT.description: Observable node representing the recruitment pattern (e.g., full interference, reduced, single oscillation) seen during maximum voluntary activation of the deltoid on needle EMG.

L_DELT_MVA_AMP.name: Deltoid Maximum Voluntary Activity Amplitude
L_DELT_MVA_AMP.description: Observable node representing the amplitude of the EMG envelope during maximum voluntary activation of the deltoid, reflecting interference pattern density.

L_DELT_TA_CONCL.name: Deltoid Turns/Amplitude Conclusion
L_DELT_TA_CONCL.description: Observable node representing the diagnostic conclusion (e.g., normal, neurogenic, myopathic) drawn from turns/amplitude analysis of the deltoid EMG signal.

L_DELT_MUPAMP.name: Deltoid Motor Unit Potential Amplitude
L_DELT_MUPAMP.description: Intermediate node representing the amplitude characteristics of motor unit potentials (MUPs) recorded from the deltoid by needle EMG.

L_DELT_QUAN_MUPAMP.name: Deltoid Quantitative MUP Amplitude
L_DELT_QUAN_MUPAMP.description: Observable node representing quantitatively measured motor unit potential amplitude in the deltoid muscle.

L_DELT_QUAL_MUPAMP.name: Deltoid Qualitative MUP Amplitude
L_DELT_QUAL_MUPAMP.description: Observable node representing the qualitative (visual, semi-quantitative) assessment of motor unit potential amplitude in the deltoid.

L_DELT_MUPDUR.name: Deltoid Motor Unit Potential Duration
L_DELT_MUPDUR.description: Intermediate node representing the duration of motor unit potentials recorded from the deltoid muscle.

L_DELT_QUAN_MUPDUR.name: Deltoid Quantitative MUP Duration
L_DELT_QUAN_MUPDUR.description: Observable node representing quantitatively measured motor unit potential duration in the deltoid.

L_DELT_QUAL_MUPDUR.name: Deltoid Qualitative MUP Duration
L_DELT_QUAL_MUPDUR.description: Observable node representing the qualitative assessment of motor unit potential duration in the deltoid.

L_DELT_QUAN_MUPPOLY.name: Deltoid Quantitative MUP Polyphasia
L_DELT_QUAN_MUPPOLY.description: Observable node representing quantitatively measured polyphasia (number of phases per MUP) of motor unit potentials in the deltoid.

L_DELT_QUAL_MUPPOLY.name: Deltoid Qualitative MUP Polyphasia
L_DELT_QUAL_MUPPOLY.description: Observable node representing the qualitative assessment of polyphasia of motor unit potentials in the deltoid.

L_DELT_MUPSATEL.name: Deltoid MUP Satellite Potentials
L_DELT_MUPSATEL.description: Observable node representing the presence of satellite (linked) potentials trailing the main motor unit potential in the deltoid, an indicator of immature reinnervation.

L_DELT_MUPINSTAB.name: Deltoid MUP Instability
L_DELT_MUPINSTAB.description: Observable node representing instability (jiggle, variability between consecutive firings) of motor unit potentials in the deltoid, indicative of unstable neuromuscular transmission.

L_DELT_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.name: Deltoid Repetitive Stimulation CMAP Amplitude
L_DELT_REPSTIM_CMAPAMP.description: Observable node representing the baseline CMAP amplitude recorded from the deltoid during repetitive nerve stimulation studies.

L_DELT_REPSTIM_DECR.name: Deltoid Repetitive Stimulation Decrement
L_DELT_REPSTIM_DECR.description: Observable node representing the percent decrement in CMAP amplitude on slow repetitive nerve stimulation of the deltoid, indicative of postsynaptic NMT disorders.

L_DELT_REPSTIM_FACILI.name: Deltoid Repetitive Stimulation Facilitation
L_DELT_REPSTIM_FACILI.description: Observable node representing CMAP amplitude facilitation (incremental response) during high-frequency repetitive stimulation or post-exercise testing of the deltoid, indicative of presynaptic NMT disorders.

L_DELT_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.name: Deltoid Repetitive Stimulation Post-Activation Decrement
L_DELT_REPSTIM_POST_DECR.description: Observable node representing the decrement in CMAP amplitude observed after sustained activation (post-exercise exhaustion) during repetitive stimulation of the deltoid.

L_DELT_SF_JITTER.name: Deltoid Single-Fiber EMG Jitter
L_DELT_SF_JITTER.description: Observable node representing the jitter measured by single-fiber EMG (SFEMG) in the deltoid, a sensitive marker of neuromuscular transmission integrity.

L_LNLPC5_DELT_MUDENS.name: C5 Posterior Cord Contribution to Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_LNLPC5_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of an LNLPC5 lesion to motor unit density (fiber density) abnormalities in the deltoid.

L_DIFFN_DELT_MUDENS.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_DIFFN_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to motor unit density abnormalities in the deltoid.

L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MUDENS.name: Combined C5 Posterior Cord/Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining the effects of LNLPC5 lesions and diffuse neuropathy on motor unit density in the deltoid.

L_MYOP_DELT_MUDENS.name: Myopathy Contribution to Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_MYOP_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myopathy to motor unit/fiber density changes in the deltoid.

L_MYDY_DELT_MUDENS.name: Myodystrophy Contribution to Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_MYDY_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myodystrophy to motor unit/fiber density changes in the deltoid.

L_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_MUDENS.name: Combined Myopathy/Myodystrophy Contribution to Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining myopathic and myodystrophic contributions to motor unit/fiber density changes in the deltoid.

L_MYAS_DELT_MUDENS.name: Myasthenia Contribution to Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_MYAS_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myasthenia to apparent motor unit/fiber density changes in the deltoid.

L_OTHER_DELT_MUDENS.name: Other Contribution to Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_OTHER_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to motor unit/fiber density changes in the deltoid.

L_MYAS_OTHER_DELT_MUDENS.name: Combined Myasthenia/Other Contribution to Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_MYAS_OTHER_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node combining myasthenic and 'other' contributions to motor unit/fiber density changes in the deltoid.

L_MUSCLE_DELT_MUDENS.name: Muscle-Level Contribution to Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_MUSCLE_DELT_MUDENS.description: Intermediate node aggregating all muscle-intrinsic contributions (myopathy, myodystrophy, myasthenia, other) to motor unit/fiber density changes in the deltoid.

L_DELT_MUDENS.name: Deltoid Motor Unit Density
L_DELT_MUDENS.description: Overall node representing the motor unit (fiber) density in the deltoid muscle, integrating contributions from neurogenic and muscle-intrinsic processes.

L_DELT_SF_DENSITY.name: Deltoid Single-Fiber EMG Fiber Density
L_DELT_SF_DENSITY.description: Observable node representing the fiber density measured by single-fiber EMG in the deltoid, reflecting the number of muscle fibers per motor unit within the SFEMG recording radius.

L_LNLPC5_DELT_NEUR_ACT.name: C5 Posterior Cord Contribution to Deltoid Neurogenic Activity
L_LNLPC5_DELT_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of an LNLPC5 lesion to spontaneous neurogenic activity (e.g., fasciculations) in the deltoid.

L_DIFFN_DELT_NEUR_ACT.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Neurogenic Activity
L_DIFFN_DELT_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to spontaneous neurogenic activity in the deltoid.

L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_NEUR_ACT.name: Combined C5 Posterior Cord/Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Neurogenic Activity
L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node combining the contributions of LNLPC5 and diffuse neuropathy to spontaneous neurogenic activity in the deltoid.

L_OTHER_DELT_NEUR_ACT.name: Other Contribution to Deltoid Neurogenic Activity
L_OTHER_DELT_NEUR_ACT.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to spontaneous neurogenic activity in the deltoid.

L_DELT_NEUR_ACT.name: Deltoid Neurogenic Activity
L_DELT_NEUR_ACT.description: Overall node representing the level of spontaneous neurogenic activity (e.g., fasciculations) in the deltoid, integrating all contributing causes.

L_DELT_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.name: Deltoid Spontaneous Neurogenic Discharges
L_DELT_SPONT_NEUR_DISCH.description: Observable node representing spontaneous neurogenic discharges, such as fasciculation potentials, recorded by needle EMG in the deltoid muscle.

L_MYOP_DELT_DENERV.name: Myopathy Contribution to Deltoid Denervation
L_MYOP_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myopathy to denervation-like findings in the deltoid muscle.

L_MYDY_DELT_DENERV.name: Myodystrophy Contribution to Deltoid Denervation
L_MYDY_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of myodystrophy to denervation-like findings in the deltoid muscle.

L_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_DENERV.name: Combined Myopathy/Myodystrophy Contribution to Deltoid Denervation
L_MYOP_MYDY_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining myopathic and myodystrophic contributions to denervation-like findings in the deltoid muscle.

L_OTHER_DELT_DENERV.name: Other Contribution to Deltoid Denervation
L_OTHER_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to denervation-like findings in the deltoid.

L_NMT_DELT_DENERV.name: NMT Contribution to Deltoid Denervation
L_NMT_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of neuromuscular transmission disorders to denervation-like findings in the deltoid.

L_OTHER_NMT_DELT_DENERV.name: Combined Other/NMT Contribution to Deltoid Denervation
L_OTHER_NMT_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining 'other' and neuromuscular transmission contributions to denervation-like findings in the deltoid.

L_MUSCLE_DELT_DENERV.name: Muscle-Level Contribution to Deltoid Denervation
L_MUSCLE_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node aggregating all muscle-intrinsic contributions (myopathy, myodystrophy, NMT, other) to denervation-like findings in the deltoid.

L_LNLPC5_DELT_DENERV.name: C5 Posterior Cord Contribution to Deltoid Denervation
L_LNLPC5_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of an LNLPC5 lesion to denervation in the deltoid muscle.

L_DIFFN_DELT_DENERV.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Denervation
L_DIFFN_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to denervation in the deltoid muscle.

L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_DENERV.name: Combined C5 Posterior Cord/Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Deltoid Denervation
L_LNLPC5_DIFFN_DELT_DENERV.description: Intermediate node combining LNLPC5 and diffuse neuropathy contributions to denervation in the deltoid muscle.

L_DELT_DENERV.name: Deltoid Denervation
L_DELT_DENERV.description: Overall node representing the presence and degree of denervation in the deltoid muscle, integrating contributions from all neurogenic and muscle-intrinsic causes.

L_DELT_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.name: Deltoid Spontaneous Denervation Activity
L_DELT_SPONT_DENERV_ACT.description: Observable node representing spontaneous denervation activity (e.g., fibrillation potentials, positive sharp waves) recorded at rest by needle EMG in the deltoid.

L_DELT_SPONT_HF_DISCH.name: Deltoid Spontaneous High-Frequency Discharges
L_DELT_SPONT_HF_DISCH.description: Observable node representing spontaneous high-frequency discharges (e.g., complex repetitive discharges, myotonic discharges) recorded at rest by needle EMG in the deltoid.

L_DELT_SPONT_INS_ACT.name: Deltoid Spontaneous Insertional Activity
L_DELT_SPONT_INS_ACT.description: Observable node representing insertional activity recorded by needle EMG upon needle movement in the deltoid muscle, with increased values suggesting denervation or membrane instability.

L_OTHER_ISCH_DISP.name: Other Contribution to Ischiadic Temporal Dispersion
L_OTHER_ISCH_DISP.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to temporal dispersion of sensory or motor responses along the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve.

L_DIFFN_ISCH_DISP.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Ischiadic Temporal Dispersion
L_DIFFN_ISCH_DISP.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to temporal dispersion of responses along the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve.

L_SUR_DISP_CA.name: Sural Temporal Dispersion (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_DISP_CA.description: Intermediate node representing temporal dispersion of the sural sensory nerve action potential along the calf (CA) recording segment.

L_OTHER_ISCH_BLOCK.name: Other Contribution to Ischiadic Conduction Block
L_OTHER_ISCH_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to conduction block in the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve.

L_DIFFN_ISCH_BLOCK.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Ischiadic Conduction Block
L_DIFFN_ISCH_BLOCK.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to conduction block in the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve.

L_SUR_BLOCK_CA.name: Sural Conduction Block (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_BLOCK_CA.description: Intermediate node representing conduction block in the sural sensory nerve along the calf segment.

L_OTHER_ISCH_SALOSS.name: Other Contribution to Ischiadic Sensory Axon Loss
L_OTHER_ISCH_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to sensory axon loss in the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve.

L_DIFFN_ISCH_SALOSS.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Ischiadic Sensory Axon Loss
L_DIFFN_ISCH_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to sensory axon loss in the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve.

L_LNL_ISCH_SEV.name: Local Ischiadic Nerve Lesion Severity
L_LNL_ISCH_SEV.description: Intermediate node representing the severity of damage to the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve from a local nerve lesion. Reflects how strongly the nerve is affected at the lesion site.

L_LNL_ISCH_PATHO.name: Local Ischiadic Nerve Lesion Pathophysiology
L_LNL_ISCH_PATHO.description: Intermediate node representing the pathophysiological character (demyelinating vs. axonal) of a local lesion of the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve.

L_LNL_ISCH_SALOSS_CA.name: Local Ischiadic Lesion Sensory Axon Loss (Calf Segment)
L_LNL_ISCH_SALOSS_CA.description: Intermediate node representing sensory axon loss in the sural-contributing fibers of the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve at the calf segment, due to a local ischiadic lesion.

L_DIFFN_LNL_ISCH_SALOSS.name: Combined Diffuse Neuropathy/Local Ischiadic Lesion Sensory Axon Loss
L_DIFFN_LNL_ISCH_SALOSS.description: Intermediate node combining the contributions of diffuse neuropathy and a local ischiadic (sciatic) lesion to sensory axon loss.

L_SUR_SALOSS.name: Sural Sensory Axon Loss
L_SUR_SALOSS.description: Overall node representing the degree of sensory axon loss affecting the sural nerve, integrating contributions from local lesions, diffuse neuropathy, and other causes.

L_SUR_EFFAXLOSS.name: Sural Effective Axonal Loss
L_SUR_EFFAXLOSS.description: Intermediate node representing the effective sural sensory axonal loss, accounting for both axonal loss and conduction block, which together determine the recorded SNAP amplitude.

L_SUR_ALLAMP_CA.name: Sural Overall SNAP Amplitude (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_ALLAMP_CA.description: Intermediate node representing the overall expected amplitude of the sural sensory nerve action potential (SNAP) along the calf segment, before adjustments for distal recording effects.

L_SUR_AMP_CA.name: Sural SNAP Amplitude (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_AMP_CA.description: Observable node representing the measured amplitude of the sural sensory nerve action potential (SNAP) recorded along the calf segment.

L_SUR_LD_CA.name: Sural Latency Difference (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_LD_CA.description: Observable node representing the latency difference of the sural sensory response across the calf recording segment.

L_SUR_RD_CA.name: Sural Relative Drop (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_RD_CA.description: Observable node representing the relative drop in sural SNAP amplitude across the calf segment, indicating partial conduction block or temporal dispersion.

L_SUR_LSLOW_CA.name: Sural Localized Slowing (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_LSLOW_CA.description: Intermediate node representing localized (focal) slowing of conduction in the sural nerve along the calf recording segment.

L_OTHER_ISCH_DIFSLOW.name: Other Contribution to Ischiadic Differential Slowing
L_OTHER_ISCH_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing miscellaneous or unspecified pathological contributions to differential (non-uniform) slowing of conduction in the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve.

L_DIFFN_ISCH_DIFSLOW.name: Diffuse Neuropathy Contribution to Ischiadic Differential Slowing
L_DIFFN_ISCH_DIFSLOW.description: Intermediate node representing the contribution of diffuse neuropathy to differential slowing of conduction in the ischiadic (sciatic) nerve.

L_SUR_DIFSLOW_CA.name: Sural Differential Slowing (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_DIFSLOW_CA.description: Intermediate node representing differential (non-uniform) slowing of conduction in the sural nerve along the calf segment, contributing to temporal dispersion of the SNAP.

L_SUR_DSLOW_CA.name: Sural Diffuse Slowing (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_DSLOW_CA.description: Intermediate node representing diffuse (uniform) slowing of conduction in the sural nerve along the calf segment.

L_SUR_ALLCV_CA.name: Sural Overall Conduction Velocity (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_ALLCV_CA.description: Intermediate node representing the overall expected conduction velocity of the sural nerve along the calf segment, integrating diffuse and differential slowing contributions.

L_SUR_CV_CA.name: Sural Conduction Velocity (Calf Segment)
L_SUR_CV_CA.description: Observable node representing the measured sensory conduction velocity of the sural nerve along the calf recording segment.
